articles.title: Enam orang Palestina tewas dalam serangan Israel di seluruh Gaza
articles.description: Enam orang Palestina tewas dalam serangan Israel di seluruh Gaza serangan Israel menewaskan enam orang Palestina dan terluka sekitar 20 orang lain di Jalur Gaza pada hari Jumat, menurut sumber medis dan saksi. Dalam Deir al- Balah, serangan tap ganda menyerang warga sipil yang membantu korban dari serangan awal, saksi mengatakan. Artileri Israel meratakan area sekitar kompleks perumahan Menara Qastal, timur kota, agen berita Palestina Wafa melaporkan. Mereka yang terluka dibawa ke Rumah Sakit Militer Aqsa di Deir Al- Balah. artileri Israel juga menghancurkan daerah timur Gaza City, Wafa menambahkan. Sejak gencatan senjata terjadi pada 11 Oktober 2025, serangan Israel telah membunuh 1.622 warga Palestina dan melukai 5.878 orang lainnya, menurut pelayanan kesehatan Gaza. Serangan dua kali lipat Israel terhadap warga sipil membantu korban dari serangan sebelumnya di Deir dan Balah. Sumber medis dan saksi mata mengatakan enam orang Palestina tewas dan sekitar 20 orang terluka dalam serangan Israel di seluruh Gaza pada hari Jumat. https: / / t.co / UpwLzygTnO - Middle East Eye (@ MiddleEastEye) November 13, 2026
articles.originalTitle: Six Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes across Gaza
articles.originalDescription: Six Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes across Gaza Israeli attacks killed six Palestinians and injured around 20 others across the Gaza Strip on Friday, according to medical sources and witnesses. In Deir al-Balah, a double-tap strike hit civilians who were helping victims of an earlier attack, witnesses said. Israeli artillery shelled the area around the al-Qastal Towers residential complex, east of the city, Palestinian news agency Wafa reported. Those wounded were taken to al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital in Deir al-Balah. Israeli artillery also shelled eastern areas of Gaza City, Wafa added. Since the ceasefire took effect on 11 October 2025, Israeli attacks have killed 1,622 Palestinians and injured 5,878 others, according to Gaza's health ministry. An Israeli double-tap strike targeted civilians helping victims of an earlier attack in Deir al-Balah. Medical sources and witnesses said six Palestinians were killed and around 20 injured in Israeli attacks across Gaza on Friday. https://t.co/UPwLzygTnO — Middle East Eye (@MiddleEastEye) November 13, 2026

articles.title: Aktivis permintaan berakhir untuk mentransfer bahan-bahan militer ke Israel melalui bandara JFK New York
articles.description: Aktivis permintaan berakhir untuk mentransfer bahan-bahan militer ke Israel melalui bandara JFK New York Dikirimkan oleh Mousira Elsamra di Fri, 11 / 13 / 2026 - 19: 19 Bandara dan Port Authority New York telah diperiksa setelah laporan-laporan mengenai bagian-bagian dari 'bunker-penghilang' yang sedang dilakukan oleh JFK Orang-orang berjalan melalui Terminal 7 di Bandara JFK di New York, pada 29 Agustus 2025 (Michael M Santiago / Getty Gambar melalui AFP) Off Aktivists, yang bergabung dengan Senator Negara Bagian New York, Jabari Brisport, yang berkumpul di luar World Trade Center pada hari Kamis, memprotes transportasi barang-barang militer melalui Bandara Internasional (JFK). Protes, yang diselenggarakan di bawah kampanye "Break the Chain" yang dipimpin oleh Sosialis Demokratis Amerika (DSA), datang di tengah pelaporan dari Intercept bahwa Penerbangan Chain Airlines memiliki material yang diangkut termasuk nitrocellosa, casing bom dan peralatan pemandu dari JFK ke Israel. Data open-source yang didokumentasikan dalam laporan mengungkapkan senjata yang diterbangkan dari JFK terkait dengan serangan massal korban di Gaza, Lebanon, dan Iran. Tantangan Airlines adalah perusahaan penerbangan kargo dan logistik Israel yang didirikan tahun 1976. Intercept melaporkan bahwa ribuan pon berharga untuk bom "bunker-buster" melewati JFK selama puncak perang AS-Israel terhadap Iran. Perang dimulai pada 28 Februari. Istirahat Chain mengatakan bahwa kargo militer menuju Israel melewati bandara JFK secara teratur, kadang-kadang beberapa kali seminggu, dan infrastruktur sipil tidak boleh digunakan untuk kepentingan militer Israel. Demonstrasi, termasuk anggota Yahudi Voice for Peace, Gerakan Pemuda Palestina, Sosialis Demokratik Amerika, dan Brooklyn for Peace menyerukan akhir pengiriman dan akuntabilitas yang lebih besar dari Port Authority, yang memiliki yurisdiksi atas Bandara JFK. articles.originalTitle: Activists demand end to transfer of military materials to Israel through New York's JFK Airport
articles.originalDescription: Activists demand end to transfer of military materials to Israel through New York's JFK Airport Submitted by Mounira Elsamra on Fri, 11/13/2026 - 19:19 The airport and New York's Port Authority have come under scrutiny after reports emerged that parts for 'bunker-busting' bombs were going through JFK People walk through Terminal 7 at JFK Airport in New York City, on 29 August 2025 (Michael M Santiago/Getty Images via AFP) Off Activists, joined by New York State Senator Jabari Brisport, gathered outside the World Trade Center on Thursday, protesting against the transportation of military-related materials through JFK International Airport (JFK). The protest, organised under the “Break the Chain” campaign led by the Democratic Socialists of America (DSA), comes amid reporting from The Intercept that Challenge Airlines cargo flights have transported materials including nitrocellulose, bomb casings and guidance kits from JFK to Israel. Open-source data documented in the report reveals weapons flown out of JFK are tied to mass casualty attacks in Gaza, Lebanon, and Iran. Challenge Airlines is an Israel-based cargo airline and logistics company founded in 1976. The Intercept reported that thousands of pounds worth of parts for "bunker-buster" bombs went through JFK during the height of the US-Israeli war on Iran. The war began on 28 February. Break the Chain says that military cargo bound for Israel passes through JFK Airport regularly, sometimes multiple times a week, and that civilian infrastructure should not be used for the benefit of the Israeli military. Protesters, including members of Jewish Voice for Peace, Palestinian Youth Movement, Democratic Socialists of America, and Brooklyn for Peace called for an end to the shipments and greater accountability from the Port Authority, which has jurisdiction over JFK Airport. Palestinian Youth Movement activist Ibtihal Aboussad brought up the possibility that the weapons shipments contributed to the recent bombing of Nasse

articles.title: Houthis mengatakan mereka menyerang bandara Riyadh dan pipa minyak Saudi
articles.description: Houthis mengatakan mereka menyerang bandara Riyadh dan pipa minyak Saudi Yaman Houthis mengatakan mereka menyerang Bandara Nasional Raja Riyadh dan stasiun pompa di Saudi Arab Barat, yang membawa minyak mentah ke pelabuhan Laut Merah Yanbu. Juru bicara militer Houthi Yahya Saree mengatakan kelompok itu menargetkan bandara dengan pesawat tanpa awak, dan stasiun pompa timur Riyadh dengan dua drone. Kelompok ini juga menembakkan dua rudal balistik pada apa yang Saree jelaskan sebagai konsentrasi pasukan Saudi di daerah al- Tuwal Jazan, di Arab Saudi selatan, katanya. Pernyataan grup tersebut datang beberapa jam setelah pertahanan sipil Saudi mengeluarkan semua yang jelas bagi provinsi ini, yang merupakan rumah bagi kilang Arab Saudi dengan kapasitas 400.000 barel minyak mentah per hari. Di Yaman, Saree mengatakan Houthis menyerang Depot senjata Saudi di kamp Ras Abbas di Aden dengan rudal balistik dan drone. Dia menambahkan bahwa mereka juga menembakkan rudal pada pasukan di bawah komando perwira Saudi di Lahj dan provinsi Jawf, mengklaim mereka menyebabkan banyak korban. Arab Saudi tidak segera mengkonfirmasi klaim Houthi. Di mana Anda akan pergi? Di sini ada 3 jam.
articles.originalTitle: Houthis say they attacked Riyadh airport and Saudi oil pipeline
articles.originalDescription: Houthis say they attacked Riyadh airport and Saudi oil pipeline Yemen's Houthis said they attacked Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport and a pumping station on Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline, which carries crude oil to the Red Sea port of Yanbu. Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree said the group targeted the airport with a drone, and a pumping station east of Riyadh with two drones. The group also fired two ballistic missiles at what Saree described as Saudi troop concentrations in the al-Tuwal area of Jazan, in southern Saudi Arabia, he said. The group's statements came hours after Saudi civil defence issued an all-clear for the province, which is home to a Saudi Aramco refinery with a capacity of 400,000 barrels of crude oil per day. Inside Yemen, Saree said the Houthis struck Saudi weapons depots at the Ras Abbas camp in Aden with ballistic missiles and drones. He added that they also fired missiles at forces under the command of Saudi officers in Lahj and al-Jawf provinces, claiming they caused many casualties. Saudi Arabia did not immediately confirm the Houthi claims. نفذت قواتنا المسلحة عمليتين عسكريتين نوعيتين الأولى استهدفت مطار خالد الدولي في عاصمة العدو السعودي الرياض بطائرة مسيرة وحققت هدفَها بنجاح بفضل الله. والأخرى استهدفت محطة الضخ رقم 3 بخط شرق غرب شرق الرياض بطائرتين مسيرتين وحققت العملية هدفها بنجاح بفضل الله. — العميد/ يحيى سريع (@Yah_Saree) November 13, 2026

articles.description: Pasukan Israel menahan pengantin laki-laki Palestina dalam serangan pernikahan karena serangan pemukim terus melintasi Barat Bank Israel pasukan dan pemukim dilakukan serangkaian serangan di seluruh West Bank pada hari Jumat, agen berita Palestina Wafa melaporkan. Di Jaba ', selatan Jenin, pasukan Israel menyerbu kota, menembakkan amunisi hidup dan gas air mata, dan menembak seorang pria Palestina muda di paha, yang Palestina Red Crescent Society mengatakan. Dekat Ramallah, pasukan Israel menyerbu sebuah aula pernikahan di desa Al- Mughayyir, menembak gas air mata di sekitar 150 tamu dan menahan empat orang, termasuk pengantin pria, kata Wafa, mengutip penduduk Palestina. Di desa yang sama, pasukan menyerbu rumah dari orang Palestina, Hamed Abu Naim, menyita kunci dan memaksa keluarga keluar. Di Beit Ummar, utara Hebron, beberapa orang Palestina dirawat karena menghirup gas air mata setelah pasukan Israel menembakkan gas air mata pada warga dan rumah mereka. Menurut warga, pasukan telah memasuki kota untuk melindungi pemukim Israel yang telah mengejar anak-anak dekat pintu masuk dan mencoba menyerang mereka. Tentara juga menghentikan kendaraan di pintu masuk dan mengalahkan pengemudinya. Selatan Yatta, di pemerintahan Hebron, pemukim mengepung rumah Yousef Shannaran selama 40 hari berturut-turut, aktivis media Osama Makhamra mengatakan Wafa. Dia mengatakan pemukim telah memasang kembali tenda di samping rumah bahwa pasukan Israel sebelumnya telah dihapus, sehingga keluarga hanya bisa datang dan pergi dengan koordinasi dengan pasukan terdekat. Settlers juga melempar batu ke rumah, menghancurkan jendela dan pintu dan meracuni air keluarga dengan baik, ia menambahkan. Dekat Khirbet Srouj, barat Jenin, pemukim menyerang keluarga Palestina memanen zaitun dan mencuri buah zaitun dan peralatan. articles.originalTitle: Israeli forces detain Palestinian groom in wedding raid as settler attacks continue across West Bank
articles.originalDescription: Israeli forces detain Palestinian groom in wedding raid as settler attacks continue across West Bank Israeli forces and settlers carried out a series of attacks across the occupied West Bank on Friday, the Palestinian news agency Wafa reported. In Jaba’, south of Jenin, Israeli forces stormed the town, firing live ammunition and tear gas, and shot a young Palestinian man in the thigh, the Palestinian Red Crescent Society said. Near Ramallah, Israeli forces raided a wedding hall in the village of al-Mughayyir, firing tear gas at around 150 guests and detaining four people, including the groom, Wafa said, citing Palestinian residents. In the same village, troops stormed the home of Palestinian man, Hamed Abu Naim, seized keys and forced the family out. In Beit Ummar, north of Hebron, several Palestinians were treated for tear gas inhalation after Israeli forces fired tear gas at residents and their homes. According to residents, troops had entered the town to protect Israeli settlers who had chased children near its entrance and tried to assault them. Soldiers also stopped a vehicle at the entrance and beat its driver. South of Yatta, in the Hebron governorate, settlers besieged the home of Yousef Shannaran for the 40th consecutive day, media activist Osama Makhamra told Wafa. He said settlers had put back up a tent next to the house that Israeli forces had previously removed, so the family can only come and go by coordinating with nearby troops. Settlers also threw stones at the home, smashed its windows and doors and poisoned the family’s water well, he added. Near Khirbet Srouj, west of Jenin, settlers attacked Palestinian families harvesting olives and stole harvested olives and equipment. In occupied East Jerusalem, two Palestinian brothers were forced to demolish their own homes in Sur Baher after the Israeli municipality said they had been built without permits. articles.title: Parlemen Arab menyambut resolusi PBB menuntut segera menghentikan serangan Houthi
articles.description: KAIRO - Parlemen Arab telah menyambut PBB Keamanan Dewan Resolusi 2837, yang menuntut bahwa milisi Houthi segera menghentikan eskalasi militer dan serangan, termasuk mereka menargetkan Arab Saudi, sipil, bandara komersial dan transportasi maritim internasional. Dalam sebuah pernyataan yang dikeluarkan pada hari Jumat, parlemen mengatakan bahwa adopsi dengan suara bulat mencerminkan pertumbuhan pengakuan internasional atas keseriusan aktivitas Houthi dan implikasi mereka untuk keamanan regional, stabilitas dan kebebasan navigasi internasional. parlemen menggambarkan resolusi sebagai langkah penting untuk menyatukan oposisi internasional dengan aksi teroris milisi dan terus melanggar. Ini menekankan kebutuhan untuk menerjemahkan kutukan internasional ke dalam tindakan yang menentukan, praktis untuk menghentikan serangan dan menahan mereka bertanggung jawab. Parlemen juga menyambut perpanjangan rezim sanksi yang dikenakan pada entitas terkait dengan milisi Houthi, untuk mencegah aktivitas mengancam keamanan dan stabilitas Yaman dan wilayah yang lebih luas. Hal ini menegaskan kembali dukungannya untuk upaya untuk memungkinkan pemerintah Yaman yang sah untuk melaksanakan tanggung jawab konstitusional, menjaga kesatuan negara, kedaulatan dan integritas teritorial, dan memenuhi aspirasi rakyat Yaman untuk keamanan, stabilitas, perdamaian dan pengembangan. Parlemen Arab menekankan bahwa solusi politik yang komprehensif tetap satu-satunya jalan untuk mengakhiri krisis Yaman.
articles.originalTitle: Arab Parliament welcomes UN resolution demanding immediate halt to Houthi attacks
articles.originalDescription: CAIRO — The Arab Parliament has welcomed UN Security Council Resolution 2837, which demands that the Houthi militia immediately halt its military escalation and attacks, including those targeting Saudi Arabia, civilians, commercial airports and international maritime transport. In a statement issued on Friday, the parliament said the resolution’s unanimous adoption reflects growing international recognition of the seriousness of Houthi activities and their implications for regional security, stability and freedom of international navigation. The parliament described the resolution as an important step toward unifying international opposition to the militia’s terrorist acts and continued violations. It stressed the need to translate international condemnations into decisive, practical measures to halt the attacks and hold those responsible accountable. The parliament also welcomed the extension of the sanctions regime imposed on entities linked to the Houthi militia, to prevent activities threatening the security and stability of Yemen and the wider region. It reaffirmed its support for efforts to enable Yemen’s legitimate government to exercise its constitutional responsibilities, preserve the country’s unity, sovereignty and territorial integrity, and fulfill the Yemeni people’s aspirations for security, stability, peace and development. The Arab Parliament stressed that a comprehensive political solution remains the only path to ending the Yemeni crisis.

articles.originalTitle: Trump says Saudi Arabia is 'disintegrating'
articles.originalDescription: Trump says Saudi Arabia is 'disintegrating' Submitted by MEE staff on Fri, 11/13/2026 - 16:08 US president says all the Gulf states have asked him not to attack Iran again because they are too vulnerable to a flare-up in the war Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman during a meeting in Cairo, on 15 September 2026 (Egyptian presidency/AFP) Off Saudi Arabia is “disintegrating”, US President Donald Trump said in an interview released on Friday, which is likely to offend the kingdom, as it suffers missile and drone strikes from Yemen’s Houthis. Trump passed judgment on Saudi Arabia, one of the US’s closest allies, in an interview with Stephen A Smith, boasting he could destroy Iran in three days by attacking civilian infrastructure but that Saudi Arabia and other Gulf states have asked him not to because of their own weaknesses. “If I want to take them out, I hit their [energy] in one day. Their energy is gone. In one day, their bridges are gone, and in one day, their manufacturing capability is gone. It would only take me three days, one day each,” Trump said. "Saudi Arabia has asked me to please just let it be the way it is now for a while because they're disintegrating," Trump said. "Qatar, if you look at that, Kuwait, UAE, Bahrain, all of them would much prefer the waiting period,” he added. This is not the first time Trump has appeared to enjoy bragging about the leverage he has over Gulf states and, particularly, Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman. Saudi Arabia has relied on the US as its security guarantor since WWII. “He (MBS) didn’t think this was going to happen… he didn’t think he’d be kissing my ass… he thought it’d be just another American president that was a loser… but now he has to be nice to me,” Trump said in March, when the war on Iran was in full swing. articles.title: Memimpin progresif suara pada Midest untuk menantang Chuck Schumer untuk kepemimpinan Senat
articles.description: Suara progresif dari Midest untuk menantang Chuck Schumer untuk pemimpin Senat Diserahkan oleh Yasmine El- Sabawi di Fri, 11 / 13 / 2026 - 15: 09 Chris Van Hollen, setidaknya, menempatkan tekanan pada Schumer untuk mengambil perubahan US Senator Chris Van Hollen (D-MD) berbicara selama forum pada Presiden Donald Van Hollen 's Decrypto decto decto, dengan senator Richard Blumenthal 27 Juli, yang akan mengumumkan pada RD Van Hollen memposting tentang niatnya mencari pos pada malam Rabu, waktu setempat, di Washington, DC. "Dalam pemilihan ini, orang Amerika meminta kami untuk melepaskan ekonomi yang dicurangi terhadap orang-orang pekerja dan didorong oleh korupsi politik. Untuk menyampaikan, kita perlu kepemimpinan baru. Ini bukan tentang satu orang - ini tentang menjawab panggilan itu," ia menulis pada X "Itu sebabnya aku mencalonkan diri sebagai Pemimpin Senat Mayoritas". Setelah hasil pemilu tengah semester yang menakjubkan pada 3 November yang membalik kedua rumah di Kongres dari merah ke biru, berkat progresif pesan dan kandidat di antara Demokrat, sebagian besar kelas mahasiswa sedang mencari perubahan kepemimpinan. Kunci di antara mereka adalah Michigan Senator - memilih Abdul El- Sayed, yang pertama kali melayang nama Van Hollen sebagai alternatif untuk Schumer, meskipun Van Hollen tidak memberikan indikasi ia tertarik. Van Hollen, 67 tahun terpilih di tahun yang sama Schumer menjadi pemimpin. Schumer, 75, sebagian besar telah dikreditkan dengan kecakapan penggalangan dananya, yang memungkinkan Demokrat untuk membalik keadaan yang belum melihat siapa pun kecuali Republik yang bertanggung jawab dalam beberapa dekade. Distributed by the Israeli healthcare provider Terem, the leaflets advertised vacancies in clinics in the West Bank settlements of Ma'ale Adumim, Beitar Illit and Modiin Illit, as well as Katzrin in the Golan Heights, which Britain recognises as occupied Syrian territory. articles.title: Perancis meminta lebih banyak tekanan pada Houthis untuk mengakhiri serangan di Arab Saudi
articles.description: Perancis meminta lebih banyak tekanan pada Houthis untuk mengakhiri serangan terhadap Arab Saudi Perancis menyerukan tekanan yang lebih besar pada Yemen Houthis untuk mengakhiri serangan mereka di wilayah tersebut, terutama terhadap Arab Saudi. "Posisi kami adalah bahwa perlu untuk meningkatkan tekanan pada Houthis sehingga mereka mengakhiri serangan dan provokasi yang tidak dapat diterima, terutama terhadap wilayah Saudi, tapi tidak hanya di sana," juru bicara untuk Kementerian Luar Negeri Perancis Pascal Confavreux menceritakan konferensi pers pada hari Jumat. Dia menanggapi pertanyaan apakah Paris mendukung ide Uni Eropa menunjuk Houthis sebagai organisasi teroris. Arab Saudi menekan Uni Eropa untuk membuat sebutan, tetapi belum mengatasi kekhawatiran Eropa bahwa hal itu bisa merusak proses perdamaian masa depan, Reuters melaporkan, mengutip enam pejabat Eropa. Juga pada hari Kamis, Dewan Keamanan PBB memilih dengan suara bulat untuk memperpanjang sanksi yang berhubungan dengan Yaman, termasuk ikatan aset dan perjalanan, untuk tahun lain, sementara menuntut mengakhiri serangan kelompok di Arab Saudi. Dewan Kerjasama Teluk (GCC) menyambut resolusi pada hari Jumat. "Resolusi ini merupakan langkah penting dalam mengkonsolidasikan sikap internasional yang menolak serangan Houthi yang berbahaya", GCC Sekretaris Jenderal Jasem Mohamed Albudaiwi mengatakan dalam sebuah pernyataan.
articles.originalTitle: France calls for more pressure on Houthis to end attacks on Saudi Arabia
articles.originalDescription: France calls for more pressure on Houthis to end attacks on Saudi Arabia France called for greater pressure on Yemen 's Houthis to end their attacks in the region, particularly against Saudi Arabia . "Our position is that it is necessary to increase pressure on the Houthis so that they put an end to their unacceptable attacks and provocations, particularly against Saudi territory, but not only there," spokesperson for the French foreign ministry Pascal Confavreux told a news conference on Friday. He was responding to a question on whether Paris backed the idea of the European Union designating the Houthis as a terrorist organisation. Saudi Arabia is pressing the EU to make the designation, but has yet to overcome European concerns that it could undermine a future peace process, Reuters reported, citing six European officials. Also on Thursday, the UN Security Council voted unanimously to extend Yemen-related sanctions, including asset freezes and travel bans, for another year, while demanding an end to the group's attacks on Saudi Arabia. The Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) welcomed the resolution on Friday. "This resolution represents a significant step in consolidating the international stance that rejects the treacherous Houthi attacks," GCC Secretary-General Jasem Mohamed Albudaiwi said in a statement.

Nine- month- tua Kinan Ahmed Raqqq ditemukan mati oleh ayahnya karena mereka berlindung di tenda di al- Mawasi daerah Khan Younis semalam. Ayah Raqiq Ahmed, berdiri menangis di luar rumah sakit Nasser, saat ia memegang tubuh anaknya yang terselubung. "Aku bangun hanya untuk melihat kulitnya telah berubah biru jadi aku bergegas dia ke Nasser Hospital, tapi dia sudah meninggal dari hipotermia dan beku sampai mati", katanya AFP. "Saya dalam shock lengkap. Aku mendapati diriku memegang anak saya dibungkus kain kafan pemakaman." Hujan lebat telah menyapu Gaza, menggabungkan ribuan tenda di mana sebagian besar populasi enclave dipaksa untuk berlindung di antara pembatasan Israel yang sedang berlangsung pada bantuan memasuki wilayah tersebut. Saat suhu menurun pada hari Kamis, serangan Israel di seluruh Gaza melonjak, dengan petugas kesehatan menempatkan total korban orang yang tewas sejak pagi pukul 11. Sehari sebelum kematian Raqq bayi, dua drone Israel merobek melalui yang sama departemen bedah rumah sakit, membunuh enam orang, termasuk dokter bedah dan anak-anak dan terluka sekitar 30 lainnya. Seorang jurnalis AFP yang berada di TKP melaporkan bahwa salah satu tangga luar gedung telah sebagian runtuh dan bahwa dalam ruangan seluruh lantai rusak, dengan beton rusak dari dinding runtuh dicampur dengan peralatan medis

articles.title: Turki dan Qatar tanda perjanjian pertahanan bersama
articles.description: Turki dan Qatar tanda perjanjian pertahanan bersama Diberikan oleh staf MEE pada Fri, 11 / 13 / 2026 - 15: 49 Pengumuman oleh presiden Turki adalah yang terbaru dalam serangkaian perjanjian pertahanan antara Timur Tengah dan Islam menyatakan Presiden Turki Reyep Tayyip Erdogan yang digambarkan dengan Emir, Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad al- Thani selama upacara penyambutan di kompleks presiden Ankara, 8 Agustus 2024 (Mugat Cetin Muhurdar / Turki kantor pers) Off Turki dan Qatar telah menandatangani perjanjian pertahanan bersama di Istanbul, dalam perjanjian terakhir antara negara-negara Islam dan militer. Perjanjian pertahanan adalah satu dari lima setuju antara Turki dan Qatar, sebagaimana Presiden Reep Tayyip Erdogan memimpin Emir dari Qatar, Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani. Pernyataan dari kantor presiden Turki mengatakan bahwa perjanjian pertahanan bersama Jumat dengan Qatar akan menambah dimensi lain untuk persaudaraan kita ". Erdogan mengatakan kerjasama Turki dan Qatar dalam industri pertahanan akan terus tumbuh, menurut pernyataan. Turki dan Qatar telah memiliki beberapa perjanjian pertahanan sejak 2017, termasuk tuan rumah pasukan Turki di Doha, tetapi kesepakatan baru mengharuskan kedua negara untuk datang ke pertahanan yang lain. Pada bulan Agustus tahun ini, Turki menandatangani perjanjian pertahanan dengan Arab Saudi dan Pakistan, dikenal sebagai Perjanjian Mekah. Minggu lalu, parlemen Turki lulus hukum menyetujui perjanjian pertahanan Mekah awal pada hari Jumat, menyelesaikan tahap penting dalam proses hukum. Gerakan ini akan memungkinkan penyebaran pasukan Turki ke Arab Saudi, yang saat ini berperang dengan Perumahan Yaman. Pada bulan Oktober, Menteri Luar Negeri Turki Hakan Fidan mengatakan bahwa setiap penyebaran ke Arab Saudi akan defensif di alam dan bahwa pasukan Turki tidak akan beroperasi di Yaman. articles.originalTitle: Turkey and Qatar sign mutual defence agreement
articles.originalDescription: Turkey and Qatar sign mutual defence agreement Submitted by MEE staff on Fri, 11/13/2026 - 15:49 Announcement by Turkish presidency is the latest in a series of defence agreements amongst Middle Eastern and Islamic states Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan pictured with Qatar's Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad al-Thani during a welcoming ceremony at the presidential complex in Ankara, 8 August 2024 (Murat Cetin Muhurdar/Turkish presidential press office/AFP) Off Turkey and Qatar have signed a mutual defence agreement in Istanbul on Friday, in what is the latest military pact between Ankara and other Muslim states. The defence agreement was one of five agreed between Turkey and Qatar, as President Recep Tayyip Erdogan hosted the Emir of Qatar, Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani. A statement by the Turkish president's office said that Friday's mutual defence agreement with Qatar "would add another dimension to our brotherhood". Erdogan said Turkey and Qatar’s cooperation in the defence industry would continue to grow, according to the statement. Turkey and Qatar have had several defence agrements since 2017, including the hosting of Turkish troops in Doha, but the new deal obliged both countries to come to the other's defence. In August this year, Turkey signed a defence pact with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan , known as the Mecca Agreement. Last week, the Turkish parliament passed a law approving the Mecca defence pact early on Friday, completing a crucial stage in the legal process. The move will allow the deployment of Turkish troops to Saudi Arabia, which is currently at war with Yemen's Houthis. In October, Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan said that any deployment to Saudi Arabia would be defensive in nature and that Turkish forces would not operate in Yemen. articles.originalDescription: Art against erasure: A Palestinian sculptor and a Lebanese painter on war, exile and memory Submitted by Victoria Brittain on Fri, 11/13/2026 - 12:11 Abdul Rahman Katanani and Ayman Baalbaki, close as brothers, have spent decades turning the violence of their youth into work shown in museums and collections worldwide Abdul Rahman Katanani in his studio outside Beirut (Victoria Brittain/MEE) Off The large studios of Abdul Rahman Katanani and Ayman Baalbaki are filled with canvases and installations about memory and destruction, drawn from the Israeli wars that shaped both artists’ youth. These magical spaces, one in an anonymous building in busy central Beirut, and the other far from the city in a village high in the hills, speak for Lebanon and Palestine . They also define the two artists and their families. Katanani’s materials are barbed wire, corrugated metal sheets, olive branches, petroleum barrels and discarded clothes from his birthplace, the Sabra and Shatila refugee camp. “I’ve always wanted to use the materials of the camp. These materials are our shadows. No... they’re us,” he told Middle East Eye. The harsh materials yield startling lyrical shapes, such as a nine-metre wave in barbed wire, a child playing, a lotus flower and a bright early collage of clothes, including the unexpectedly intimate detail of underwear. Once, he built a replica of the Palestinian camp of his childhood, shown inside an art gallery. Ayman Baalbaki in his studio (Victoria Brittain/MEE) Baalbaki’s very large mixed-media paintings are distinctive. They feature multiple thick layers of paint, often acrylic, in both intense and subtle colours. Many form part of a mesmerising series. One such series, Destruction and Loss , depicts the ruin of Beirut’s iconic buildings, like his 2015-16 iconic painting of the Barakat Building on the corner of Damascus Road on the Green Line of the 15-year-long civil war. articles.title: Dua orang Palestina dibunuh oleh api Israel di pusat Gaza, sumber rumah sakit mengatakan
articles.description: Dua orang Palestina dibunuh oleh api Israel di pusat Gaza, sumber rumah sakit mengatakan dua orang Palestina dibunuh oleh api Israel di timur Deir-Balah di pusat Gaza, menurut sumber-sumber di Rumah Sakit Al- Aqsa Martir, Al Jazeera dilaporkan. Pembunuhan itu terjadi sejak 7 Oktober 2023 telah meningkat menjadi setidaknya 74.653, menurut sumber medis Palestina yang dikutip oleh agen berita Wafa pada hari Rabu. Krisis kemanusiaan telah memburuk karena pembatasan Israel pada bantuan. Tim negara kemanusiaan PBB mengatakan pada hari Jumat bahwa Israel terus menghalangi masuk persediaan penting, termasuk tenda, selimut, pompa dan peralatan musim dingin lainnya. Hujan lebat selama seminggu terakhir telah membanjiri ribuan tenda pengungsi Palestina, sementara PBB mengatakan lebih dari 106.000 orang telah langsung terpengaruh.
articles.originalTitle: Two Palestinians killed by Israeli fire in central Gaza, hospital sources say
articles.originalDescription: Two Palestinians killed by Israeli fire in central Gaza, hospital sources say Two Palestinians were killed by Israeli fire east of Deir el-Balah in central Gaza, according to sources at Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital, Al Jazeera reported. The killings come as Gaza’s death toll since 7 October 2023 has risen to at least 74,653, according to Palestinian medical sources cited by Wafa news agency on Wednesday. The humanitarian crisis has worsened because of Israeli restrictions on aid. The UN’s humanitarian country team said on Friday that Israel continues to obstruct the entry of essential supplies, including tents, blankets, pumps and other winter equipment. Heavy rains over the past week have flooded thousands of tents sheltering displaced Palestinians, while the UN said more than 106,000 people had been directly affected.

Dalam hukum agama Yahudi, rodef adalah seseorang yang menimbulkan ancaman bagi kehidupan orang lain dan mungkin dihentikan dengan cara apapun yang diperlukan. articles.originalTitle: Senior Chabad rabbi condones killing Jewish politicians who work with Arabs
articles.originalDescription: Senior Chabad rabbi condones killing Jewish politicians who work with Arabs Submitted by MEE staff on Fri, 11/13/2026 - 14:22 Chabad-Lubavitch Hasidic movement distances itself from Gedalia Axelrod's 'personal opinion' Rabbi Gedalia Axelrod (YouTube screengrab) Off A senior Chabad rabbi has been criticised by his own movement after he said it was permissible to kill Jewish Israeli politicians who worked with Arabs. Gedalia Axelrod, a senior cleric in the Chabad-Lubavitch Hasidic movement, issued a halakhic ruling earlier this week in which he said that Jewish politicians who form a government backed by Palestinian citizens of Israel were "din rodef", which roughly translates as "law of the pursuer". Under Jewish religious law, a rodef is someone who poses a threat to another person's life and may be stopped by any means necessary. The doctrine was previously invoked by Yitzhak Rabin’s assassin, Yigal Amir, to justify the prime minister’s killing in 1995. Axelrod wrote that collaboration with Arab parties "poses a terrible danger to the people of Israel in the Holy Land and around the world". Collaboration could either take the form of inviting Arab parties to join a governing coalition, or even relying on their support from outside it. Swift condemnation Axelrod's comments were swiftly condemned by the leadership of his religious movement, with Chabad spokesperson Rabbi Shimi Segal clarifying that his statements did not represent the official Chabad position. “Chabad’s official halachic positions are determined exclusively by the Chabad Rabbinical Court, in accordance with the Rebbe’s instructions,” he said. The changing face of Israel’s ultra-Orthodox politics Read More » “Rabbi Axelrod is not a member of the court and does not hold a leadership position in Chabad. His statements and letters reflect his personal views alone.” Despite the disavowal, at least one Chabad website has described Axelrod as "among the most important Chabad rabbis in the Holy Land". Thunberg, who addressed a packed press conference on Thursday alongside activists from Nepal, Australia, Palestine and Canada, called on Ankara to “stop the transfer of oil and energy from its territory to Israel”, which she said is “directly fuelling the genocide of Palestine”. Her comments came shortly after Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan declared in his opening address to the conference that Gaza has suffered "not only a genocide but also an ecocide", and called for the immediate entry of aid into the war-torn enclave. Minister of environment and COP31 president, Murat Kurum, told Turkish media earlier this week that Turkey did not invite Israel’s leaders to participate at the summit due to the mass killings of Palestinians in Gaza. The campaign group Energy Embargo for Palestine (EFFP) told Middle East Eye that while they welcomed these statements and actions, an "uncomfortable contradiction still follows Türkiye throughout COP". articles.description: Kelompok hak-hak Palestina mengatakan Israel melarang sutradaranya dari perjalanan ke luar negeri Israel melarang Shawan Jabarin, direktur umum kelompok hak asasi manusia Palestina Al- Haq, dari perjalanan ke Yordania setelah menghentikan dia di Jembatan Allenby persimpangan pada hari Jumat, organisasi mengatakan. Dalam sebuah pernyataan, Al- Haq mengatakan pasukan Israel mempertanyakan Jabarin tentang tujuan perjalanannya sebelum memberitahunya bahwa dia dilarang bepergian. Organisasi mengatakan pembatasan secara politis termotivasi dan terkait dengan hak asasi manusia advokasi. Al- Haq mengatakan Jabarin sebelumnya menghadapi pembatasan perjalanan dan ancaman atas karyanya. Ini mengutip panggilan peringatan 2022 dari Shin Bet Israel dan mengatakan larangan perjalanan yang diberlakukan pada tahun 2006 tetap berlaku selama enam tahun sebelum diangkat sementara di 2012. Organisasi mengatakan ia juga telah dicegah dari perjalanan ke Belanda pada tahun 2009 untuk menerima penghargaan HAM. articles.originalTitle: Palestinian rights group says Israel barred its director from travelling abroad
articles.originalDescription: Palestinian rights group says Israel barred its director from travelling abroad Israel barred Shawan Jabarin, the general director of Palestinian human rights group Al-Haq, from travelling to Jordan after stopping him at the Allenby Bridge crossing on Friday, the organisation said. In a statement, Al-Haq said Israeli forces questioned Jabarin about the purpose of his journey before informing him that he was banned from travelling. The organisation said the restriction were politically motivated and linked to his human rights advocacy. Al-Haq said Jabarin had previously faced travel restrictions and threats over his work. It cited a 2022 warning call from Israel’s Shin Bet and said a travel ban imposed in 2006 remained in force for six years before being temporarily lifted in 2012. Dalam pernyataan yang dikeluarkan pada hari Kamis, Departemen Luar Negeri Jordan mengutuk serangan yang terus-menerus, yang baru-baru ini melibatkan peluncuran dua rudal balistik menuju wilayah Hindia, bersama dengan rudal dan drone diarahkan di Riyadh dan daerah lainnya di Kingdom. Departemen ini menggambarkan serangan sebagai pelanggaran hukum Saudi, hukum internasional dan Piagam PBB, menegaskan kembali penolakan Jordan atas serangan terhadap warga sipil, sipil, dan infrastruktur ekonomi. Jordan juga menegaskan solidaritas penuh dengan Arab Saudi dan mendukung keamanan, stabilitas, kedaulatan, aset nasional, warga negara dan warga. Sementara itu, Liga Arab sangat mengutuk peluncuran rudal balistik, meluncurkan rudal dan drone menuju Mekah, Riyadh dan Arab Saudi bagian timur dan selatan, menggambarkan serangan sebagai eskalasi berbahaya mengancam keamanan Kerajaan dan kehidupan sipil. Organisasi ini menekankan bahwa menargetkan wilayah Saudi, terutama daerah perumahan Islam situs suci, melanggar kedaulatan dan integritas teritorial Kingdom, hukum internasional dan Piagam PBB, sementara melanggar kesucian situs agama dan memprovokasi Muslim di seluruh dunia. articles.originalTitle: Jordan, Egypt, Kuwait, Bahrain and Arab League condemn Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Jordan, Egypt, Kuwait, Bahrain and the Arab League have strongly condemned the terrorist Houthi militia’s continued missile and drone attacks on Saudi Arabia, reaffirming their solidarity with the Kingdom and support for measures taken to protect its security and sovereignty. In a statement issued on Thursday, Jordan’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs condemned the continued attacks, most recently involving the launch of two ballistic missiles toward the Makkah region, along with missiles and drones directed at Riyadh and other areas of the Kingdom. The ministry described the attacks as flagrant violations of Saudi sovereignty, international law and the UN Charter, reaffirming Jordan’s rejection of attacks targeting civilians and civilian and economic infrastructure. Jordan also reiterated its full solidarity with Saudi Arabia and support for measures taken to protect its security, stability, sovereignty, national assets, citizens and residents. Meanwhile, the Arab League strongly condemned the launch of ballistic missiles, cruise missiles and drones toward Makkah,Riyadh and Saudi Arabia’s eastern and southern regions, describing the attacks as a dangerous escalation threatening the Kingdom’s security and civilian lives. The organization stressed that targeting Saudi territory, particularly areas housing Islamic holy sites, violates the Kingdom’s sovereignty and territorial integrity, international law and the UN Charter, while infringing upon the sanctity of religious sites and provoking Muslims worldwide. The Arab League praised the effectiveness of Saudi air defenses in intercepting and thwarting the attacks and reaffirmed its support for the Kingdom’s legitimate measures to protect its territory, citizens and residents. articles.title: Eksklusif: Toyota meninjau penggunaan forklift oleh militer Israel setelah penyelidikan MEE
articles.description: Exclusive: Toyota meninjau penggunaan forklift oleh militer Israel setelah penyelidikan MeE Diserahkan oleh Sebastian Shehadi di Wed, 11 / 2026 - 15: 16 Manufaktur meninjau apakah 'sipil-use' clause dilanggar setelah MEE mengungkap kontrak kementrian pertahanan Israel dan menggunakan forklift di situs amunisi dan basis tentara Sebuah gambar Toyota forklift di pusat rudal dan amunisi di Israel Utara, seperti yang diposting di rekening media sosial militer Israel pada tanggal 7 Juli. (Facebook) Pada Toyota mengatakan hal ini sedang menyelidiki penggunaan forklift-nya oleh militer Israel setelah Mata Timur Tengah menemukan foto-foto dan video-foto kendaraan di lokasi penyimpanan senjata dan amunisi, yang melayani persediaan untuk unit garis depan, dan digunakan oleh Korps Logistik Angkatan Darat. Ini datang setelah MeE menemukan rincian sebelumnya yang belum dilaporkan 158m- shekel ($49.8m) kontrak antara Toyota dan Departemen Pertahanan Israel untuk persediaan forklift yang ditandatangani pada tahun pertama perang Gaza. Toyota mengatakan bahwa kendaraan tidak dimaksudkan untuk penggunaan militer. Ketika ditanya tentang kontrak, perusahaan mengatakan kepada MEE itu memiliki komitmen di tempat dengan baik menteri pertahanan dan pejabat reseller di Israel untuk memastikan bahwa teknologi dan produk adalah "untuk penggunaan sipil saja". Tapi ketika MeE kemudian menyebarkan rekaman resmi media sosial Israel, yang menunjukkan Toyota forklift digunakan di lokasi termasuk gudang rudal dan amunisi di Israel utara, basis pelatihan Logistik Corps, dan di dalam pabrik amunisi, katanya itu menyelidiki gambar-gambar untuk menentukan apakah perjanjian tersebut telah dilanggar. Toyota adalah perusahaan Jepang tapi bisnis utama forklift, Toyota Material Handling, bermarkas di Amerika Serikat. "Meskipun tidak mungkin untuk setiap pembuat kendaraan untuk melacak kendaraan yang mungkin telah dibeli dan dijual kembali oleh perantara, kami meninjau foto-foto dan video-video ini dan menyeli
articles.originalTitle: Exclusive: Toyota reviewing use of forklifts by Israeli military after MEE investigation
articles.originalDescription: Exclusive: Toyota reviewing use of forklifts by Israeli military after MEE investigation Submitted by Sebastian Shehadi on Wed, 11/11/2026 - 15:16 Manufacturer reviewing whether 'civil-use' clause breached after MEE uncovers Israeli defence ministry contract and use of forklifts at munitions sites and army bases An image of a Toyota forklift at a missiles and ammunition centre in northern Israel, as posted on Israeli military social media accounts on 7 July. (Facebook) On Toyota has said it is investigating the use of its forklifts by the Israeli military after Middle East Eye found photos and videos of the vehicles at weapons and munitions storage sites, serving supply lines for frontline units, and being used by the army’s Logistics Corps. It comes after MEE uncovered details of a previously unreported 158m-shekel ($49.8m) contract between Toyota and Israel’s Ministry of Defense for the supply of forklifts that was signed in 2024 – the first full year of the Gaza war . Toyota says that its vehicles are not intended for military use. When asked about the contract, the company told MEE it had commitments in place with both the defence ministry and its official reseller in Israel to ensure that its technology and products were “for civil use only”. But when MEE then shared footage posted on official Israeli military social media channels, which showed Toyota forklifts being used at locations including a missiles and ammunition depot in northern Israel, a Logistics Corps training base, and inside a munitions factory, it said it was investigating the images to determine whether those agreements had been breached. Toyota is a Japanese corporation but its main forklift business, Toyota Material Handling, is headquartered in the United States . "While it is impossible for any vehicle maker to track vehicles that may have been bought and resold by intermediaries, we are reviewing these photos and videos and are investigating whether our use agreements have been violated,"

articles.title: Pasukan Israel membunuh Palestina di Gaza, merampok rumah di Tepi Barat
articles.description: Pasukan Israel membunuh Palestina di Gaza, menyerbu rumah-rumah di wilayah West Bank A Palestina telah dibunuh oleh tembakan orang Israel di lingkungan Tuffah, sebelah timur kota Gaza, rumah sakit di Shifa telah memberitahu Al Jazeera. Pasukan Israel juga menyerbu beberapa daerah di Nablus dan mencari rumah di kota-kota terdekat Beit Furik dan Beit Dajan, timur kota, Wafa melaporkan. Citing sumber keamanan, agen berita Palestina mengatakan tentara menyerbu daerah gunung utara, Perumahan Popular, Perumahan Austria dan kamp Old Askar di Nablus, memasuki rumah dan merusak isinya.

articles.originalDescription: Israeli forces kill Palestinian in Gaza, raid homes in occupied West Bank A Palestinian has been killed by Israeli gunfire in the Tuffah neighbourhood, east of Gaza City, al-Shifa Hospital has told Al Jazeera. Israeli forces also stormed several neighbourhoods in Nablus and searched homes in the nearby towns of Beit Furik and Beit Dajan, east of the city, Wafa reported. Citing security sources, the Palestinian news agency said soldiers raided the northern mountain area, Popular Housing, Austrian Housing and the Old Askar camp in Nablus, entering homes and tampering with their contents.

articles.title: Perusahaan Israel terkait dengan pembantaian Gaza menuju ke India untuk puncak teknologi
articles.description: Perusahaan-perusahaan Israel terkait dengan genosida Gaza untuk menuju ke India untuk puncak teknologi yang disetujui oleh Azad Essa di Wed, 11 / 2026 - 08: 41 Pasokan drone, sensor militer, dan teknologi pengawasan berada di antara 45 perusahaan Israel yang diharapkan terjadi di Hyderabad dan Bengaluru Seorang tentara Israel mengambil posisi di pos pemeriksaan di Israel - 08: 41 Pasokan Barat, 23 Oktober 2026 (Ahmad Gharabagal) Beberapa perusahaan Israel yang telah digunakan dalam kapal-kapal militer tersebut dalam bulan ini menuju ke India tengah menuju ke tengah. Dua puluh perusahaan Israel diharapkan untuk menghadiri sebuah acara startup di Hyderabad, Telangana, pada 16 November, diselenggarakan oleh T-Hub, yang menggambarkan dirinya sebagai "pusat startup terbesar di dunia", mendukung pendiri melalui program, kemitraan dan akses ke pasar global. 25 perusahaan Israel lebih lanjut diharapkan pada Konferensi Teknologi Bengaluru, ditagih sebagai platform perdana Asia untuk teknologi, perdagangan dan inovasi, yang berjalan dari 17 sampai 19 November. Perusahaan-perusahaan termasuk XTEND, yang drone-nya telah dikerahkan oleh pasukan Israel di Gaza, termasuk yang diduga digunakan untuk melacak dan merekam pembunuhan pemimpin Hamas Yahya Sinwar pada 16 Oktober 2024. Juga hadir di Dagan-Optik, pemasok peralatan untuk unit militer Israel, dan Netzer Precision, yang sensornya dimasukkan ke dalam tank Israel dan kapal induk lapis baja. Puncak dimaksudkan untuk memberikan kesempatan untuk kolaborasi teknologi dan kemitraan komersial antara perusahaan teknologi Israel dan perusahaan lokal. Analisis MEE perusahaan yang dijadwalkan untuk hadir telah menemukan bahwa beberapa secara langsung terlibat dalam operasi militer Israel di Gaza atau materi terhubung dengan militer yang lebih luas negara kompleks industri, termasuk infrastruktur pendudukan di West Bank. 'Polisi dan badan investigasi India membeli alat pengawasan dan forensik dari luar negeri lebih cepat daripada Parlemen
articles.originalTitle: Israeli companies linked to Gaza genocide to head to India for tech summits
articles.originalDescription: Israeli companies linked to Gaza genocide to head to India for tech summits Submitted by Azad Essa on Wed, 11/11/2026 - 08:41 Suppliers of drones, military sensors and surveillance technology are among 45 Israeli companies expected at events in Hyderabad and Bengaluru An Israeli soldier takes position at a checkpoint in the Israeli-occupied West Bank on 23 October 2026 (Ahmad Gharabali/AFP) Off Several Israeli firms whose military equipment has been used in the genocidal war on Gaza are heading to India later this month to explore partnerships with local firms, Middle East Eye can reveal. Twenty Israeli companies are expected to attend a start-up event in Hyderabad, Telangana, on 16 November, organised by T-Hub, which describes itself as "the world's largest startup hub", supporting founders through programmes, partnerships and access to global markets. A further 25 Israeli companies are expected at the Bengaluru Tech Summit, billed as Asia's premier platform for technology, commerce and innovation, which runs from 17 to 19 November. The companies include XTEND , whose drones have been deployed by Israeli forces in Gaza, including one allegedly used to track and film the killing of Hamas leader Yahya Sinwar on 16 October 2024. Also attending are Dagan-Optics, a supplier of equipment to Israeli military units, and Netzer Precision, whose sensors are incorporated into Israeli tanks and armoured personnel carriers. The summits are intended to provide opportunities for technological collaboration and commercial partnerships between Israeli tech companies and local firms. An MEE analysis of the companies scheduled to attend has found that several are either directly involved in Israel's military operations in Gaza or materially connected to the country's wider military-industrial complex, including its occupation infrastructure in the occupied West Bank. articles.title: Saudi, pejabat Cina mendiskusikan serangan Houthi, keamanan daerah dan navigasi maritim
articles.description: RIYADH - Menteri Luar Negeri Saudi Pangeran Faisal bin Farhan bertemu dengan Duta Khusus Cina untuk Timur Tengah Zhai Jun untuk mendiskusikan hubungan bilateral dan serangan Houthi yang sedang berlangsung menargetkan infrastruktur sipil dan sipil di Kerajaan. Selama pertemuan, dua pejabat tersebut meninjau hubungan Saudi- Cina dan implikasi dari serangan Houthi untuk keamanan daerah dan stabilitas. Mereka juga mendiskusikan perkembangan regional dan upaya diplomatik untuk menahan krisis dan ketegangan yang menurun. Kedua belah pihak menekankan pentingnya penguatan keamanan energi, menjaga stabilitas pasar dan menjaga koridor maritim dan kebebasan navigasi, terutama di Selat Hormuz dan Baja-Selat Mandeb, untuk memastikan aliran halus perdagangan global dan rantai pasokan. Pertemuan ini dihadiri oleh Wakil Menteri Luar Negeri untuk urusan politik Dr. Saud Al- Sati.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi, Chinese officials discuss Houthi attacks, regional security and maritime navigation
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan met with Chinese Special Envoy for Middle East Affairs Zhai Jun to discuss bilateral relations and ongoing Houthi attacks targeting civilians and civilian infrastructure in the Kingdom. During the meeting, the two officials reviewed Saudi-Chinese relations and the implications of the Houthi attacks for regional security and stability. They also discussed regional developments and diplomatic efforts to contain crises and de-escalate tensions. Both sides stressed the importance of strengthening energy security, maintaining market stability and safeguarding maritime corridors and freedom of navigation, particularly in the Strait of Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb Strait, to ensure the smooth flow of global trade and supply chains. The meeting was attended by Undersecretary of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for Political Affairs Dr. Saud Al-Sati.

articles.title: Arab Saudi menyampaikan belasungkawa kepada Türkiye atas kematian helikopter militer kecelakaan
articles.description: RIYADH - Arab Saudi telah memperpanjang belasungkawa tulus untuk Türkiye berikut jatuhnya helikopter militer selama operasi rutin. Dalam pernyataan yang dikeluarkan oleh Kementerian Luar Negeri pada hari Jumat, Arab Saudi menyampaikan belasungkawa dan simpati yang tulus kepada keluarga dari almarhum dan pemerintah dan rakyat Türkiye. Kerajaan juga menyatakan solidaritas Arab Saudi dengan keluarga korban dan pemerintah Turki dan orang-orang dalam masa sulit ini. Ini juga wishied keselamatan dan keamanan untuk semua.

In a statement issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Friday, the Saudi Arabia conveyed its sincerest condolences and sympathies to the families of the deceased and the government and people of Türkiye. The Kingdom also expressed Saudi Arabia’s solidarity with the victims’ families and the Turkish government and people during this difficult time. It also wishied safety and security for all.

articles.title: Arab Saudi menyatakan solidaritas dengan UAE setelah kecelakaan Fujairah membunuh 14, melukai 30
articles.description: RIYADH - Arab Saudi menyatakan solidaritas dengan Uni Emirat Arab setelah kecelakaan lalu lintas yang besar di Fujairah yang menewaskan 14 orang dan melukai 30 lainnya, kata Kementerian Luar Negeri. Dalam sebuah pernyataan, kementrian menyampaikan belasungkawa dan simpati yang tulus kepada pemimpin UAE, pemerintah dan rakyat, serta keluarga korban, dan berharap yang terluka cepat sembuh. Kecelakaan itu terjadi sebelum tengah malam di Sheikh Khalifa bin Zayed Road di pintu masuk ke Fujairah, ketika sebuah truk bertabrakan dengan beberapa kendaraan, memicu kebakaran yang menyebar ke beberapa mobil, menurut Polisi Fujairah. Kantor Pusat Polisi FFujairah mengatakan pengemudi truk kehilangan kendali kendaraan, menyebabkan bertabrakan dengan mobil lain sebelum menabrak dan menabrak beberapa kendaraan yang telah berhenti atau melambat karena kemacetan lalu lintas. Tabrakan memicu kebakaran di truk yang kemudian menyebar ke kendaraan lain, mengakibatkan kerugian signifikan kehidupan. Polisi mengatakan tim tanggap darurat, termasuk polisi, ambulans, penyelamatan dan personil pertahanan sipil, segera dikirim ke tempat kejadian setelah ruang operasi menerima laporan kecelakaan. Kru darurat memadamkan api, menyediakan pertolongan pertama dan mengangkut yang terluka ke rumah sakit, sementara polisi mengamankan TKP dan mengatur lalu lintas untuk memastikan keselamatan pengguna jalan lainnya. Pihak berwenang mengkonfirmasi bahwa 15 dari 30 orang yang terluka telah dikeluarkan dari rumah sakit setelah menerima perawatan medis, sedangkan 15 lainnya terus menerima perawatan medis. Polisi Fujairah mengatakan korban jiwa termasuk warga Emiri, sementara tim forensik sedang melakukan tes DNA untuk mengidentifikasi beberapa korban lainnya. Yang terluka termasuk warga negara UEE, Oman, India, Brasil, Pakistan, Yordania dan Mesir. Polisi menyatakan kesedihan mendalam atas tragedi dan belasungkawa panjang untuk keluarga mereka yang tewas, sementara berharap yang terluka pemulihan cepat. Piha
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia expresses solidarity with UAE after Fujairah crash kills 14, injures 30
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia expressed its solidarity with the United Arab Emirates following a major traffic accident in Fujairah that killed 14 people and injured 30 others, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs said. In a statement, the ministry extended the Kingdom’s sincere condolences and sympathy to the UAE’s leadership, government and people, as well as the families of the victims, and wished the injured a speedy recovery. The accident occurred shortly before midnight on Sheikh Khalifa bin Zayed Road at the entrance to Fujairah, when a truck collided with several vehicles, triggering a fire that spread to multiple cars, according to Fujairah Police. The Fujairah Police General Headquarters said the truck driver lost control of the vehicle, causing it to collide with another car before overturning and crashing into several vehicles that had stopped or slowed because of traffic congestion. The collision sparked a fire in the truck that subsequently spread to other vehicles, resulting in significant loss of life. Police said emergency response teams, including police, ambulance, rescue and civil defense personnel, were immediately dispatched to the scene after the operations room received a report of the accident. Emergency crews extinguished the fire, provided first aid and transported the injured to hospitals, while police secured the scene and managed traffic to ensure the safety of other road users. articles.originalDescription: How Gaza’s winter ‘crisis’ is manufactured by Israel For the fourth winter in a row, rains have swept through Gaza, exposing woefully inadequate supplies of materials for shelter entering the strip. This has forced 65 percent of the population - around 1.4m people - to shelter in makeshift shelters or tents which have been swamped in the downpour, or damaged buildings which risk collapse. While the weather is turbocharged by a strengthening El Nino event, the paucity of aid is entirely man-made, leveraged as a pressure point by Israel over Gaza’s population. The Israeli authorities have long restricted the entry of shelter and construction materials into Gaza, with vital equipment like tent poles and mobile homes deemed to be “dual use”. articles.title: Pro- Palestina kelompok berusaha melarang pada real estate Israel adil di Paris
articles.description: Grup Pro- Palestina berusaha melarang pameran real estate Israel di Paris Pro- Palestina aktivis telah meminta pengadilan Perancis untuk melarang pameran real estate Israel di Paris pemasaran pemukiman Israel di West Bank dan East Jerusalem, AFP melaporkan pada Kamis. Asosiasi NIDAL Franco- Palestina mengajukan mosi darurat dengan pengadilan melawan real estate ke-9 Icube dan salon investasi, menyatakan bahwa adil melanggar hak asasi manusia. Acara ini dijadwalkan hari Minggu di Eropa Pusat untuk Yudaisme di ibukota Perancis. Kota-kota besar lainnya telah melihat kegemparan serupa atas pameran real estate Israel. NIDAL meminta pengadilan untuk baik memesan kepala kepolisian Paris untuk melarang acara langsung atau untuk memastikan bahwa acara tidak menjual properti di West Bank dan Yerusalem Timur, yang pekerjaannya oleh Israel sejak 1967 dianggap ilegal di bawah hukum internasional. Sebelum mengambil tindakan hukum, kelompok mengatakan mereka telah mengirim surat kepada polisi Paris pada 5 November, yang tidak terjawab. Dalam pengajuan ini, terlihat oleh AFP, kelompok hak-hak mengatakan bahwa pemasaran pemukiman Israel di wilayah yang diduduki berkontribusi terhadap pemindahan paksa rakyat Palestina melalui transfer populasi - praktek yang dilarang oleh hukum internasional dan diklasifikasikan sebagai kejahatan perang di bawah kode pidana Perancis. Secara khusus, para aktivis menyoroti bahwa BH Nadlan, sebuah perusahaan yang menetap di Yerusalem Timur dan Tepi Barat, akan hadir di pameran. Mereka juga menunjukkan tawaran resmi sang pemandu dari bonus "keuangan" yang signifikan untuk pendatang baru yang menetap di "Yudea dan Samaria", istilah Israel untuk West Bank yang ditempati.
articles.originalTitle: Pro-Palestinian group seeks ban on Israeli real estate fair in Paris
articles.originalDescription: Pro-Palestinian group seeks ban on Israeli real estate fair in Paris Pro-Palestinian activists have asked a French court to ban an Israeli real estate fair in Paris marketing Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank and East Jerusalem, AFP reported on Thursday. The Franco-Palestinian NIDAL association filed an emergency motion with a court against the 9th Icube real estate and investment salon, arguing that the fair violates human rights. The event is scheduled for Sunday at the European Centre for Judaism in the French capital. Other major cities have seen similar uproars over Israeli real estate fairs. NIDAL asked the court to either order the head of the Paris police force to ban the event outright or to ensure that the event does not sell property in the West Bank and East Jerusalem, whose occupation by Israel since 1967 is considered illegal under international law. Before taking legal action, the group said they had sent a letter to the Paris police on 5 November, which went unanswered. In the filing, seen by AFP, the rights group says that marketing Israeli settlements in the occupied territories contributes to the forced displacement of the Palestinian people through population transfer - a practice prohibited by international law and classified as a war crime under the French penal code. In particular, the activists highlighted that BH Nadlan, a company that markets settlements in both East Jerusalem and the West Bank on its website, will be present at the fair. They also pointed to the fair's official guide's offer of a "significant" financial "bonus" for newcomers settling in "Judea and Samaria", the Israeli term for the occupied West Bank.

articles.originalTitle: Israeli settlers injure five Palestinians
articles.originalDescription: Israeli settlers injure five Palestinians Israeli settlers stormed Atara, a Palestinian village in the occupied West Bank and injured five people on Thursday, a rights group said. The attacks came after the Israeli military took down two outposts built by settlers without permission in the West Bank. More than 500,000 Israelis live in settlements across the West Bank, all of which are deemed illegal under international law, and some of which, known as outposts, are built without the Israeli government's involvement. "After Israeli military forces left the area, dozens of settlers, armed with clubs, tear gas and stones, stormed the village of Atara," the Israeli rights group Yesh Din said in a statement. "Five residents were injured and hospitalised, one in serious condition with a brain haemorrhage," Yesh Din added. The Palestinian Red Crescent said one of the injured people was 67 years old.

articles.title: Saudi- AS ikatan bisnis mendapatkan momentum dengan perjanjian kerjasama landmark
articles.description: WASHINGTON - Dewan Bisnis AS-Saudi dan Federasi Saudi Chambers telah menandatangani memorandum pemahaman (MoU) untuk memperkuat hubungan antara komunitas bisnis Arab Saudi dan Amerika Serikat. Perjanjian itu ditandatangani oleh Dewan Ketua dan CEO Charles Hallab dan Sekretaris Federasi Jenderal Sultan Al- Musallam. Upacara penandatanganan ini dihadiri oleh Asisten Sekretaris Jenderal untuk Perdagangan Internasional di Federasi Saudi Chambers Majid Al- Mutairi dan Presiden sektor Timur Tengah di Mayer Brown Company Tom Thraya di Washington, D.C. MoU membangun kerangka kerja untuk meningkatkan komunikasi antara perusahaan di dua negara, mengembangkan peluang investasi, dan mengatasi tantangan yang dihadapi bisnis di kedua pasar. Federasi dari Saudi Chambers sedang memainkan peran kunci dalam kemitraan sebagai badan perwakilan sektor swasta Saudi, memastikan bahwa perspektif sektor dan kebutuhan harus dipertimbangkan. Memorandum menetapkan mekanisme praktis untuk kerjasama antara dewan dan federasi, termasuk memfasilitasi kunjungan delegasi perdagangan dan komunikasi antara para pemimpin bisnis, mendukung investasi dan kemitraan strategis, bertukar informasi pasar dan keahlian, dan bekerja melalui saluran yang relevan untuk memfasilitasi perusahaan masuk ke kedua pasar dan mengatasi hambatan yang mereka hadapi. Sebuah kelompok pekerja gabungan akan mengawasi implementasi memorandum dan mengembangkan rencana aksi gabungan. Wakil senior dari kedua belah pihak akan bertemu setiap tiga bulan untuk menilai kemajuan, sektor prioritas dan kegiatan, mengatur jadwal, dan menetapkan tanggung jawab. Berbicara pada kesempatan itu, Hallab mengatakan bahwa Federasi dari Saudi Chambers adalah mitra kunci untuk dewan yang berhubungan dengan dan mendukung sektor swasta Saudi. "Kesepakatan ini memungkinkan Dewan dan Federasi untuk membawa perusahaan bersama-sama, bekerja terhadap tujuan yang sama, dan memperkuat hubungan perdagangan antara kedua negara kita. The Federation of Saudi Chambers is playing a key role in the partnership as the representative body of the Saudi private sector, ensuring that the sector’s perspectives and needs are duly considered. The memorandum sets out practical mechanisms for cooperation between the council and the federation, including facilitating trade delegation visits and communication between business leaders, supporting investments and strategic partnerships, exchanging market information and expertise, and working through relevant channels to facilitate companies’ entry into both markets and address the obstacles they encounter. A joint working group will supervise the implementation of the memorandum and develop a joint action plan. Senior representatives from both sides will meet every three months to assess progress, identify priority sectors and activities, set timelines, and assign responsibilities. articles.description: X menangguhkan rekening kampanye warga Palestina yang sedang berjalan untuk Senat AS, dikeluarkan oleh staf MEE pada Thu, 11 / 12 / 2026 - 18 Gaza- lahir dan Philepphia berbasis Ahmed Moor, meluncurkan tantangannya terhadap prof-Israel John Fetterman minggu ini Ahmed Moor, yang mencalonkan diri untuk kursi Pennsylvania di Senat AS pada tahun 2028, digambarkan dalam foto yang belum tertanggal dari situs kampanyenya (MoorForSente.com) Dari Amerika Palestina yang meluncurkan tawaran untuk kursi senat untuk mewakili Pennsylvania dalam pemilihan tahun 2028 telah membuat akun kampanyenya ditangguhkan oleh media sosial X. Akun tersebut, @ moorforpa, milik Gaza-born, Philepphia- mengangkat Ahmed Moor, yang mengatakan minggu ini ia ingin menggulingkan pro- garis keras Israel Senator John Fetterman ketika dia untuk kembali pemilihan dalam dua tahun. Fetterman belum mengumumkan apakah dia berencana untuk lari lagi. "Teman! Ini resmi! Kami adalah ancaman," Moor menulis di akun X pribadinya pada hari Rabu. "Mereka telah menghentikan rekening kampanye. Bantu kami mempertahankan momentum dengan me-retweet dan pertimbangkan mendonasikan". Akun kampanye memiliki lebih dari 33.000 pengikut dalam 72 jam peluncuran. Mata Timur Tengah telah menghubungi kampanye Moor. X tidak lagi mempertahankan akun email aktif untuk pertanyaan pers. 'Agenda martabat' Banyak dengan cara yang sama progressives berlari kampanye mereka di seluruh negeri dan berhasil membawa distrik mereka dalam pemilu paruh baya pada 3 November, menyebabkan terobosan bersejarah, slogan kampanye Moor adalah "Stop Funding Wars". Mulai Funding Pennsylvania "." Saya berlari untuk mengakhiri perang di Iran dan untuk mempromosikan agenda martabat: layanan kesehatan gratis, layanan anak gratis, dan perumahan terjangkau ", menulis di X pada hari Senin, ketika ia mengumumkan dijalankan. Help us maintain the momentum by retweeting and please consider donating." The campaign account had over 33,000 followers within some 72 hours of its launch. Middle East Eye has reached out to Moor's campaign. X no longer maintains an active email account for press inquiries. articles.title: Pemimpin Demokrat Amerika Serikat Hakeem Jeffries ingin 'perubahan dramatis' di Timur Tengah
articles.description: Pemimpin Demokrat Amerika Serikat Hakeem Jeffries ingin 'perubahan dramatis' di Rumah Perwakilan Demokrat Timur Tengah AS pemimpin DPR Hakeem Jeffries menyerukan Kamis untuk "perubahan dramatis" di Timur Tengah dan kembali dukungannya untuk dua-negara solusi untuk Israel dan Palestina. Partai Demokrat menyapu kemenangan dalam pemilihan paruh waktu minggu lalu bisa menyebabkan pembengkokan dukungan AS untuk sekutu dekatnya Israel, menempatkan sorotan pada pandangan para pemimpin partai karena mereka bersiap untuk mengambil alih kedua rumah Kongres pada 3 Januari. Jeffries, seorang Demokrat New York, diharapkan menjadi pembicara House berikutnya. "Status quo tidak dapat diterima, dan kita perlu perubahan dramatis. Dan itu terlihat seperti, sejauh yang saya ketahui, memastikan Anda memiliki Israel yang aman dan aman, hidup berdampingan sebagai Yahudi dan negara demokratis dengan negara Palestina independen yang menyediakan martabat dan tekad sendiri untuk Palestina", katanya pada konferensi pers mingguan.
articles.originalTitle: US House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries wants 'dramatic change' in Middle East
articles.originalDescription: US House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries wants 'dramatic change' in Middle East US House of Representatives Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries called on Thursday for "dramatic change" in the Middle East and reiterated his support for a two-state solution for Israelis and the Palestinians. The Democrats' sweeping victories in last week's midterm elections could lead to the curbing of US support for its close ally Israel, putting the spotlight on party leaders' views as they prepare to take control of both houses of Congress on 3 January. Jeffries, a New York Democrat, is expected to be the next House speaker. "The status quo is unacceptable, and we need dramatic change. And that looks like, as far as I'm concerned, making sure you have a safe and secure Israel, living side by side as a Jewish and democratic state with an independent Palestinian state that provides dignity and self-determination for the Palestinians," he said at a weekly press conference.

Questioned in parliament on Wednesday, Berendsen said diplomatic discussions were taking place but he would not specify whether proposals to shield heads of state and restrict the court's jurisdiction over nationals of non-member states were under consideration. The exchange followed a report by Dutch rights organisation The Rights Forum , citing anonymous diplomatic sources in New York, that the Netherlands was "negotiating" with the US changes to the court's founding treaty in response to US sanctions on the court and its top officials. Middle East Eye has previously reported similar US demands. articles.title: Arab Saudi, Kenya menandatangani perjanjian untuk mengatur perekrutan pekerja dalam negeri
articles.description: RIYADH - Wakil Menteri Sumber Daya Manusia dan Pengembangan Sosial untuk Tenaga Kerja Abdullah Abuthanain menerima Sekretaris Kabinet Kenya untuk Buruh dan Perlindungan Sosial Alfred Nganga Mutua di markas pelayanan di Riyadh pada hari Kamis. Beberapa pejabat menteri Saudi senior dan delegasi Kenyan menemani juga menghadiri pertemuan. Pertemuan ini membahas cara untuk memperkuat kerjasama antara Arab Saudi dan Kenya di bidang kepentingan bersama di sektor kerja paksa, terutama dengan mengembangkan mekanisme kerja sama untuk perekrutan pekerja dalam negeri, meningkatkan efektivitas pelatihan keberangkatan dan program kualifikasi, dan meningkatkan kesadaran hak-hak kontrak dan kewajiban. Upaya ini bertujuan untuk meningkatkan kesiapan para pekerja domestik, meningkatkan kualitas layanan perekrutan, mempromosikan stabilitas dalam hubungan kontrak, dan melindungi hak-hak semua pihak. Kedua pihak juga mendiskusikan mekanisme penguatan koordinasi teknis, pertukaran keahlian dan praktek terbaik dalam pelatihan dan kualifikasi, dan meningkatkan prosedur yang berkaitan dengan perekrutan pekerja domestik. Langkah-langkah ini bertujuan untuk meningkatkan efisiensi proses perekrutan, meningkatkan hasil mereka, dan melayani kepentingan bersama dari kedua negara. Setelah pertemuan tersebut, Abdullah Abuthnain dan Alfred Nganga Mutua menandatangani annex teknis untuk menyetujui perekrutan pekerja domestik antara Arab Saudi dan Kenya, ditandatangani pada 5 Juli 2026. Annex adalah bagian dari upaya untuk memperkuat kerjasama dan mengembangkan mekanisme teknis dan regulasi yang mengatur perekrutan pekerja domestik. Annex teknis bertujuan untuk prosedur tipis dan mengurangi biaya merekrut pekerja domestik dari Kenya ke Arab Saudi. Hal ini juga berusaha untuk meningkatkan efisiensi mekanisme perekrutan, memastikan kepatuhan dengan peraturan yang disetujui, melindungi hak-hak majikan dan pekerja dalam negeri, dan mengatur hubungan kontrak antara dua partai. articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia, Kenya sign deal to regulate recruitment of domestic workers
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Deputy Minister of Human Resources and Social Development for Labor Abdullah Abuthnain received Kenya’s Cabinet Secretary for Labour and Social Protection Alfred Nganga Mutua at the ministry’s headquarters in Riyadh on Thursday. Several senior Saudi ministry officials and the accompanying Kenyan delegation also attended the meeting. The meeting discussed ways to strengthen cooperation between Saudi Arabia and Kenya in areas of mutual interest in the labor sector, particularly by developing cooperation mechanisms for the recruitment of domestic workers, improving the effectiveness of pre-departure training and qualification programs, and raising awareness of contractual rights and obligations. These efforts aimed to enhance the readiness of domestic workers, improve the quality of recruitment services, promote stability in contractual relations, and protect the rights of all parties. The two sides also discussed mechanisms for strengthening technical coordination, exchanging expertise and best practices in training and qualification, and improving procedures related to the recruitment of domestic workers. These measures aimed to enhance the efficiency of recruitment processes, improve their outcomes, and serve the mutual interests of both countries. Following the meeting, Abdullah Abuthnain and Alfred Nganga Mutua signed a technical annex to the agreement on the recruitment of domestic workers between Saudi Arabia and Kenya, signed on July 5, 2026. The annex is part of efforts to strengthen cooperation and develop the technical and regulatory mechanisms governing the recruitment of domestic workers. The technical annex aims to streamline procedures and reduce the costs of recruiting domestic workers from Kenya to Saudi Arabia. It also seeks to improve the efficiency of recruitment mechanisms, ensure compliance with approved regulations, protect the rights of employers and domestic workers, and regulate the contractual relationship between the two parties. articles.title: 10 orang Palestina terbunuh sejak fajar
articles.description: 10 orang Palestina tewas sejak fajar Al Jazeera melaporkan bahwa 10 orang telah terbunuh dalam serangan Israel di seluruh Gaza sejak fajar, termasuk dua serangan terhadap rumah sakit yang menewaskan setidaknya tujuh orang. Sebuah serangan mematikan semalam di Nasser Medical Kompleks di Khan Younis membunuh enam orang, termasuk ahli bedah dan pasien, sementara setidaknya satu kematian dilaporkan setelah serangan terpisah dekat pintu masuk ke Rumah Sakit Gaza City al- Shifa. Al Jazeera mengatakan bahwa beberapa korban juga dilaporkan setelah pesawat tak berawak Israel menabrak kendaraan selatan Deir al- Balah di pusat Gaza. Sementara itu, agen berita Wafa melaporkan tiga kematian setelah enam awal serangan Rumah Sakit Nasser. Menurut laporan, Hossam Ali Saleha tewas dalam serangan menargetkan kendaraan di luar pintu masuk ke Rumah Sakit Alfa di Gaza City. Di Deir al- Balah, sebuah pesawat tak berawak Israel menabrak sebuah kendaraan di selatan kota, membunuh 26 tahun Nashat Fouad Awwad. Di Gaza Utara, orang Palestina lainnya terbunuh dan beberapa lainnya terluka akibat kebakaran Israel yang menargetkan sekelompok orang di dekat Jabalia di pemakaman Nazla.
articles.originalTitle: 10 Palestinians killed since dawn
articles.originalDescription: 10 Palestinians killed since dawn Al Jazeera reports that 10 people have been killed in Israeli attacks across Gaza since dawn, including two strikes on hospitals which killed at least seven people. A deadly overnight strike on the Nasser Medical Complex in Khan Younis killed six people, including surgeons and patients, while at least one death was reported after a separate attack near the entrance to Gaza City's al-Shifa Hospital. Al Jazeera said that multiple casualties were also reported after an Israeli drone struck a vehicle south of Deir al-Balah in central Gaza. Meanwhile, Wafa news agency reports three deaths following the initial six in the Nasser Hospital attack. According to the report, Hossam Ali Saleha was killed in a strike targeting a vehicle outside the entrance to al-Shifa Hospital in Gaza City. In Deir al-Balah, an Israeli drone struck a vehicle in the city's south, killing 26-year-old Nashat Fouad Awwad. In northern Gaza, another Palestinian was killed and several others wounded by Israeli fire targeting a group of people near Jabalia al-Nazla Cemetery.

Menurut berita Channel 12 Israel, pelecehan tersebut terjadi bulan lalu di pos militer Jalameh, setelah tentara Israel menangkap seorang pria Palestina di persimpangan terdekat. Para prajurit dilaporkan menemukan pisau kecil di mobilnya. Palestina kemudian dibebaskan tanpa biaya. According to Israel’s Channel 12 News , the abuse took place last month at the Jalameh military outpost, after Israeli soldiers arrested a Palestinian man at a nearby crossing. The soldiers reportedly found a small knife in his car. The Palestinian was later released without charge. The soldiers initially transferred him to the outpost handcuffed and blindfolded, where military police investigators suspect one of them began abusing him. An investigation by the Military Police Criminal Investigation Division was launched following complaints from other soldiers. Investigators suspect the soldier beat the Palestinian and extinguished a cigarette on his body, leaving him injured. The alleged abuse did not end there. According to the investigation, the soldier urinated on the detainee before smearing his own faeces on the man's face and urging him to eat it. Three soldiers were initially questioned, but two were later released, leaving one suspect in custody, Channel 12 reported. The soldier, who serves in Israel’s Paratroopers Brigade, has been detained for several weeks as military police prepare an indictment, which is expected to be filed in the coming days. He admitted beating the Palestinian man but denied the other allegations.
