articles.title: Sekolah Saudi memulai liburan musim gugur 10 hari di Nov 20
articles.description: RIYADH - Siswa di sekolah-sekolah umum di seluruh Arab Saudi sangat bersemangat mengantisipasi liburan 10 hari mendatang di 1448 AH kalender akademik, terdiri dari liburan musim gugur dan tambahan satu hari libur. Menurut kalender akademik, liburan akan dimulai pada hari Jumat, 20 November 2026, dan berlanjut sampai Minggu, November 29. Istirahat musim gugur akan berjalan dari Nov 20-28, diikuti oleh hari libur tambahan pada Nov 29. Siswa dijadwalkan untuk kembali ke kelas pada hari Senin, Nov 30, 2026, setelah 10 hari istirahat, dan melanjutkan kegiatan akademik mereka selama sisa semester.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi schools to begin 10-day autumn holiday on Nov. 20
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Students in public schools across Saudi Arabia are eagerly anticipating an upcoming 10-day holiday in the 1448 AH academic calendar, comprising the autumn break and an additional one-day holiday. According to the academic calendar, the holiday will begin on Friday, November 20, 2026, and continue through Sunday, Nov. 29. The autumn break will run from Nov. 20 to 28, followed by an additional day off on Nov. 29. Students are scheduled to return to classrooms on Monday, Nov. 30, 2026, following the 10-day break, and resume their academic activities for the remainder of the semester.

Partai-partai telah meminta otoritas kota apakah mereka dapat mencegah senjata yang dihasilkan di bawah perjanjian dari mencapai militer Israel dan apakah mereka dapat memblokir produksi lokal. Tilburg berbasis AIA membeli desain dan pengetahuan teknis - bagaimana dari IWI dan rencana untuk membuat senapan dan senapan mesin ringan di sebuah taman industri di kota. Kesepakatan itu mencakup senapan 5 infanteri Arad dan senapan mesin UX Negev. Produksi awalnya akan berlangsung di Tilburg sebelum pindah ke situs yang lebih besar di Overijssel, menurut penyiar Belanda Omroep Brabant. AIA mengatakan bahwa ia bermaksud untuk memasok negara-negara Eropa dan mitra Nato lainnya. Masih belum jelas apakah perusahaan juga bisa menjual senjata kepada Israel. articles.originalTitle: Six Dutch parties condemn local arms company’s deal with Israeli gunmaker
articles.originalDescription: Six Dutch parties condemn local arms company’s deal with Israeli gunmaker Submitted by Elis Gjevori on Thu, 11/12/2026 - 12:08 The dispute comes after Dutch MPs called for an end to dependence on Israel’s arms industry A visitor holds a weapon from Israel Weapon Industries at the Eurosatory international defence trade fair, in Villepinte, Paris, on 13 June 2022 (Emmanuel Dunand/AFP) Off Six political parties in the Dutch city of Tilburg have condemned a local arms company’s deal with Israeli gunmaker Israel Weapon Industries (IWI). The parties have asked the municipal authorities whether they can prevent weapons produced under the agreement from reaching Israel’s military and whether they can block local production. Tilburg-based AIA bought designs and technical know-how from IWI and plans to make rifles and light machine guns at an industrial park in the city. The agreement covers the Arad 5 infantry rifle and the Negev UX light machine gun. Production will initially take place in Tilburg before moving to a larger site in Overijssel, according to Dutch broadcaster Omroep Brabant . AIA says that it intends to supply European countries and other Nato partners. It remains unclear whether the company could also sell the weapons to Israel. D66, PRO, Denk, the Party for the Animals, the Socialist Party and VoorTilburg013 submitted questions to the municipal administration. Dia membuat komentar saat berbicara melalui konferensi video di Konferensi Global Markets BNP di London. articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Minister of Investment Fahad Al-Saif announced a 110 percent year-on-year increase in the number of licenses issued to foreign investors in the Kingdom. He also revealed that the number of regional headquarters established by global companies in Saudi Arabia has reached 780, underscoring the accelerating momentum in attracting international investments and further consolidating the Kingdom’s position as a premier destination for global companies and a regional business hub. He made the remarks while speaking via video conference at the BNP Paribas Global Markets Conference in London. The conference is a flagship annual event gathering hundreds of institutional investors, corporate executives, economists, and policymakers to discuss global markets, economics, geopolitics, and investment strategies. Al-Saif said foreign direct investment (FDI) inflows into the Kingdom surged by 33 percent in 2025, driven by growing investor confidence in the Saudi economy and the continued implementation of economic and legislative reforms designed to enhance the competitiveness of the investment environment. The minister noted that the Kingdom’s GDP has doubled over the past decade, while the Saudi economy recorded growth of 5.2 percent in the first half of 2026. This performance coincides with continued progress in achieving economic diversification objectives, strengthening financial sustainability, and maintaining fiscal balance. articles.originalTitle: Ireland: Watchdog accused of stalling probe into Microsoft hosting Israeli military app

"I'm calling on Microsoft to explain why it’s providing the Israeli government with the tools and technologies to sustain its system of apartheid – a system under which millions of Palestinians are being denied basic human rights." The complaint was submitted on behalf of a Palestinian resident of Gaza and the West Bank, as well as a European Union citizen, based on evidence provided by a whistleblower. articles.title: Warga Saudi ditangkap karena mengangkut 5 pelanggar di Jazan
articles.description: JAZAN - patroli keamanan dari Resimen Keamanan di Al- Aridah pemerintahan di daerah Jazan selatan menangkap seorang warga karena mengangkut lima individu yang melanggar Hukum Keamanan Perbatasan dalam kendaraan yang dia kendarai. Prosedur hukum dimulai terhadap semua orang yang ditangkap, dengan pelanggar yang disebut otoritas yang kompeten dan transporter ke Jaksa Umum. Badan Keamanan Dalam Negeri menyatakan kembali bahwa memfasilitasi pelanggar keamanan perbatasan ke Arab Saudi, mengangkut atau melindungi mereka, atau menyediakan mereka dengan segala bentuk bantuan membawa hukuman hingga 15 tahun penjara dan denda sampai dengan SR1 juta. Hukuman juga termasuk penyitaan kendaraan yang digunakan untuk transportasi dan penamaan publik. Agensi menekankan bahwa kejahatan dianggap sebagai pelanggaran besar. Hal ini mendorong publik untuk melaporkan pelanggaran residensi, tenaga kerja, dan peraturan keamanan perbatasan dengan memanggil 911 di daerah Mekah, Madinah, Riyadh, dan Provinsi Timur, atau 999 dan 996 di semua daerah lain. Semua laporan akan diperlakukan dengan kerahasiaan ketat, dan mereka yang melaporkan pelanggaran tidak akan menanggung kewajiban, lembaga ditambahkan.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi citizen arrested for transporting 5 violators in Jazan
articles.originalDescription: JAZAN — Security patrols from the Security Regiments in Al-Aridah governorate in the southern Jazan region arrested a citizen for transporting five individuals who violated the Border Security Law in a vehicle he was driving. Legal procedures were initiated against all the arrested persons, with the violators referred to the competent authority and the transporter to the Public Prosecution. The Ministry of Interior's Agency for Security Regiments Affairs reiterated that facilitating the entry of border security violators into Saudi Arabia, transporting or sheltering them, or providing them with any form of assistance carries penalties of up to 15 years in prison and a fine of up to SR1 million. Penalties also include confiscation of the vehicle used for transportation and public naming. The agency emphasized that the crime is considered as a major offense. It urged the public to report violations of residency, labor, and border security regulations by calling 911 in the regions of Makkah, Madinah, Riyadh, and Eastern Province, or 999 and 996 in all other regions. All reports will be treated with strict confidentiality, and those who report violations will bear no liability, the agency added.

articles.description: Israel menyerang Al- Shifa Hospital membunuh satu setelah enam tewas dalam serangan Nasser sebuah serangan Israel menargetkan Rumah Sakit Gaza-Shifa kota telah membunuh setidaknya satu Palestina dekat gerbang fasilitas, laporan Wafa. Serangan itu datang tak lama setelah sebuah rudal Israel menghancurkan rumah sakit South Gaza, membunuh enam orang, termasuk ahli bedah dan pasien. Wafa juga melaporkan, mengutip sumber-sumber lokal, bahwa pesawat Israel menyerang sekelompok orang Palestina di selatan Khan Younis, sementara yang lain dipecat menuju perahu nelayan di lepas pantai Gaza City juga kamp pengungsi Shati. Menurut laporan, sumber medis mengatakan bahwa total sembilan orang Palestina telah dibunuh oleh api Israel sejak fajar.
articles.originalTitle: Israeli strike on al-Shifa Hospital kills one after six killed in Nasser attack
articles.originalDescription: Israeli strike on al-Shifa Hospital kills one after six killed in Nasser attack An Israeli strike targeting Gaza City's al-Shifa Hospital has killed at least one Palestinian near the facility's gate, Wafa reports. The attack comes shortly after an Israeli missile tore through southern Gaza's Nasser Hospital, killing six people, including surgeons and patients. Wafa also reports, citing local sources, that an Israeli drone struck a group of Palestinians in south Khan Younis, while another was fired towards fishing boats off the coast of Gaza City's al-Shati refugee camp. According to the report, medical sources say that a total of nine Palestinians have been killed by Israeli fire since dawn.

articles.description: JEDDAH - Konferensi Haji dan Pameran keenam menyimpulkan di Jeddah Superdome pada hari Rabu setelah empat hari kegiatan, mengumpulkan lebih dari 520 entitas dari pemerintah, swasta, dan sektor nirlaba, dengan partisipasi dari lebih dari 150 negara. Acara ini diadakan di bawah perlindungan dari Penjaga Dua Masjid Suci Raja Salman, diselenggarakan oleh Kementerian Haji dan Umrah bekerjasama dengan Program Pengalaman Pilgrim, salah satu dari Saudi Vision 2030 program di Superdome Jeddah. Konferensi dan pameran, di bawah tema "Dari Mekah ke Dunia", menarik lebih dari 200.000 pengunjung dan melihat penandatanganan 2.553 perjanjian. * * media [2793647] * * Konferensi ini ditandai tonggak kunci dalam persiapan awal untuk musim haji 2027. Ini mengumpulkan kantor-kantor urusan haji, penyedia layanan, pemerintah, pribadi dan nirlaba, pembuat keputusan, wirausahawan, dan inovator untuk menyelesaikan persiapan dan kontrak, mendiskusikan kebutuhan operasional dan organisasi, dan solusi sekarang dan inisiatif meliputi berbagai tahap perjalanan ziarah. articles.originalTitle: Hajj Conference draws over 200,000 visitors, seals 2,553 agreements
articles.originalDescription: JEDDAH — The sixth Hajj Conference and Exhibition concluded at Jeddah Superdome on Wednesday after four days of activities, bringing together more than 520 entities from the government, private, and nonprofit sectors, with participation from more than 150 countries. The event, held under the patronage of Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman, was organized by the Ministry of Hajj and Umrah in cooperation with the Pilgrim Experience Program, one of the Saudi Vision 2030 programs at the Jeddah Superdome. The conference and exhibition, under the theme “From Makkah to the World,” attracted more than 200,000 visitors and saw the signing of 2,553 agreements. **media[2793647]** The conference marked a key milestone in early preparations for the 2027 Hajj season. It brought together Hajj affairs offices, service providers, government, private and nonprofit entities, decision-makers, entrepreneurs, and innovators to complete preparations and contracts, discuss operational and organizational needs, and present solutions and initiatives covering the various stages of the pilgrim journey. The conference’s scientific program featured 45 panel discussions with more than 460 speakers, alongside 71 specialized workshops attended by 3,500 trainees. The sessions and workshops covered three main areas: infrastructure and operational services; empowerment and synergy; and training and development. Related topics included transportation, logistics, accommodation, hospitality, catering, healthcare, media and communications, technology, innovation, entrepreneurship, training, and ways to enrich the pilgrim experience. **media[2793646]** The Hajj Talk was one of the conference’s dialogue platforms, hosting 47 sessions on operational and development issues related to the Hajj services system. articles.originalDescription: More than 50 British MPs demand fresh sanctions on Israel over Gaza aid obstruction Submitted by Imran Mulla on Thu, 11/12/2026 - 12:01 As storms batter Gaza, 150,000 tents in aid lorries remain stuck outside the Palestinian enclave Humanitarian aid trucks at the Rafah border crossing with the Gaza Strip on 4 February 2026 (AFP) Off More than 50 British MPs are supporting a parliamentary motion calling on their government to take "urgent action" on getting aid into Gaza and demanding fresh sanctions on Israel . The motion, which was tabled on Tuesday night by Labour MP Richard Burgon, notes "UN reports that tens of thousands of already displaced families have suffered damage to their shelters" in Gaza . It says this has "been made far worse by Israel's widespread destruction of homes, drainage systems and other essential infrastructure that have left most Palestinians in Gaza displaced". The motion further condemns "Israel's ongoing restrictions on the entry of humanitarian aid, including materials needed to provide shelter, respond to flooding, and aid reconstruction", as well as its "restrictions on bringing humanitarian supplies and international staff into Gaza". Some 65 percent of Gaza’s population, about 1.4 million people, live in tents or makeshift shelters, according to the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (Ocha). In the last week, torrential rainfall and deadly storms have flooded or destroyed tens of thousands of these tents. Israel continues to bar aid groups from bringing supplies and international staff into the territory. The Norwegian Refugee Council reported last month that Israeli authorities were allowing just 15 trucks carrying dual-use items into Gaza from Jordan once a week. Ramiz Alakbarov, the UN’s humanitarian coordinator for the occupied Palestinian territory, said this week that 150,000 tents in aid lorries were stuck outside Gaza, while stocks of essential shelter and winter items inside the enclave were exhausted. articles.description: Kami kehilangan pasien saya telah merawat ': Perawat Nasser berbicara tentang serangan' menakutkan 'Seorang perawat yang bekerja shift malam di departemen bedah Nasser Hospital ketika ditargetkan oleh serangan udara Israel telah mengatakan bahwa sejumlah pasien mereka merawat tewas dalam serangan itu. Dalam kesaksian yang dibagikan oleh LSM Medical Aid untuk Palestina (MAP), Muhammad Salman menggambarkan serangan terhadap rumah sakit, yang merupakan yang terbesar di Gaza Selatan, sebagai "mengerikan". "Saya melihat pasien terjebak di bawah reruntuhan dan rekan-rekan terluka. Kami kehilangan beberapa pasien saya telah merawat, termasuk setidaknya dua," katanya. "Ketakutan terbesar kami adalah untuk pasien. Kami segera mulai mencoba mengevakuasi mereka dan mendapatkan mereka untuk keselamatan, bekerja bersama tim Pertahanan Sipil dan memindahkan mereka kita bisa menyelamatkan ke departemen lain." Salman mengatakan seorang rekan, dokter bedah Dr Rizq Abu Shaeria, tewas saat dia memeriksa pasien. "Beberapa menit kemudian, semuanya berubah, dan kami kehilangan dia. Sangat menyakitkan kehilangan rekan yang hanya melakukan pekerjaannya dan mendedikasikan dirinya untuk merawat pasien", katanya. Dalam sebuah pernyataan, Kementerian Kesehatan Palestina melaporkan bahwa dua rudal menghantam lantai atas gedung Yassin rumah sakit, yang menampung departemen bedah, sekitar pukul 00: 39 waktu setempat, membunuh enam orang ahli bedah, pasien, dan anak-anak. Ini menambahkan bahwa salah satu rudal gagal meledakkan dan tetap di dalam gedung, berpose ancaman tambahan untuk pasien dan staf medis masih ada. articles.originalTitle: 'We lost patients I had been caring for': Nasser nurse speaks of 'terrifying' attack
articles.originalDescription: 'We lost patients I had been caring for': Nasser nurse speaks of 'terrifying' attack A nurse who was working a night shift at Nasser Hospital's surgical department when it was targeted by an Israeli air strike has said that a number of patients they were caring for were killed in the attack. In testimony shared by the NGO Medical Aid for Palestine (MAP), Mohammed Salman described the attack on the hospital, which is the largest in southern Gaza, as "terrifying". "I saw patients trapped under the rubble and colleagues injured. We lost some of the patients I had been caring for, including at least two," he said. "Our greatest fear was for the patients. We immediately started trying to evacuate them and get them to safety, working alongside Civil Defence teams and moving those we could rescue to another department." Salman said a colleague, surgeon Dr Rizq Abu Shaeria, was killed as he was checking on a patient. "A few minutes later, everything changed, and we lost him. It is incredibly painful to lose a colleague who was simply doing his job and dedicating himself to caring for patients," he said. In a statement, the Palestinian Ministry of Health reported that two missiles struck the upper floors of the hospital's Yassin building, which houses the surgical department, at around 00:39 local time, killing six – including surgeons, patients and a child. It added that one of the missiles failed to detonate and remains inside the building, posing an additional threat to patients and medical staff still there. Nasser Hospital is one of the few still able to provide care. According to the UN's OCHA, just 20 of the Strip's 37 hospitals remain partially functional and none are fully functional. The latest assault is the seventh time Israeli forces have targeted Nasser Hospital, according to MAP. articles.title: Arab Saudi menunda 10 Inisiatif Investasi Masa Depan hingga Oktober 2027
articles.description: RIYADH - Edisi ke-10 Inisiatif Investasi Masa Depan (FII10) telah dijadwalkan ulang hingga 25 Oktober 2027, di Riyadh, dari tanggal aslinya dari 26- 29 Oktober 2026, FII Institute diumumkan pada hari Kamis. Diadakan di bawah perlindungan dari Penjaga Dua Masjid Suci Raja Salman bin Abdullah, acara ini akan berlangsung di bawah tema "The Power of Legacy", menandai dekade dialog investasi global, kemitraan dan dampak sambil melihat ke depan sampai dekade berikutnya. * * Media [2793600] * FII Institut CEO Dr Maha bint Mishari menggambarkan edisi ke-10 sebagai tonggak makna global, menandai satu dekade untuk mengumpulkan para pemimpin dunia, investor dan pembuat-keputusan. Dia mengatakan keputusan untuk menunda acara sampai Oktober 2027 mencerminkan komitmen lembaga untuk memastikan tingkat tertinggi partisipasi internasional, kehadiran dan dampak. Lembaga ini akan melanjutkan keterlibatan global di depan FII10 melalui Konferensi PRIORITY FII di Miami, dijadwalkan untuk Maret 31- April 2, 2027, dan FII PRIORITY Asia 2027 Summit, yang tanggal dan lokasinya akan diumumkan nanti.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia postpones 10th Future Investment Initiative to October 2027
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The 10th edition of the Future Investment Initiative (FII10) has been rescheduled to October 25–28, 2027, in Riyadh, from its original dates of October 26–29, 2026, the FII Institute announced on Thursday. Held under the patronage of Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman bin Abdulaziz, the event will take place under the theme “The Power of Legacy,” marking a decade of global investment dialogue, partnerships and impact while looking ahead to the next decade. **media[2793600]** FII Institute CEO Princess Dr. Maha bint Mishari described the 10th edition as a milestone of global significance, marking a decade of bringing together world leaders, investors and decision-makers. She said the decision to postpone the event until October 2027 reflects the institute’s commitment to ensuring the highest levels of international participation, attendance and impact. The institute will continue its global engagement ahead of FII10 through the FII PRIORITY Summit in Miami, scheduled for March 31–April 2, 2027, and the FII PRIORITY Asia 2027 Summit, whose date and location will be announced later.

The Lewisham Islamic Centre in south-east London said it was seeking legal advice "on the most appropriate course of action" after the Charity Commission issued it a warning for hosting what it called "inflammatory, divisive" sermons. Imam Shakeel Begg gave a sermon in October 2023, during Israel's bombardment of Gaza, describing Palestinian "suffering at the hands of the oppressors and the Zionists". He also called the celebrities Justin Bieber and Kylie Jenner "sick" for their vocal support of Israel. The Islamic centre said in an official statement this week: "This is about more than one mosque or one charity. "It is about whether Muslim institutions can discharge their religious and charitable responsibilities without being penalised for expressing solidarity with Palestine, conducting established forms of Islamic worship, or addressing issues of concern to their congregations, including repudiation of Zionism, or denunciation of the Israeli state for war crimes and genocide." The centre added: "Solidarity with the oppressed must not become grounds for charitable sanction. "Should legal action be pursued, we would urge others to come forward and join a united challenge to an overbearing commission in defence of religious freedom." Berbicara di upacara penandatanganan pada sela-sela konferensi iklim PBB Cop31 di Antalya, Departemen Keuangan dan Menteri Keuangan Mehmet Simsek mengatakan tidak ada negara yang bisa membiayai transisi hijau saja. "Tidak ada anggaran negara dapat memenuhi kebutuhan investasi transformasi ini sendiri", katanya. "Itulah mengapa dukungan dari bank pengembangan multilateral sangat penting bagi kami". Perjanjian itu ditandatangani antara pelayanan dan Development Bank Asia (ADB), Bank Investasi Infrastruktur Asia (AIB), Bank Dunia dan Bank Pengembangan Islam (IDB). Simsek mengatakan Ankara telah melakukan pekerjaan rumah dengan benar-benar mempersiapkan proyek dan mengamankan pembiayaan yang diperlukan untuk mengimplementasikan mereka. Proyek-proyek, katanya, akan menciptakan lapangan kerja dan memperkuat perekonomian Turki. Dia menambahkan bahwa Turki telah dijamin sekitar $50bn dalam pembiayaan eksternal dari mitra pengembangan sejak 2023. Turki menandatangani perjanjian pinjaman pertamanya dengan ADB pada bulan November 2025, kata Simsek. articles.originalTitle: Cop31: Turkey signs $5.1bn loan deals to boost green transition
articles.originalDescription: Cop31: Turkey signs $5.1bn loan deals to boost green transition Submitted by Ragip Soylu on Thu, 11/12/2026 - 10:23 Deals with four multilateral development banks will support climate action, infrastructure resilience and small businesses The UN climate conference, Cop31, is taking place in Antalya, Turkey (Ozan Kose/AFP) Off Turkey signed 10 loan agreements worth $5.1bn with multilateral development banks on Thursday to accelerate its green transition. Speaking at the signing ceremony on the sidelines of the UN climate conference Cop31 in Antalya, Treasury and Finance Minister Mehmet Simsek said no country could finance the green transition alone. "No country's budget can meet the investment needs of this transformation on its own," he said. "That is why support from multilateral development banks is critically important to us." The agreements were signed between the ministry and the Asian Development Bank (ADB), the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB), the World Bank and the Islamic Development Bank (IsDB). Simsek said Ankara had done its homework by thoroughly preparing projects and securing the financing needed to implement them. The projects, he said, would create jobs and strengthen the Turkish economy. He added that Turkey had secured approximately $50bn in external financing from its development partners since 2023. Turkey signed its first loan agreement with the ADB in November 2025, Simsek said. articles.title: 160 kontestan untuk bergabung dengan Arab Saudi Al-Qur 'an dan kompetisi Sunnah di Mauritania
articles.description: RIYADH - Edisi kedua Custodian dari Kompetisi Dua Masjid Suci untuk Memanisasi Al-Qur 'an dan Nabi Sunnah untuk Negara Afrika Barat akan berlangsung di Nouakchott, Mauritania, dari 15 November sampai 19, 2026, membawa bersama 160 kontestan dari 16 negara. Diadakan dengan persetujuan dari Penjaga dari Dua Masjid Suci Raja Salman, kompetisi diatur oleh Saudi Arab Kementerian Urusan Islam, Dawah dan Bimbingan dalam kerjasama dengan Kementerian Urusan Islam Mauritania dan Pendidikan Asli. Menteri Urusan Islam, Dawah dan Bimbingan Sheikh Dr Abdullatif bin Abdullah Al Al- Sheikh menekankan bahwa melayani Al-Qur' an dan Sunnah telah menjadi prioritas misi Islam Saudi Arab sejak mendirikan. Dia mencatat bahwa Kerajaan terus mendukung kompetisi Qur 'anic, program pendidikan dan inisiatif jangkauan Islam baik domestik maupun internasional, memperkuat hubungan umat Islam dengan Al-Qur' an dan Sunnah sementara mempromosikan moderasi dan keseimbangan. Menteri menekankan bahwa inisiatif ini memperpanjang melampaui menghafal, bertujuan untuk memperkuat kesadaran agama, memelihara Muslim pada dasar-dasar yang sehat dan benar agama keyakinan, dan mendorong generasi muda untuk merangkul dan menerapkan ajaran Al Qur 'an dan Sunnah. Al Al- Sheikh mengucapkan terima kasih kepada Raja Salman dan Putra Mahkota Mohammed bin Salman atas dukungan mereka dari inisiatif didedikasikan untuk melestarikan, mengajar dan menyebarkan Al Qur' an dan Sunnah di seluruh dunia. Dia juga mengucapkan terima kasih kepada Kementerian Urusan Islam Mauritania dan Pendidikan Asli atas kerjasama dan usaha yang berkontribusi untuk keberhasilan edisi pertama kompetisi, serta koordinasi lanjutan dalam hosting kedua. Menteri memuji hubungan lama antara Arab Saudi dan Mauritania dan mereka terus kerjasama dalam pendidikan Islam dan jangkauan agama, menyoroti komitmen mereka bersama untuk melestarikan dan mempromosikan Al-Qur 'an dan Sunnah antara generasi muda.
articles.originalTitle: 160 contestants to join Saudi Qur’an and Sunnah competition in Mauritania
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The second edition of the Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques Competition for Memorization of the Holy Qur’an and the Prophet’s Sunnah for West African Countries will take place in Nouakchott, Mauritania, from November 15 to 19, 2026, bringing together 160 contestants from 16 countries. Held with the approval of Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman, the competition is organized by Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Islamic Affairs, Dawah and Guidance in cooperation with Mauritania’s Ministry of Islamic Affairs and Original Education. Minister of Islamic Affairs, Dawah and Guidance Sheikh Dr. Abdullatif bin Abdulaziz Al Al-Sheikh emphasized that serving the Qur’an and Sunnah has been a priority of Saudi Arabia’s Islamic mission since its founding. He noted that the Kingdom continues to support Qur’anic competitions, educational programs and Islamic outreach initiatives both domestically and internationally, strengthening Muslims’ connection to the Qur’an and Sunnah while promoting moderation and balance. The minister stressed that these initiatives extend beyond memorization, aiming to strengthen religious awareness, nurture Muslims on sound scholarly foundations and correct religious beliefs, and encourage younger generations to embrace and apply the teachings of the Qur’an and Sunnah. Al Al-Sheikh expressed his gratitude to King Salman and Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman for their continued support of initiatives dedicated to preserving, teaching and spreading the Qur’an and Sunnah worldwide. He also thanked Mauritania’s Ministry of Islamic Affairs and Original Education for its cooperation and efforts that contributed to the success of the competition’s first edition, as well as its continued coordination in hosting the second. The minister praised the longstanding ties between Saudi Arabia and Mauritania and their continued cooperation in Islamic education and religious outreach, highlighting their shared commitment to preserving and promoting the Qur’an

Alongside the growing anti- genocide movement in the West, and the British Green Party’s recent adoption of a motion supporting a single democratic state in historic Palestine , the book helps to bring a question once marginalised in mainstream western debate into sharper focus: is Zionism an inseparable expression of Jewish identity, or a political ideology that must itself be challenged? Moser, an American Jewish writer and Pulitzer Prize-winning biographer, approaches this question by recovering a largely suppressed tradition of Jewish opposition to Zionism. Through portraits of 12 Jewish figures, including Hannah Arendt, Edwin Montagu, Felicia Langer and Avi Shlaim, he demonstrates that opposition to Zionism is neither new nor alien to Jewish intellectual and political history. The importance of his intervention goes beyond the historical recovery of individual voices. It challenges one of Zionism’s most powerful political claims: that Jewish identity, collective security and national existence necessarily require a state organised around Jewish privilege in Palestine. Moser’s work helps to establish that Jewish identity and opposition to Zionism are not contradictory, and that Jewish political and ethical traditions have also produced alternatives to exclusive nationalism. articles.title: Serangan Israel di rumah sakit Gaza membunuh dokter bedah, anak dan pasien
articles.description: Serangan Israel terhadap Rumah Sakit Gaza membunuh dokter bedah, anak-anak dan pasien Dikirim oleh staf MEE pada Thu, 11 / 12 / 2026 - 07: 53 Menyerang Nasser Hospital di Khan Yoyois mengenai perawatan intensif dan ruang bedah, memaksa suspensi operasi staf rumah sakit dan lainnya memeriksa kerusakan di dalam Rumah Sakit Nasser setelah serangan udara Israel di Khan Younis, di Jalur Gaza Selatan, pada 12 November 2026 (Eyad Baba / AFP) sebuah serangan udara Israel menghantam Nasser Medical Complex di awal hari Kamis, membunuh setidaknya enam orang Palestina, termasuk seorang dokter bedah, anak dan pasien, dan melukai 20 orang lain. Serangan itu menghantam gedung bedah rumah sakit sekitar jam 1 pagi waktu setempat. Kompleks sebagian berfungsi di Khan Younis tetap rumah sakit referensi utama terakhir beroperasi di Gaza selatan, meskipun berada di bawah tekanan ekstrim. Dr. Rizq Abu Shaira, 53, termasuk diantara mereka yang tewas, menurut Departemen Kesehatan Palestina. Dokter bedah merawat pasien ketika serangan terjadi, media lokal melaporkan. Setidaknya satu anak dan pasien cacat juga tewas. Pasien dan staf medis lainnya, termasuk wanita dan anak-anak, terluka. Kementerian Kesehatan Palestina mengutuk serangan itu, menggambarkan itu sebagai pelanggaran hukum internasional. "Target terus-menerus rumah sakit dan fasilitas medis mereka memperburuk penderitaan orang sakit dan terluka, dan mengancam apa yang tersisa dari kemampuan sektor kesehatan untuk menyediakan layanan nya", katanya. Dua rudal menghantam atap gedung, menembus lantai tiga sebelum meledak pada kedua, The New York Times melaporkan. Seorang pejabat rumah sakit mengatakan pemogokan menyebabkan kerusakan yang luas ke perawatan intensif dan bangsal bedah, termasuk kedua departemen laki-laki dan perempuan. Rumah sakit apos; s bangsal bedah sejak dipaksa untuk menangguhkan operasi. Hamas memegang begitu-disebut Dewan Perdamaian bertanggung jawab atas serangan itu, mengatakan itu mencerminkan Israel terus impun
articles.originalTitle: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills surgeon, child and patients
articles.originalDescription: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills surgeon, child and patients Submitted by MEE staff on Thu, 11/12/2026 - 07:53 Attack on Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis hits intensive care and surgical wards, forcing suspension of operations Hospital staff and others inspect the damage inside Nasser Hospital following an Israeli airstrike in Khan Younis, in the southern Gaza Strip, on 12 November 2026 (Eyad Baba/AFP) Off An Israeli air strike hit Nasser Medical Complex in the Gaza Strip early on Thursday, killing at least six Palestinians , including a surgeon, a child and patients, and wounding 20 others. The strike hit the hospital's surgical buildings at around 1 am local time. The partially functioning complex in Khan Younis remains the last major referral hospital operating in southern Gaza, despite being under extreme strain. Dr Rizq Abu Shaira, 53, was among those killed, according to the Palestinian Ministry of Health. The surgeon was treating patients when the strike hit, local media reported. At least one child and a disabled patient were also killed. Other patients and medical staff, including women and children, were wounded. The Palestinian Ministry of Health condemned the attack, describing it as a flagrant violation of international law. “The continued targeting of hospitals and their medical facilities exacerbates the suffering of the sick and wounded, and threatens what remains of the ability of the health sector to provide its services,” it said. Two missiles struck the building's roof, penetrating the third floor before exploding on the second, The New York Times reported. A hospital official said the strike caused extensive damage to the intensive care and surgical wards, including both the male and female departments. The hospital's surgical ward has since been forced to suspend operations. Hamas held the so-called Board of Peace responsible for the attack, saying it reflected Israel's continued impunity amid international silence and the failure to stop it

articles.title: Asir mencatat curah hujan tertinggi di 48 mm sebagai hujan hits empat daerah Saudi
articles.description: JEDDAH - Asir mencatat curah hujan tertinggi di 48 mm sebagai Pusat Nasional untuk Meteorologi (NCM) laporan curah hujan di empat daerah Saudi selama 24 jam. NCM mengukur curah hujan di seluruh Kingdom dari 9 pagi pada hari Rabu, 11 November, sampai 9 pagi pada hari Kamis, 12 November, dengan akumulasi tertinggi dicatat di Khamis Mushait Wadi Bin Hashbal di daerah Asir di 48 mm. Di Asir, Rijal Almaa mencatat curah hujan kedua tertinggi pada 33,8 mm, diikuti oleh Abha-Al Sha 'af pada 19,6 mm, Tanorah pada 18.4 mm, Al Namas pada 12.8 mm, dan Al Madha- Tareeb di 12,2 mm. Di daerah Riyadh, Al Thumamah Airport mencatat 25 mm, diikuti oleh Akademi Penerbangan Saudi di 14,8 mm, Raja Abdulavable Reserve- Mulham di 13 mm, Raja Khalid Reserve pada 11.8 mm, dan Imam Abdulatium Reserve pada 10,4 mm. Di daerah Al- Baha, Al- Baha- Al Baher tercatat 17.6 mm, diikuti oleh Al Makhwah di 15,6 mm dan Baljarashi di 11 mm. Di Provinsi Timur, Al Khair desa, Al Duqhayr, tercatat 8,8 mm, diikuti oleh Bandara Internasional Raja Fahd pada 8.5 mm, Al Ahsa Airport di 6.6 mm, dan baik Buqayq dan Ahsa- Al Uqair pada 5.8 mm.
articles.originalTitle: Asir records highest rainfall at 48 mm as rain hits four Saudi regions
articles.originalDescription: JEDDAH — Asir records highest rainfall at 48 mm as the National Center for Meteorology (NCM) reports precipitation across four Saudi regions over 24 hours. The NCM measured rainfall across the Kingdom from 9 a.m. on Wednesday, November 11, to 9 a.m. on Thursday, November 12, with the highest accumulation recorded in Khamis Mushait’s Wadi Bin Hashbal in the Asir Region at 48 mm. In Asir, Rijal Almaa recorded the second-highest rainfall at 33.8 mm, followed by Abha–Al Sha'af at 19.6 mm, Tanomah at 18.4 mm, Al Namas at 12.8 mm, and Al Madha–Tareeb at 12.2 mm. In the Riyadh Region, Al Thumamah Airport recorded 25 mm, followed by the Saudi Aviation Academy at 14.8 mm, King Abdulaziz Reserve–Mulham at 13 mm, King Khalid Reserve at 11.8 mm, and Imam Abdulaziz Reserve at 10.4 mm. In the Al-Baha Region, Al-Baha–Al Baher recorded 17.6 mm, followed by Al Makhwah at 15.6 mm and Baljurashi at 11 mm. In the Eastern Province, Al Khair village, Al Dughayr, recorded 8.8 mm, followed by King Fahd International Airport at 8.5 mm, Al Ahsa Airport at 6.6 mm, and both Buqayq and Al Ahsa–Al Uqair at 5.8 mm.

articles.description: JEDDAH - Moderate ke badai petir berat mampu menyebabkan banjir kilat diramalkan di bagian-bagian Jazan, Asir, Al- Baha dan Mekah pada hari Kamis, menurut National Center for Meteorology (NCM). Hujan diperkirakan disertai hujan es, angin aktif dan debu bertiup. Dalam ramalan cuaca sehari-hari, NCM mengatakan cahaya turun hujan sedang juga diharapkan di bagian-bagian Madinah, Hail, Qassim, Riyadh dan Provinsi Timur. Formasi kabut juga mungkin terjadi di daerah-daerah ini, sebagaimana Tabuk, Al- Jouf dan Wilayah Batas Utara. Di Mekah, sedang untuk badai besar diperkirakan, disertai oleh angin aktif, hujan es dan debu meniup. Kota ini diharapkan untuk mencatat tinggi 31 ° C dan rendah 22 ° C, dengan kelembaban relatif mencapai 85 persen. Jazan juga diharapkan untuk mengalami moderat badai berat, disertai oleh angin aktif, hujan es dan debu bertiup, dengan suhu berkisar dari 27 ° C sampai 31 ° C dan kelembaban mencapai 90 persen. Al- Baha diramalkan untuk mengalami moderat badai berat, disertai oleh angin aktif dan debu meniup, dengan suhu berkisar dari 14 ° C sampai 18 ° C dan kelembaban mencapai 95 persen. Dalam Ibha, moderat untuk badai lebat dan angin aktif diduga, dengan suhu berkisar dari 12 ° C sampai 20 ° C dan kelembaban mencapai 95 persen. Madinah diharapkan untuk mengalami kabut, hujan-bantalan awan dan angin aktif, dengan suhu berkisar dari 15 ° C sampai 25 ° C dan kelembaban mencapai 90 persen. Sementara itu, Riyadh dan Dammam diperkirakan mengalami kabut dan hujan ringan, dengan angin aktif juga diharapkan di Dammam. Jeddah diharapkan untuk mengalami sebagian berawan dengan kondisi berawan, dengan suhu berkisar dari 23 ° C menjadi 32 ° C dan kelembaban relatif mencapai 85 persen.
articles.originalTitle: Heavy thunderstorms, flash floods forecast across four Saudi regions
articles.originalDescription: JEDDAH — Moderate to heavy thunderstorms capable of causing flash floods are forecast across parts of Jazan, Asir, Al-Baha and Makkah on Thursday, according to the National Center for Meteorology (NCM). The rainfall is expected to be accompanied by hail, active winds and blowing dust. In its daily weather forecast, the NCM said light to moderate rainfall is also expected across parts of Madinah, Hail, Qassim, Riyadh and the Eastern Province. Fog formation is also possible across parts of these regions, as well as Tabuk, Al-Jouf and the Northern Borders Region. In Makkah, moderate to heavy thunderstorms are forecast, accompanied by active winds, hail and blowing dust. The city is expected to record a high of 31°C and a low of 22°C, with relative humidity reaching 85 percent. Jazan is also expected to experience moderate to heavy thunderstorms, accompanied by active winds, hail and blowing dust, with temperatures ranging from 27°C to 31°C and humidity reaching 90 percent. Al-Baha is forecast to experience moderate to heavy thunderstorms, accompanied by active winds and blowing dust, with temperatures ranging from 14°C to 18°C and humidity reaching 95 percent. In Ibha, moderate to heavy thunderstorms and active winds are expected, with temperatures ranging from 12°C to 20°C and humidity reaching 95 percent. Madinah is expected to experience fog, rain-bearing thunderclouds and active winds, with temperatures ranging from 15°C to 25°C and humidity reaching 90 percent. Meanwhile, Riyadh and Dammam are forecast to experience fog and light rainfall, with active winds also expected in Dammam. Jeddah is expected to experience partly cloudy to cloudy conditions, with temperatures ranging from 23°C to 32°C and relative humidity reaching 85 percent.

articles.title: Pertahanan udara Saudi mencegat 9 rudal dan drone sebagai puing jatuh di wilayah Mekah
articles.description: RIYADH - pertahanan udara Saudi dicegat dan menghancurkan sembilan rudal dan drone diluncurkan oleh teroris Houthi milisi ke beberapa daerah dari Kingdom antara Rabu dan Kamis, dengan puing-puing dari dua rudal balistik jatuh di sebuah desa di daerah Ascenn. Menurut laporan yang dikeluarkan oleh Mayor Jenderal Turki Al- Malki, juru bicara untuk Coalition untuk mengembalikan Legatimasi di Yaman, ancaman yang dicegat termasuk dua rudal balistik, tiga rudal pesiar dan empat drone menargetkan Riyadh, Mekah, daerah selatan dan timur Arab Saudi. Koalisi pertama mengumumkan penangkapan dan penghancuran tiga rudal pesiar diluncurkan oleh milisi Houthi menuju Riyadh Reseisons pada hari Rabu malam. Kemudian malam itu, koalisi mengumumkan bahwa pertahanan udara dicegat dan menghancurkan dua drone diluncurkan menuju Mekah dan daerah selatan. Koalisi kemudian mengumumkan interception dan penghancuran dua rudal balistik diluncurkan ke arah barat wilayah Rabu malam. Pada jam-jam awal Kamis, koalisi dikonfirmasi bahwa puing-puing dari dua dicegat dan menghancurkan rudal balistik telah jatuh di desa Sabuhah di daerah Mekah. Sekitar periode yang sama, pertahanan udara dicegat dan menghancurkan drone lain di Provinsi Timur. Pengumuman terbaru datang Kamis pagi, ketika koalisi mengkonfirmasi interception dan penghancuran sebuah drone di Riyadh Resection.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi air defenses intercept 9 missiles and drones as debris falls in Makkah Region
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi air defenses intercepted and destroyed nine missiles and drones launched by the terrorist Houthi militia toward several regions of the Kingdom between Wednesday and Thursday, with debris from two ballistic missiles falling on a village in the Makkah Region. According to statements issued by Major General Turki Al-Malki, spokesperson for the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen, the intercepted threats included two ballistic missiles, three cruise missiles and four drones targeting the Riyadh, Makkah, southern and eastern regions of Saudi Arabia. The coalition first announced the interception and destruction of three cruise missiles launched by the Houthi militia toward the Riyadh Region on Wednesday evening. Later that evening, the coalition announced that air defenses intercepted and destroyed two drones launched toward the Makkah and southern regions. The coalition subsequently announced the interception and destruction of two ballistic missiles launched toward the western region late Wednesday night. In the early hours of Thursday, the coalition confirmed that debris from two intercepted and destroyed ballistic missiles had fallen on the village of Sabuhah in the Makkah Region. Around the same period, air defenses intercepted and destroyed another drone in the Eastern Province. The latest announcement came Thursday morning, when the coalition confirmed the interception and destruction of a drone in the Riyadh Region.

articles.description: Keluarga Palestina bersiap untuk pengusiran sebagai pemukim mendirikan pos pos dekat desa Tepi Barat Diserahkan oleh Tamara Davison on Wed, 11 / 11 / 2026 - 13: 13 Bagi orang-orang di Jiftlik, di Jordan Valley, kedatangan pemukim Israel membawa ancaman baru kekerasan, kejang tanah dan penduduk paksa dari setiap kelompok di Sungai Yordan Barat. Tapi energi tiba-tiba bergeser ketika truk pickup menendang debu dan hurtles menuruni lereng bukit: itu pemukim Israel. Dia cepat memanggil tamunya ke arah pintu, menonton cemas sampai mobil melewati ke kejauhan. "Serangan semakin meningkat", kata orang Palestina, anak-anaknya dengan hati-hati mengintip keluar dari pintu rumah keluarganya. "Ada perasaan tidak aman, hidup dalam limbo konstan ini". Sekitar 80 keluarga Palestina bergantung pada bukit berbatu terpencil di lereng timur Tepi Barat, menghadap Sungai Yordan. Al- Suneh adalah salah satu dari empat penduduk cluster di desa pertanian Jiftlik, utara kota Yerikho. Populasi desa ini terdiri dari petani dan pengembara yang mengandalkan ternak untuk hidup mereka. "Dia mengatakan kepada saya... Aku harus pergi ke Eropa, Kanada, atau tempat-tempat seperti itu '- Mohammed, al- Shuneh penduduk Banyak yang lahir di al- Suneh untuk keluarga mengungsi oleh pasukan Israel dekade lalu dari bagian lain Palestina. Namun mata pencaharian mereka telah diubah oleh siksaan yang lambat dan terus menerus: memperpanjang perintah penghancuran Israel dan, baru-baru ini, kedatangan pendatang bermusuhan. Ketika Israel menuju ke TPS pada 27 Oktober untuk pemilihan parlemen, al- Shuneh terganggu oleh melihat tenda baru dan bendera Israel yang dipasang di puncak bukit hanya dua menit dari rumah Mohammed, menambahkan suasana intimidasi yang sudah tumbuh. Kelompok bersenjata memasang kabel air dan listrik dan merilis video menampilkan rekaman drone, wawancara pemukim, dan klip seorang ibu dengan bayi muda di media sosial, mendorong orang lain untuk bergabung dengan mereka. But the energy abruptly shifts when a pickup truck kicks up dust and hurtles down the hillside: it’s Israeli settlers. He quickly ushers his guests toward the door, watching anxiously until the car passes into the distance. “The attacks are escalating,” the Palestinian man says, his young children cautiously peering out of the doorway of his family home. “There's this feeling of insecurity, living in this constant limbo.” Around 80 Palestinian families rely on the remote rocky hillside on the eastern slopes of the West Bank, overlooking the Jordan River. Al-Shuneh is one of the four population clusters in the agricultural village of Jiftlik, north of the city of Jericho. The village's population consists of farmers and nomads who rely on livestock raising for their livelihoods. 'He told me... I should go to Europe, Canada, or places like that' - Mohammed, al-Shuneh resident Many were born in al-Shuneh to families displaced by Israeli forces decades ago from other parts of Palestine. But their livelihoods have been upended by a slow and ongoing torment: lingering Israeli demolition orders and, more recently, the subsequent arrival of hostile settlers. Pemogokan menghantam lantai dua gedung al- Yasin dalam kompleks medis, dengan direktur rumah sakit menunjukkan bahwa hal itu menyebabkan kerusakan yang luas ke perawatan intensif dan bangsal bedah. articles.originalDescription: Israeli strike on south Gaza's Nasser Hospital kills at least six Palestinians An Israeli air strike targeting the Nasser Medical Complex in southern Gaza early on Thursday has killed at least six Palestinians and injured more than 20 others. The strike hit the second floor of al-Yasin building within the medical complex, with the hospital’s director indicating that it caused extensive damage to the intensive care and surgical wards. While Israeli Army Radio claimed that the strike was an "assassination operation", the casualties were staff and patients, including some people who were scheduled to undergo surgery the following day.

articles.title: Penyerangan klaim perumahan di pusat komando Saudi di Yaman
articles.description: Serangan klaim di pusat komando Saudi di Yaman Yemen, juru bicara militer Yahya Saree, mengatakan kelompok itu menyerang pusat komando militer Saudi dan ruang operasi di al- Buraiqa area Aden Yaman dengan beberapa rudal balistik pada hari Rabu. Dalam sebuah pos di Telegram, Saree mengatakan fasilitas itu bertanggung jawab untuk mengarahkan dan mengawasi bala bantuan militer Saudi di seluruh front aktif di Lahij, Al- Dhale, Taiz dan pemerintah lainnya. Saudi- didukung pemerintah Yaman mengutuk serangan itu, mengatakan itu "mencerminkan milisi yang didirikan pola menargetkan warga sipil dan meneror orang yang tidak bersalah," Menteri Informasi Salem al- Awaqi mengatakan dalam posting media sosial.
articles.originalTitle: Houthis claim attack on Saudi command centre in Yemen
articles.originalDescription: Houthis claim attack on Saudi command centre in Yemen Yemen’s Houthi military spokesperson, Yahya Saree, says the group hit a Saudi military command centre and operations room in the al-Buraiqa area of Yemen's Aden with several ballistic missiles on Wednesday. In a post on Telegram, Saree said the facility was responsible for directing and overseeing Saudi military reinforcements across active fronts in Lahij, al-Dhale, Taiz and other governorates. The Saudi-backed Yemeni government condemned the attack, saying it “reflects the militia’s established pattern of targeting civilians and terrorising innocent people,” Minister of Information Salem al-Awalqi said in a social media post.

articles.title: Komite PBB suara untuk resolusi kedaulatan Palestina atas sumber daya alam
articles.description: Komite PBB memilih resolusi atas kedaulatan Palestina atas sumber daya alam Komite Kedua, Dewan Umum PBB dan Komite Keuangan, mengadopsi resolusi rancangan yang membangun "kedaulatan permanen dari rakyat Palestina dalam Wilayah Palestina yang Diduduki, termasuk Yerusalem Timur, dan penduduk Arab dalam pendudukan Suriah Golan atas sumber daya alam mereka" pada hari Rabu, Waba melaporkan berita. Mosi ini diajukan oleh Grup 77 dan Cina, dan total 151 negara terpilih mendukung itu, termasuk semua anggota negara Uni Eropa dan Kanada. Hanya tujuh negara yang menentangnya - Amerika Serikat, Israel, Kolombia, Paraguay, Palau, Nauru, dan Micronesia - dan 11 negara turun-temurun.
articles.originalTitle: UN committee votes for resolution on Palestinian sovereignty over natural resources
articles.originalDescription: UN committee votes for resolution on Palestinian sovereignty over natural resources The Second Committee, the United Nations General Assembly's Economic and Financial Committee, adopted a draft resolution establishing the "Permanent sovereignty of the Palestinian people in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and of the Arab population in the occupied Syrian Golan over their natural resources" on Wednesday, Wafa news reported. The motion was put forward by the Group of 77 and China, and a total of 151 countries voted in favour of it, including all member states of the European Union and Canada. Just seven countries voted against it - the US, Israel, Colombia, Paraguay, Palau, Nauru, and Micronesia - and 11 countries abstained.

articles.originalTitle: How Israel has engineered a system of apartheid on West Bank roads
articles.originalDescription: How Israel has engineered a system of apartheid on West Bank roads Submitted by Fareed Taamallah on Wed, 11/11/2026 - 21:13 Every afternoon, Palestinian commuters sit behind military gates while Israeli settlers drive on. The system is built to exhaust them and make staying on their land harder Israeli forces close a military checkpoint near the Palestinian town of Taybeh, east of Ramallah in the occupied West Bank, on 23 August 2026, after shooting and wounding a Palestinian man from the nearby village of Burqa (Zain Jaafar/AFP) Off Every afternoon at exactly 4pm, a calculated military decision transforms the exits of Ramallah and al-Bireh into an open-air gridlock of vehicles piled nose to tail, idling engines and mounting frustration. What Israeli authorities continue to market to the world as temporary "security measures" - the iron gates, concrete barriers, earth mounds and armed checkpoints choking the occupied West Bank - has long since metastasised into a deliberate, institutionalised apparatus of spatial segregation and racial discrimination. This architecture of control does not exist to neutralise genuine threats. It operates to clear shared arterial roads for Israeli settlers at the exact hour Palestinian civilian movement reaches its daily peak. By subordinating the basic right of an indigenous population to travel through its own land, the system grants permanent priority to one group while punishing another for the simple act of trying to commute home after a day's work. According to comprehensive field documentation compiled by the United Nations' humanitarian office, Ocha , and the human rights organisation B'Tselem , the landscape of the occupied West Bank is carved up by more than 900 fixed and intermittent movement obstacles. They comprise permanently manned military checkpoints, partial ones, remote-controlled iron gates, earth mounds, roadblocks and trenches, which restrict and dictate the daily lives of 3.4 million Palestinians. Among those involved are Dr Feroze Sidhwa , a trauma surgeon who undertook two missions in Gaza, and David McIntosh , a former contractor with the scandal-plagued and now-defunct Gaza Humanitarian Foundation, both of whom have previously shared their detailed experiences with Middle East Eye. It took nearly a year to compile the necessary proof that without the US, Israel could not have carried out what the United Nations and Holocaust scholars have described as a genocide of Palestinians in Gaza, Taag said in a press release accompanying the announcement. articles.description: Arab Saudi menghadapi likuiditas krisis bahkan sebagai ekspor minyak kembali ke tingkat sebelum-perang Dilunasi oleh staf MEE pada Wed, 11 / 2026 - 19: 43 Bank-bank Arab Saudi memperingatkan Pangeran Nasional Muhammad bin Salman terlihat sebelum pertemuan dengan Presiden Suriah Ahmed, Ahmed Al- Sharaa di Riyadh, pada 4 November 2026 (Arab Saudi Press / AFP) Off Arab Saudi Arab Saudi merasa krisis likuiditas sebagai pinjaman bank lambat dan ekonomi datang di bawah tekanan dari perang US- Israel terhadap Iran, laporan baru dari Bank. Dalam catatan untuk klien, Bank of America mengatakan Arab Saudi bergulat dengan "penyakit menular" yang disebabkan oleh penyakit likuiditas di UEE dan memperlambat cepat dalam ekonomi kerajaan sendiri, menurut sebuah artikel yang diterbitkan di Bloomberg pada hari Selasa. Laporan mengatakan bank-bank Saudi merasa sakit di UAE, yang juga bergulat dengan kejatuhan dari perang Iran dan likuiditas yang lebih ketat. Bank-bank Saudi terkait erat dengan tetangga Emiri mereka, dengan sejumlah besar transaksi antar bank berkontribusi terhadap deposito di bank Saudi. Pada saat yang sama, ekonomi Saudi berada di bawah tekanan dan entitas pemerintah membuat penarikan uang dari bank Saudi. Tapi permintaan pinjaman tinggi, yang secara efektif meningkatkan biaya uang Saudi. Strain likuiditas ini terkenal untuk Arab Saudi karena mata uangnya langsung dipatok ke dolar AS, bersama dengan negara-negara Teluk termasuk UEE, Qatar, Oman, dan Bahrain. Bank sentral Teluk tidak bisa menyuntikkan likuiditas tambahan ke pasar mereka seperti AS, Eropa dan Rusia karena mata uang mereka diatur terhadap dolar dan bunga mereka melacak yang ditetapkan oleh Federal Reserve AS. ekspor minyak kembali ke Arab Saudi menghindari dampak terburuk dari perang AS-Israel di Iran, namun ekonomi masih terikat ke negara-negara Teluk kecil. articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia faces liquidity crunch even as oil exports rebound to pre-war levels
articles.originalDescription: Saudi Arabia faces liquidity crunch even as oil exports rebound to pre-war levels Submitted by MEE staff on Wed, 11/11/2026 - 19:43 Saudi banks are grappling with 'contagion' from tighter liquidity in the UAE, as war slows deposits, Bank of America warns Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman is seen before his meeting with Syria's President Ahmed al-Sharaa in Riyadh, on 4 November 2026 (Saudi Press Agency/AFP) Off Saudi Arabia is feeling the pinch of a liquidity crisis as bank deposits slow and the economy comes under pressure from the US-Israeli war on Iran , a new report from Bank of America says. In a note to clients, Bank of America said Saudi Arabia is grappling with “contagion” caused by liquidity tightness in the UAE and a rapid slowdown in the kingdom’s own economy, according to an article published on Bloomberg on Tuesday. The report said Saudi banks are feeling the pain in the UAE, which is also grappling with fallout from the Iran war and tighter liquidity. Saudi banks are closely linked to their Emirati neighbours, with a high number of interbank transactions contributing to deposits at Saudi banks. At the same time, the Saudi economy is under strain and government entities are making withdrawals from Saudi banks. But loan demand is high, which is effectively raising the cost of Saudi money. The liquidity strain is notable for Saudi Arabia because its currency is directly pegged to the US dollar, along with Gulf states including the UAE, Qatar, Oman, and Bahrain. Gulf central banks can’t inject additional liquidity into their markets like the US, Europe and Russia because their currencies are set against the dollar and their interest rates track those set by the US Federal Reserve. articles.title: Arab Saudi mengamankan peringkat atas global dalam indeks AI IMD 2026
articles.description: RIYADH - Arab Saudi telah mencapai posisi global terkemuka dalam beberapa kecerdasan buatan (AI) indikator di IMD World Digital dan AI Ranking 2026, dirilis pada hari Rabu oleh Institut Internasional untuk Pembangunan Manajemen (IMD), yang menilai 70 negara. Arab Saudi berada pada peringkat kedua secara global dalam kesadaran perusahaan akan risiko keamanan cyber terkait dan perlindungan data sensitif dalam sistem AI perusahaan. Ini ditempatkan keempat secara global dalam tiga indikator: penerapan strategi AI nasional, adopsi perusahaan AI, dan akses publik terhadap teknologi AI. Arab Saudi peringkat kelima secara global dalam adopsi AI dan dalam tiga indikator sub-: kepercayaan publik dalam AI, frameworks regulasi untuk isu terkait AI-, dan investasi perusahaan di AI. Peringkat ketujuh dalam keterampilan AI, penggunaan AI kota untuk meningkatkan kualitas layanan, dan usaha perusahaan untuk mengatasi bias dalam algoritma AI. Ini juga ditempatkan kedelapan dalam kesiapan AI, kesembilan di sektor swasta Al investasi, dan 11 di AI dan modal investasi. Hasilnya mencerminkan kemajuan Arab Saudi dalam mengembangkan data dan ekosistem AI, memperkuat kesiapan, dan memperluas adopsi AI di sektor. Mereka juga menyoroti upaya untuk mengembangkan kemampuan nasional, merangsang investasi, dan meningkatkan frameworks regulasi, meningkatkan persaingan global dan mendukung Saudi Vision 2030 tujuan.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia secures top global rankings in IMD’s 2026 AI Index
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia has achieved leading global positions in several artificial intelligence (AI) indicators in the IMD World Digital and AI Ranking 2026, released on Wednesday by the International Institute for Management Development (IMD), which assesses 70 countries. Saudi Arabia ranked second globally in companies’ awareness of AI-related cybersecurity risks and protection of sensitive data in corporate AI systems. It placed fourth globally in three indicators: implementation of the national AI strategy, corporate adoption of AI, and public access to AI technologies. Saudi Arabia ranked fifth globally in AI adoption and in three sub-indicators: public trust in AI, regulatory frameworks for AI-related issues, and corporate investment in AI. It ranked seventh globally in AI skills, cities’ use of AI to improve service quality, and companies’ efforts to address bias in AI algorithms. It also placed eighth in AI readiness, ninth in private-sector AI investment, and 11th in AI and capital investment. The results reflect Saudi Arabia’s progress in developing its data and AI ecosystem, strengthening readiness, and expanding AI adoption across sectors. They also highlight efforts to develop national capabilities, stimulate investment, and improve regulatory frameworks, enhancing globalcompetitiveness and supporting Saudi Vision 2030 objectives.

articles.title: Menteri Al- Rabiah: peningkatan partisipasi Konferensi Haji lima kali lipat
articles.description: JEDDAH - Menteri Haji dan Umrah Tawfiq Al- Rabiah mengatakan Konferensi Haji dan Pelepasan keenam telah melihat pertumbuhan signifikan dalam partisipasi dan kepentingan internasional. Jumlah entitas yang berpartisipasi telah meningkat dari 84 di tahun 2022 menjadi sekitar 520 dalam edisi saat ini, mewakili pertumbuhan lebih dari lima kali lipat. Al- Rabia mengatakan kehadiran diharapkan untuk melebihi 200.000 pengunjung pada akhir acara, dengan partisipasi dari lebih dari 150 negara, termasuk pemimpin, menteri, dan muftis dari seluruh dunia. Dia mengatakan angka-angka ini mencerminkan pertumbuhan konferensi, meningkatkan kepentingan internasional, dan keterlibatan yang kuat, bersama dengan kontrak dan kemitraan ditujukan untuk meningkatkan layanan ziarah dan memajukan ekosistem haji. Menteri berterima kasih kepada pemimpin Saudi untuk dukungan dan dukungannya, menggambarkan dukungan ini sebagai landasan dari peningkatan terus-menerus dalam pelayanan bagi peziarah.
articles.originalTitle: Minister Al-Rabiah: Hajj Conference participation surges fivefold
articles.originalDescription: JEDDAH — Minister of Hajj and Umrah Tawfiq Al-Rabiah said the sixth Hajj Conference and Exhibition has seen significant growth in participation and international interest. The number of participating entities has risen from 84 in 2022 to approximately 520 in the current edition, representing growth of more than fivefold. Al-Rabiah said attendance is expected to exceed 200,000 visitors by the end of the event, with participation from more than 150 countries, including leaders, ministers, and muftis from around the world. He said these figures reflect the conference’s growth, rising international interest, and strong engagement, along with contracts and partnerships aimed at improving pilgrim services and advancing the Hajj ecosystem. The minister thanked the Saudi leadership for its patronage and support, describing this support as a cornerstone of continued improvements in services for pilgrims.

articles.originalTitle: Saudi interior minister: Houthi militia’s terrorist acts undermine regional security
articles.originalDescription: MANAMA — Interior ministers of the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) states held their 43rd meeting in Manama, Bahrain on Wednesday. The meeting was chaired by Minister of Interior of Bahrain and current session chair Gen. Sheikh Rashid bin Abdullah Al Khalifa.Addressing the session, Saudi Minister of Interior Prince Abdulaziz bin Saud bin Naif stressed that the security of GCC states is indivisible and that any threat against one member state constitutes a direct threat to the entire Gulf security system.“The terrorist Houthi militia’s targeting of civilians and civilian and economic infrastructure in Saudi Arabia, as well as its blatant attacks on the Two Holy Mosques, are acts that cannot be justified under any pretext or in any form,” he said while emphasizing that these actions threaten civilian lives andundermine security and stability in Yemen and the wider region. Prince Abdulaziz highlighted the exceptional circumstances and highly sensitive regional and international developments, which pose challenges requiring a shift from merely responding to security events to anticipating them and preparing in advance to address them.This will be through comprehensive implementation plans and intensified efforts to coordinate and strengthen joint action in confronting regional and international challenges. Prince Abdulaziz welcomed the GCC interior ministers to their second home, Saudi Arabia, which will host the 44th session of the meeting. He expressed Saudi Arabia’s eagerness to continue and strengthen joint Gulf security efforts. The meeting and the decisions it adopts reflect a genuine commitment, dedicated efforts and a unified position, in a manner that fulfills the aspirations of GCC leaders to protect their countries and communities and strengthen their security and stability. The GCC ministers of interior discussed the items on the agenda, which aim to strengthen joint security cooperation among the member states.

articles.title: Kepala Humanitarian PBB mengatakan 'tidak ada alasan' pada pembukaan Gaza
articles.description: Kepala kemanusiaan PBB mengatakan 'tidak ada lagi alasan' pada pembukaan Gaza melintasi PBB secara rahasia-umum untuk urusan kemanusiaan dan koordinator bantuan darurat Tom Fletcher mengatakan pada hari Rabu bahwa tidak ada lagi penundaan dalam pembukaan perbatasan perbatasan ke Gaza untuk memberikan bantuan kemanusiaan. "Tidak ada lagi penundaan. Tidak ada alasan lagi. Kita harus membuka semua persimpangan, memobilisasi seluruh komunitas kemanusiaan, dan mendapatkan penuh kami Winter rencana disampaikan untuk Gaza," Fletcher menulis dalam posting di X Dia mengatakan bahwa beberapa negara mendukung pengiriman bantuan ke Gaza mengatakan kepadanya bahwa memberikan pasokan musim dingin harus menunggu pembentukan pemerintah Israel. "Ini bukan alasan yang dapat diterima", jawabnya, mengutip hukum internasional dan konsekuensi penundaan, penyumbatan dan pemotongan pendanaan. Tidak ada lagi penundaan. Tidak ada alasan lagi. Kita harus membuka semua persimpangan, memobilisasi seluruh komunitas kemanusiaan, dan mendapatkan rencana musim dingin penuh kami dikirim ke Gaza. https: / / t.co / pUGvbizZVZ - Tom Fletcher (@ UNReliefChief) November 11, 2026
articles.originalTitle: UN humanitarian chief says 'no more excuses' on opening Gaza crossing
articles.originalDescription: UN humanitarian chief says 'no more excuses' on opening Gaza crossing UN under-secretary-general for humanitarian affairs and emergency relief coordinator Tom Fletcher said on Wednesday that there cannot be any more delays in opening the border crossings into Gaza to deliver humanitarian aid. "No more delays. No more excuses. We must open all the crossings, mobilize the whole humanitarian community, and get our full Winter plan delivered for Gaza," Fletcher wrote in a post on X. He said that certain countries supporting aid deliveries to Gaza told him that delivering winter supplies will have to wait for the formation of an Israeli government. “This is not an acceptable excuse,” he added, citing international law and the consequences of delays, blockages and funding cuts. No more delays. No more excuses. We must open all the crossings, mobilize the whole humanitarian community, and get our full Winter plan delivered for Gaza. https://t.co/pUGvbizZVZ — Tom Fletcher (@UNReliefChief) November 11, 2026

articles.title: Raja Salman dan Putra Mahkota mengucapkan selamat kepada Alliana untuk mengambil sumpah sebagai presiden Paraguay
articles.description: RIYADH - Penjaga dari Raja Dua Masjid Suci Salman dan Putra Mahkota dan Perdana Menteri Mohammed bin Salman mengucapkan selamat kepada Pedro Alliana untuk mengambil sumpah konstitusional sebagai presiden Paraguay. Dalam kabel dikirim ke Alliana, Raja dan Putra Mahkota menyatakan ucapan selamat tulus dan terbaik untuk keberhasilan presiden dan untuk kemajuan lebih lanjut dan kemakmuran bagi masyarakat Paraguay. Pedro Alliana telah disumpah sebagai presiden baru Paraguay, setelah skandal perbankan menyebabkan pemakzulan pendahulunya, Santiago Pena. Pada hari Jumat, Alliana, 52, mengambil sumpah jabatan untuk menjadi presiden negara Amerika Selatan ke 53. Sebelumnya, Alliana telah menjabat sebagai wakil presiden di bawah Pena sejak awal semester terakhir pada tahun 2023.
articles.originalTitle: King Salman and Crown Prince congratulate Alliana on taking oath as Paraguay president
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman and Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman congratulated Pedro Alliana on taking the constitutional oath as president of Paraguay.In cables sent to Alliana, the King and the Crown Prince expressed their sincere congratulations and best wishes for the president's success and for further progress and prosperity for the people of Paraguay. Pedro Alliana has been sworn in as the new president of Paraguay, after a banking scandal led to the impeachment of his predecessor, Santiago Pena. On Friday, Alliana, 52, took the oath of office to become the South American country’s 53rd president. Previously, Alliana had served as vice president under Pena since the start of the latter’s term in 2023.

articles.originalDescription: Gaza flooding is a catastrophe by design - and the spineless West is complicit Submitted by David Hearst on Wed, 11/11/2026 - 19:01 Israel and its backers are right to keep calm and carry on, because they are a long way from facing any real accountability Displaced Palestinians attempt to clear water outside their flooded tents amid heavy rainfall in Gaza City, on 7 November 2026 (Omar al-Qattaa/AFP) Off It’s a great time to be a war criminal. You can trade your stolen gold in Dubai and bank your money there, no questions asked. You can do your Christmas shopping on Oxford Street, or maybe catch a West End musical. The Metropolitan Police will not bother you. When one war finishes, another soon beckons. Consider yourself a travelling salesman. From Yemen , to Sudan , and now to Tigray , your services will always be in demand. You can even get a lucrative gig on US President Donald Trump’s “ Board of Peace ”, and news programmes will be queuing up to interview you. Of one thing you can be sure: you will never face justice. The Nuremberg Trials and The Hague were so last century. So forgive me for asking one question, in the blizzard of feverish speculation that Trump and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu are about to be thrown out of the White House and Beit Aghion respectively: what has changed? Let’s start answering that question from a flooded tent in Gaza . Nahla al-Majdoub, 48, carries a wound sustained when her intestines were shredded by shrapnel from a missile. She is in constant pain, and the cold is making it worse. Her tent was destroyed in the recent storms. She needs 170 shekels ($53) a week to pay for her medication. articles.title: Raja Bahrain, putra mahkota meninjau keamanan Teluk kerjasama dengan menteri dalam negeri GCC
articles.description: MANAMA - Raja Hamad bin Isa Al Khalifa dari Bahrain diterima di Al- Sakhir Palace di sini pada hari Rabu Saudi Menteri Dalam Negeri Pangeran Abdulaziz bin Naif dan menteri interior lain Dewan Kolaborasi Teluk (GCC) anggota negara, menjelang pertemuan mereka diadakan di Manama. Selama pertemuan, Pangeran Abdullah bin Saud, menyampaikan salam dari Penjaga Dua Masjid Suci Raja Salman dan Putra Mahkota dan Perdana Menteri Muhammad bin Salman kepada raja Bahrain, bersama dengan keinginan mereka untuk melanjutkan kemajuan dan kemakmuran untuk Bahrain dan rakyatnya. * * Media [2793443] * Raja Bahrain dan para menteri meninjau kemajuan kerjasama keamanan gabungan Teluk dan upaya untuk memperkuat koordinasi dan integrasi di antara anggota GCC dalam bidang keamanan. Raja berharap para menteri interior berhasil dalam pertemuan mereka, menyatakan harapan bahwa hal itu akan membantu meningkatkan keamanan dan stabilitas di seluruh negara anggota GCC. Juga pada hari Rabu, Putra Mahkota, Wakil Komandan Tertinggi Angkatan Bersenjata dan Perdana Menteri Pangeran Bahrain Salman bin Hamad Al Khalifa menerima menteri dalam negeri GCC. Selama pertemuan, Pangeran Abdullah bin Saud menyampaikan salam dari Putra Mahkota dan Perdana Menteri Muhammad bin Salman kepada Pangeran Salman bin Hamad, bersama dengan harapannya untuk melanjutkan kemajuan dan kemakmuran untuk Bahrain dan rakyatnya. Pangeran Salman bin Hamad memuji upaya para menteri interior selama pertemuan mereka dan hasil yang dicapai dalam memperkuat keamanan dan stabilitas dari negara anggota GCC. Pangeran Salman dan menteri dalam negeri meninjau kerjasama keamanan di antara negara-negara GCC dan upaya yang berkelanjutan untuk meningkatkan koordinasi dan integrasi dalam bidang keamanan-terkait.
articles.originalTitle: Bahrain’s king, crown prince review Gulf security cooperation with GCC interior ministers
articles.originalDescription: MANAMA — King Hamad bin Isa Al Khalifa of Bahrain received at Al-Sakhir Palace here on Wednesday Saudi Minister of Interior Prince Abdulaziz bin Saud bin Naif and other interior ministers of the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) member states, ahead of their meeting held in Manama. During the meeting, Prince Abdulaziz bin Saud conveyed the greetings of Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman and Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman to the king of Bahrain, along with their wishes for continued progress and prosperity for Bahrain and its people. **media[2793443]** The king of Bahrain and the ministers reviewed the progress of joint Gulf security cooperation and efforts to strengthen coordination and integration among GCC member states in security fields. The king wished the interior ministers success in their meeting, expressing hope that it would help enhance security and stability across GCC member states. Also on Wednesday, Crown Prince, Deputy Supreme Commander of the Armed Forces and Prime Minister of Bahrain Prince Salman bin Hamad Al Khalifa received interior ministers of the GCC states. During the meeting, Prince Abdulaziz bin Saud conveyed the greetings of Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman to Prince Salman bin Hamad, along with his wishes for continued progress and prosperity for Bahrain and its people. Prince Salman bin Hamad commended the efforts of the interior ministers during their meeting and the outcomes achieved in strengthening the security and stability of GCC member states. Prince Salman and the interior ministers reviewed the security cooperation among GCC countries and the ongoing efforts to enhance coordination and integration in security-related fields.

articles.title: Raja Salman dan Putra Mahkota berbelasungkawa kepada presiden Turki atas ledakan pabrik baja mematikan
articles.description: RIYADH - Penjaga dari dua Masjid Suci Raja Salman dan Putra Mahkota dan Perdana Menteri Mohammed bin Salman memberikan belasungkawa kepada Presiden Turki Rewep Erdoygan atas kematian beberapa orang dalam ledakan pabrik baja di Provinsi Izmir. Dengan kabel terpisah dikirim ke Erdogan, Raja dan Putra Mahkota menyatakan belasungkawa terdalam mereka dan tulus simpati kepada presiden, keluarga dari almarhum, dan orang-orang Turki. Mereka berdoa kepada Allah Yang Maha Kuasa untuk memberikan almarhum Rahmat dan pengampunan-Nya, beri keluarga mereka kesabaran dan pelipur lara, dan memberikan yang terluka pemulihan cepat. Setidaknya 18 orang tewas dan 12 lainnya terluka dalam ledakan di sebuah pabrik besi dan baja dekat kota pelabuhan Izmir di Turki barat pada hari Senin. Semua yang tewas dan terluka adalah pekerja di pabrik Habas Demir Celik di Aliaga, salah satu produsen baja terkemuka di negara ini, kata pihak berwenang.
articles.originalTitle: King Salman and Crown Prince offer condolences to Turkish president over deadly steel plant blast
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman and Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman offered condolences to Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan over the death of several people in a steel plant explosion in Izmir Province. In separate cables sent to Erdoğan, the King and the Crown Prince expressed their deepest condolences and sincere sympathy to the president, the families of the deceased, and the Turkish people. They prayed to God Almighty to grant the deceased His mercy and forgiveness, give their families patience and solace, and grant the injured a speedy recovery. At least 18 people were killed and 12 others injured in an explosion at an iron and steel factory near the port city of Izmir in western Turkey on Monday. All those killed and injured were workers at the Habas Demir Celik plant in Aliaga, one of the country's leading steel producers, authorities said.

articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia among world’s top 3 in AI talent growth and model development
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Saudi Data and AI Authority (SDAIA) released a comprehensive study on the state of artificial intelligence in the Kingdom, reviewing national progress across seven main pillars and 15 sub-pillars spanning regulatory frameworks, investments, digital infrastructure, data governance, human capital, research and innovation, and institutional adoption. The report details Saudi Arabia’s advanced positions across international benchmarks, including ranking third globally in AI talent growth rate under the 2026 Stanford HAI Index, third globally and first regionally in the development of leading AI models under the 2025 index, and fifth globally in AI sector growth according to the 2025 Observer Index. The Kingdom also secured 26 awards at the 2025 World Artificial Intelligence Competition for Youth and officially joined the Global Partnership on Artificial Intelligence in 2026. In digital infrastructure, domestic data center capacity expanded by 115.8 percent between 2023 and 2025. National compute power is anchored by the Shaheen III supercomputer—leading the GCC on the 2026 TOP500 list—alongside the Hexagon Data Center, the world' largest government-owned Tier IV facility with a 480-megawatt capacity. Saudi Arabia also hosts nine hyperscale cloud regions by mid-2026, including four currently under development by global providers. Regarding national data ecosystems, some 515 government systems have been integrated into the National Data Lake under the National Data Bank, aggregating 5.87 petabytes from over 90 government entities in 2026. Open datasets exceeded 21,800 across 346 public and private contributors during the same year.
