articles.title: Al- Qasabi: Perlindungan Konsumen Baru Hukum memperkuat keamanan untuk kelompok yang paling rentan
articles.description: RIYADH - Menteri Perdagangan Majid Al- Qasabi menegaskan bahwa persetujuan Hukum Perlindungan Konsumen, oleh Dewan Menteri pada hari Selasa, menandai tonggak legislatif signifikan dalam memperkuat hak-hak konsumen di Arab Saudi. "Ini akan dicapai dengan membangun keamanan hukum yang jelas, mengatur hubungan antara konsumen dan perusahaan komersial, dan mempromosikan praktek bisnis yang adil. Ini adalah hukum perlindungan konsumen komprehensif pertama di Kerajaan, menjamin hak dan mempromosikan praktek komersial yang adil", katanya. Al- Qasabi menyatakan bahwa hukum, undang-undang perlindungan konsumen pertama komprehensif di Kerajaan, mengumpulkan mandat lebih dari 20 lembaga pemerintah, sehingga meningkatkan efisiensi oversight dan memperkuat perlindungan hak-hak konsumen pada produk dan jasa. Hukum terdiri dari 10 bab berisi 76 artikel. Menteri mencatat bahwa hukum berisi ketentuan yang mengatur kontrak dan kompensasi atas kerusakan, menjaga kelompok yang paling rentan, termasuk anak-anak, orang tua, dan orang-orang dengan cacat. "Hukum memperkenalkan langkah-langkah untuk mengekang kenaikan harga yang tidak biasa selama krisis dan keadaan yang luar biasa, dengan demikian berkontribusi ke stabilitas pasar," tambahnya.
articles.originalTitle: Al-Qasabi: New Consumer Protection Law strengthens safeguards for most vulnerable groups
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Minister of Commerce Majid Al-Qasabi affirmed that the approval of the Consumer Protection Law, by the Council of Ministers on Tuesday, marks a significant legislative milestone in strengthening consumer rights in Saudi Arabia. “This will be achieved by establishing clear legal safeguards, regulating the relationship between consumers and commercial establishments, and promoting fair business practices. This is the first comprehensive consumer protection law in the Kingdom, guaranteeing rights and promoting fair commercial practices,” he said. Al-Qasabi stated that the law, the first comprehensive consumer protection legislation in the Kingdom, brings together the mandates of more than 20 government agencies, thereby enhancing the efficiency of oversight and reinforcing the protection of consumer rights in products and services. The law comprises 10 chapters containing 76 articles. The minister noted that the law contains provisions governing contracts and compensation for damages, safeguarding the most vulnerable groups, including children, the elderly, and people with disabilities. "The law introduces measures to curb unusual price increases during crises and exceptional circumstances, thereby contributing to market stability," he added.

articles.title: Sidang ulang jurnalis Mesir Lina Attalah ditunda di tengah kritik media yang rusak
articles.description: Persidangan ulang jurnalis Mesir Lina Attalah ditunda di tengah kritikan media yang patah hati diturunkan oleh staf MEE pada Wed, 11 / 11 / 2026 - 10: 13 Mada Pengacara editor Masr mengatakan hakim telah membentuk pandangan terhadap dirinya setelah memesan outlet 's penutupan terpisah dalam kasus Mada Masr pendiri dan editor- di - kepala Lina Attalah berbicara selama wawancara di Kairo pada 8 November 2026 (Khaled Desouki / AFP) Pengadilan Mesir pada hari Rabu menunda sidang ulang dari Mada Masr -in -kepala Lina Attalah sampai 18 November untuk mempertimbangkan permintaan pertahanan untuk membuang berita independen. Attalah menghadapi tuntutan penerbitan berita palsu dan mengoperasikan sebuah situs tanpa izin dalam sebuah kasus di mana dia dijatuhi hukuman setahun penjara karena ketidakhadirannya pada tahun 2024. Pengacara Mada Masr, Hassan Al- Azhari, mengatakan pertahanan akan mengajukan alasan untuk mencari hakim penghapusan depan sidang berikutnya, berpendapat bahwa ia telah "sudah membentuk pandangan terhadap terdakwa". Hakim ketua, Mohamed Mubarak, juga mengeluarkan putusan pada 27 Oktober dalam kasus terpisah fining Attalah tiga juta pound Mesir (sekitar $56.000) dan memerintahkan penutupan Mada Masr' s. Proses ini terjadi di tengah banyaknya media independen yang lebih luas, termasuk penahanan pada bulan September dari enam jurnalis yang bekerja untuk pemeriksaan wajah-outlet Matsadash. Mada Masr mengatakan Attalah menerima panggilan dalam kasus lisensi terbaru pada 19 Oktober, jam setelah bergabung dengan tujuh lainnya independen media Arab dalam berita independen inisiatif dimaksudkan untuk mengisi kesenjangan kiri oleh penangkapan Matsadaash. Dalam pernyataannya pada hari Rabu, Mada Masr mengatakan kasus ini didengar tanggal kembali untuk ditanyai oleh Penuntut Banding Kairo pada bulan November 2023, berikut keluhan oleh Dewan Agung untuk Peraturan Media. Keluhan tersebut mengkhawatirkan laporan yang diterbitkan setelah wabah perang Israel di Gaza pada bulan Oktober 2023. Jaksa lagi menanyai Attalah pada bulan Februari 2024 setelah Mada Masr menerbitkan laporan lain tentang Sinai Busi

Attalah faces charges of publishing false news and operating a website without a licence in a case in which she was sentenced to a year in prison in her absence in 2024. Mada Masr’s lawyer, Hassan al-Azhari, said the defence would submit its grounds for seeking the judge’s removal ahead of the next hearing, arguing that he had “already formed a view against the defendant”. The presiding judge, Mohamed Mubarak, also issued a ruling on 27 October in a separate case fining Attalah three million Egyptian pounds (about $56,000) and ordering Mada Masr’s closure. The proceedings come amid a wider crackdown on independent media, including the detention in September of all six journalists working for fact-checking outlet Matsadaash. Mada Masr said Attalah received a summons in the latest licensing case on 19 October, hours after it joined seven other independent Arab media outlets in a joint newsroom initiative intended to fill the gap left by the Matsadaash arrests. In its statement on Wednesday, Mada Masr said the case being heard dates back to questioning by the Cairo Appeals Prosecution in November 2023, following a complaint by the Supreme Council for Media Regulation. The complaint concerned a report published after the outbreak of Israel’s war on Gaza in October 2023. articles.title: Departemen Kesehatan: cuti sakit hanya setelah penilaian medis; toleransi nol untuk penyalahgunaan
articles.description: RIYADH - Kementerian Kesehatan menekankan bahwa cuti sakit diberikan sejalan dengan peraturan dan prosedur yang ditetapkan berdasarkan penilaian medis kondisi pasien, bukan pada permintaan atau preferensi pasien. Seorang dokter memutuskan berdasarkan kebutuhan yang sebenarnya dan seberapa jauh kondisi mempengaruhi kemampuan pasien untuk bekerja atau melaksanakan kegiatan sehari-hari, sehingga panjang cuti cocok dengan kesehatan pasien yang sebenarnya. Durasi cuti diatur oleh kondisi dan diagnosis, dalam wewenang yang diberikan kepada dokter dan kesehatan, kata pelayanan tersebut. Permintaan melampaui otoritas dokter membutuhkan persetujuan lebih lanjut dari dokter lain, komite medis khusus, atau badan medis yang relevan, menurut pedoman dan jangka waktu yang disetujui. Menteri menekankan bahwa cuti sakit hanya bisa diperoleh dari badan kesehatan yang sah setelah penilaian medis yang tepat. cuti elektronik dapat dilihat dalam aplikasi Sehhaty, dan keaslian cuti sakit dapat diperiksa melalui layanan penyelidikan pada platform Seha. Pengguna harus memastikan mereka berada di platform resmi dan bahwa rincian meninggalkan cocok, daripada mengandalkan pada salinan dokumen atau pada kode QR yang dapat mengarah ke situs palsu. Praktek dilarang termasuk mengeluarkan cuti sakit tanpa pembenaran medis yang sah, merusak catatan medis untuk membenarkan itu, mengeluarkan cuti melalui orang-orang tidak sah atau entitas, membantu pasien mendapatkan manfaat yang tidak layak, dan memalsukan dokumen dan isi mereka yang sakit, semua yang dikenakan akuntabilitas hukum, kata kementrian. oversight nya meliputi meninjau prosedur medis untuk mengeluarkan cuti sakit, audit fasilitas kesehatan di lapangan, menganalisis sakit meninggalkan data, dan fasilitas pengawasan 'dan praktisi' kepatuhan dengan pedoman, sebagai bagian dari peran regulasi dan kesadaran kampanye untuk praktisi dan pasien. Para praktisi perawatan kesehatan bertanggung jawab untuk integritas proses dan harus mengikuti peratu
articles.originalTitle: Health ‏ministry: Sick leave only after medical assessment; zero tolerance for misuse
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Ministry of Health emphasized that sick leave is granted in line with established regulations and procedures based on a medical assessment of the patient's condition, not at the patient's request or preference. A physician decides based on actual need and how far the condition affects the patient's ability to work or carry out daily activities, so that the length of leave matches the patient's actual health. The duration of leave is set by the condition and diagnosis, within the authority granted to physicians and healthcare entities, the ministry said. Requests beyond the attending physician's authority require further approval from other physicians, specialized medical committees, or relevant medical bodies, according to approved guidelines and timeframes. The ministry stressed that sick leave should be obtained only from authorized healthcare entities after a proper medical assessment. Electronically issued leave can be viewed in the Sehhaty app, and the authenticity of sick leave can be checked through the inquiry service on the Seha platform. Users should make sure they are on the official platform and that the leave details match, rather than relying on a copy of a document or on QR codes that may lead to fraudulent websites. Prohibited practices include issuing sick leave without valid medical justification, tampering with medical records to justify it, issuing leave through unauthorized people or entities, helping patients obtain undeserved benefits, and forging sick leave documents or their contents, all of which are subject to legal accountability, the ministry said. Its oversight includes reviewing medical procedures for issuing sick leave, auditing healthcare facilities in the field, analyzing sick leave data, and monitoring facilities' and practitioners' compliance with guidelines, as part of its regulatory role and awareness campaigns for practitioners and patients. Healthcare practitioners are responsible for the integrity of the process

articles.description: RIYADH - Departemen Perdagangan mengumumkan bahwa Undang-undang Perlindungan Konsumen, disetujui oleh Dewan Menteri pada hari Selasa, adalah undang-undang komprehensif pertama untuk mengatur hak-hak konsumen dalam produk dan jasa di bawah kerangka kerja hukum terpadu. articles.originalTitle: Maximum 2-year-jail and SR8 million fine for Consumer Protection Law violations
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Ministry of Commerce announced that the Consumer Protection Law, approved by the Council of Ministers on Tuesday, is the first comprehensive legislation to regulate consumer rights in products and services under a unified legal framework. The law will come into force 180 days after its publication in the official gazette, replacing three existing regulations: the Anti-Commercial Fraud Law, the E-Commerce Law, and the Commercial Data Law.The law prescribes penalties for violations, including fines of up to SR8 million, imprisonment for up to two years, suspension of business activities, confiscation of non-compliant products, and publication of warnings to consumers. It also introduces enhanced dispute-resolution mechanisms through simplified procedures for handling minor cases, thereby expediting access to justice. The law introduces exceptional measures to protect consumers from unusual price increases during extraordinary circumstances, crises, and pandemics. These measures include imposing temporary price controls, setting maximum profit margins, and requiring prior approval from the relevant authority before any price increase. These provisions are intended to maintain market stability and safeguard consumer interests. The Ministry of Commerce said the law addresses commercial practices that influence consumer decisions, including imposing burdensome restrictions, threatening or exerting undue influence on consumers, and charging fees for using specific payment methods. It also prohibits misleading practices, such as providing false information that deceives consumers, concealing or misrepresenting relevant information, and offering counterfeit products. The law permits comparative advertising among economic operators, enabling consumers to make fair and transparent comparisons of products and services. articles.description: Netanyahu mencari pembicaraan pribadi dengan pemimpin partai Palestina, meskipun serangan publik dilakukan oleh staf MEE di Wed, 11 / 2026 - 11: 17 Mansour Abbas mengatakan bahwa pidato perdana menteri yang menjelekkan pihak Palestina, membuat dia beresiko menjadi Perdana Menteri Benjamin Netanyahu, terlihat selama pidato pembukaan pada parlemen Israel baru di Yerusalem pada 10 November 2026 (Ilia Yefimovich), "Dia tertarik pada posisi kita pada hukum kecuali seorang penegak hukum yang didakwa dari menjabat sebagai perdana menteri, dan apakah kita benar-benar bermaksud untuk memasukkan koalisi dan menggantikan pemerintahan Netanyahu", Abbas mengatakan kepada Kan radio publik. "Ketika melayani kepentingannya, warga Arab tiba-tiba menjadi sah, ia menjadi 'Abu Yair', dan Mansour Abbas menjadi mitra layak di matanya." Daftar Arab (Ra 'am) yang dipimpin Palestina dan Daftar Gabungan memenangkan rekor 19 kursi digabungkan, menyusul lonjakan antara pemilih Palestina di Israel, memberikan mereka keseimbangan kekuasaan. articles.title: Dana HSBC 'Sarah-compliant' untuk mengecualikan perusahaan senjata setelah Israel menghubungkan pendapatan terkena
articles.description: Dana HSBC 'shari- compliant' untuk mengecualikan perusahaan senjata setelah Israel - pendapatan terkait yang diekspos oleh Imran Mulla pada Wed, 11 / 2026 - 10: 11 Move datang setelah MeE mengungkapkan HSBC Global Equity Index Fund membeli saham di perusahaan senjata terbesar di dunia sebuah cabang HSBC bank di jalan di London pada 27 Oktober 2026 (AFP) dana terbesar di Inggris "shari- compliant" yang dikeluarkan dari perusahaan-perusahaan yang mengambil lebih dari 5 persen pendapatan mereka dari persenjataan, setelah Mata Timur Tengah mengungkapkan bulan lalu bahwa dana itu membeli lebih dari $100m saham di perusahaan-perusahaan Israel terkait dengan setengah tahun pertama dalam tahun pertama militer di Israel dalam tahun ini. Perubahan baru berarti raksasa perbankan Inggris HSBC 's Islam Global Equity Index Fund diharapkan untuk mencabut dari perusahaan-perusahaan besar termasuk RTX, Rolls-Royce, Honeywell International, BAE Systems dan Palantir. Dana HSBC mulai pelacakan S & P Global 1200 Shariah Pilih Indeks, sebuah tanda tangan perusahaan disaring untuk kepatuhan dengan prinsip keuangan Islam, pada Maret. Dana tersebut secara pasif dikelola, yang berarti itu mencerminkan investasi indeks. Pada awal November, indeks diperbarui metodologinya dan diatur untuk mengimplementasikan perubahan pada 23 November. Sekarang ini akan mengecualikan pertahanan dan perusahaan senjata, kontraktor militer dan sektor terkait dari indeks. Menurut kriteria baru, indeks akan mengecualikan perusahaan dengan lebih dari 5 persen eksposur militer kontrak, senjata nuklir, habis uranium, senjata pembakar, senjata biologis dan senjata kecil, di antara jenis persenjataan lainnya. Menurut kebanyakan pedoman penyaringan, bisnis dapat dianggap "syaria- compliant" jika kurang dari 5 persen pendapatan mereka berasal dari sumber-sumber yang dikategorikan sebagai tidak dapat ditembus. Indeks sebelumnya tidak mengecualikan perusahaan dengan eksposur untuk sebagian besar jenis persenjataan. Dana HSBC diawasi oleh dewan sarjana Islam. MEE melaporkan bulan lalu bahwa dana dibeli $35.7m senilai saham di RTX, kedua dunia compa senjata terbesar

articles.originalDescription: HSBC 'sharia-compliant' fund to exclude arms companies after Israeli-linked revenue exposed Submitted by Imran Mulla on Wed, 11/11/2026 - 10:11 Move comes after MEE revealed HSBC’s Islamic Global Equity Index Fund purchased shares in world’s second-largest arms company A branch of HSBC bank on a street in central London on 27 October 2026 (AFP) Off The UK ’s largest “sharia-compliant” fund is divesting from companies which take more than 5 percent of their revenue from weaponry, after Middle East Eye revealed last month that it purchased more than $100m worth of shares in companies linked to the Israeli military in the first half of this year. The new change means the British banking giant HSBC’s Islamic Global Equity Index Fund is expected to divest from major companies including RTX, Rolls-Royce, Honeywell International, BAE Systems and Palantir. The HSBC fund began tracking the S&P Global 1200 Shariah Select Index, a benchmark of companies screened for compliance with Islamic finance principles, in March. The fund is passively managed, which means it mirrors the index's investments . In early November, the index updated its methodology and is set to implement the changes on 23 November. It will now exclude defence and weapons companies, military contractors and related sectors from the index. According to the new criteria , the index will exclude companies with a more than 5 percent exposure to military contracting, nuclear weapons, depleted uranium, incendiary weapons, biological weapons and small arms, among other types of weaponry. According to most screening guidelines, businesses can be deemed “sharia-compliant” if less than 5 percent of their income derives from sources categorised as impermissible. The index did not previously exclude companies with exposure to most types of weaponry. The HSBC fund is overseen by a board of Islamic scholars. articles.description: Sebuah perjalanan ke pantai Laut Merah Mesir untuk menemukan Sufi dan lyre mistis Dipersembahkan oleh Sean Mathews pada Mon, 11 / 09 / 2026 - 10: 44 El- Quseir pernah menyambut penjelajah, pejuang dan peziarah haji haji, tetapi hari ini adalah bypass dalam mendukung dari resor Laut Merah yang lebih besar El- Quseir diisi dengan runtuh Ottoman-era rumah dengan balconies kayu protruding (MEE / Sean Mathews) Off ElQuseir. Satu-satunya cahaya di dalam labirin yang membusuk ini dari sebuah pelabuhan datang ketika sebuah sepeda motor Bajaj mendengkur menyusuri gang aneh, melemparkan lampu di salah satu dari banyak anjing liar kota, atau seorang pejalan kaki berkedip telepon, menyalakan balkon kayu yang membusuk. Rumah walikota tua mudah ditemukan dalam kegelapan. Ini memancarkan hangat, cahaya emas. Ketika saya tiba, kerumunan sudah berkumpul di beranda tiang; beberapa orang di djallabas, yang lain dengan seragam jins kurus dari Timur Tengah. Aku melihat hipster Kairo aneh di antara mereka. Para peserta terutama berseri-seri dalam make-up. Mengapa tidak seharusnya. Malam ini adalah malam Hazz, nama, yang dalam bahasa Arab berarti keberuntungan, diberikan untuk soirees menyusuri pantai Laut Merah Mesir, mana simsimiyya, lyre segitiga, dimainkan untuk balada tentang pelabuhan tua, persahabatan dan pelaut legendaris. Simsimiyya tampak besar di atas El-Quseir. "Orang-orang di sini akan berada di laut selama empat bulan pada suatu waktu. Mereka akan menyimpan tempat pada cara mereka hanya untuk pemain Simoniyya untuk menghibur mereka," Aly El- Sayed, pendiri Bahar, sebuah organisasi komunitas bekerja untuk melestarikan warisan kota dan ekosistem laut, mengatakan kepada saya. Aly adalah tuan rumah pertemuan malam ini. Rumah walikota tua, bungalow kupu-kupu kuning dibangun pada tahun 1888, telah ditarik kembali sebagai rumah Bahar. "Kami mencoba untuk tidak banyak berubah. Kami bahkan berhati-hati untuk tidak melukis terlalu banyak," kata El-Sayed. 'Mereka bernyanyi sepanjang waktu' Saya tahu bahwa musik adalah pusat bagi kehidupan kapal dhows, tradisional kapal layar kayu, barang yang diolesi, termasuk budak, antara Afrika Timur dan Arab sampai abad pertengahan-20. articles.originalTitle: A journey down Egypt's Red Sea coast to find Sufi saints and a mystical lyre
articles.originalDescription: A journey down Egypt's Red Sea coast to find Sufi saints and a mystical lyre Submitted by Sean Mathews on Mon, 11/09/2026 - 10:44 El-Quseir once welcomed explorers, warriors and Hajj pilgrims, but today it is bypassed in favour of bigger Red Sea resorts El-Quseir is filled with crumbling Ottoman-era houses with protruding wooden balconies (MEE/Sean Mathews) Off El-Quseir is pitch black at night. The only light inside this decaying labyrinth of a port comes when a battered Bajaj motorcycle purrs down the odd alley, casting a headlight on one of the town’s many stray dogs, or a passerby flashes a phone, lighting up a decaying wooden balcony. The old mayor’s house is easy to find in the darkness. It emits a warm, golden light. When I arrive, a crowd is already gathered on the colonnaded veranda; some men in djellabas, others in the uniform skinny jeans of the Middle East. I spot the odd Cairo hipster among them. The women attendees are especially radiant in make-up. Why shouldn’t they be. Tonight is a Hazz night, the name, which in Arabic means luck, given to soirees down Egypt’s Red Sea coast, where the simsimiyya , a triangular lyre, is played to ballads about old ports, friendships and legendary seafarers. The simsimiyya looms large over El-Quseir. “The men here would be at sea for four months at a time. They would save a spot on their dhow just for a simsimiyya player to entertain them,” Aly El-Sayed, the founder of Bahar, a community organisation working to preserve the city's heritage and marine ecosystem, told me. Aly is the host of tonight’s gathering. The old mayor’s house, a butter-yellow bungalow built in 1888, has been repurposed as Bahar’s home. “We tried not to change much. We were even careful not to paint too much,” El-Sayed said. 'They sang all the time' I knew that music was central to life aboard dhows, traditional wooden sailing boats, that plied goods, including slaves, between East Africa and Arabia up until the mid-20th century. articles.originalTitle: Hundreds of British Jews accuse Board of Deputies of 'genocide denial'
articles.originalDescription: Hundreds of British Jews accuse Board of Deputies of 'genocide denial' Submitted by MEE staff on Tue, 11/10/2026 - 14:09 Open letter challenges Jewish community body over its denunciation of Green Party and response to Israel’s actions against Palestinians Members of the Jewish Bloc for Palestine take part in a Free Gaza protest, near Admiralty Arch in central London, on 1 May 1 2024 (Adrian Dennis/AFP) Off Hundreds of British Jews have accused the Board of Deputies of British Jews of “genocide denial” in an open letter condemning its decision to declare the Green Party racist over its stance on Zionism. The letter, released on Tuesday by Jews Against Genocide Denial, accuses the prominent Jewish representative organisation of shielding Israel from accountability and silencing criticism within its own ranks. Historian Avi Shlaim, former South African MP and arms trade campaigner Andrew Feinstein, and human rights lawyer Margaret Owen are among the more than 250 signatories listed in the document. The intervention follows the board’s decision on 25 October to declare that the Green Party of England and Wales had become a racist party after adopting a conference motion treating Zionism as a form of racism. The board’s resolution, passed by 118 votes to one, argued that the Green policy stigmatised a connection to Israel that forms part of many British Jews’ religious, cultural and national identity. The letter’s signatories rejected that interpretation, while stressing that they did not all share the same view of the Green motion’s merits. “Some Jewish Greens supported it, some opposed it, some thought it unnecessary, given the party’s already strong stance against Israel’s oppressive regime and war crimes,” they wrote. articles.title: Daerah Riyadh mencatat curah hujan tertinggi di 73.4 mm saat hujan mencapai enam daerah Saudi
articles.description: JEDDAH - Daerah Riyadh tercatat curah hujan tertinggi pada 73,4 milimeter sebagai Pusat Nasional Meteorologi (NCM) diukur curah hujan di enam wilayah Saudi selama periode 24 jam. The NCM diukur curah hujan antara 09: 00 pada hari Selasa, 10 November, dan 9 pagi pada hari Rabu, 11 November 2026, dengan Al- Majma 'ah di daerah Riyadh mendaftar pengukuran tertinggi. Di wilayah yang sama, Bandara Al- Dawadmi merekam 69,6 mm, diikuti oleh Royal Reserve di Umm Al- Jurum dengan 60.2 mm dan Umm Radhmah dengan 49.4 mm. Ukuran lain termasuk Shaqra di 33.8 mm, Imam Abdullah bin Mohammed Royal Reserve di 14.2 mm, Halban di Al- Quway' iyah di 13,2 mm dan Bandara Al- Thumamah di 11.4 mm. Di Qassim, Al- Sahiyah di Qibah tercatat 33.2 mm, diikuti oleh Damhnah di Al- Rass di 28.4 mm, Buraydah di 25,6 mm, Unaizah di 22.6 mm dan Pangeran Naif bin Abdullah Airport di 14.4 mm. Provinsi Timur mencatat 24 mm di pangkalan udara di Hafar Al- Batin, 17.4 mm di Umm Al- Shifrah di Qaryat Al- Ulya, 17,3 mm di Al- Qaisumah Airport, 15.6 mm di stasiun pemantauan lain di Hafar Al- Batin dan 12 mm di pangkalan udara di Jujaminan. Di wilayah Perhambaan, Al- Naphiyah tercatat 28.8 mm, diikuti oleh Al- Umrah pada 7.6 mm dan Al- Rusabfah pada 7.3 mm, pengukuran terendah terdaftar dalam laporan. Sementara itu, Alhlu di Al- Hanakiyah tercatat 28,6 mm di wilayah Madinah, sementara Al- Madain lingkungan di Hail terdaftar 8.1 mm.
articles.originalTitle: Riyadh region records highest rainfall at 73.4 mm as rain hits six Saudi regions
articles.originalDescription: JEDDAH — The Riyadh region recorded the highest rainfall at 73.4 millimeters as the National Center for Meteorology (NCM) measured precipitation across six Saudi regions over a 24-hour period. The NCM measured rainfall between 9 a.m. on Tuesday, November 10, and 9 a.m. on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, with Al-Majma'ah in Riyadh region registering the highest measurement. In the same region, Al-Dawadmi Airport recorded 69.6 mm, followed by the King Abdulaziz Royal Reserve at Umm Al-Jurum with 60.2 mm and Umm Radhmah with 49.4 mm. Other measurements included Shaqra at 33.8 mm, Imam Abdulaziz bin Mohammed Royal Reserve at 14.2 mm, Halban in Al-Quway'iyah at 13.2 mm and Al-Thumamah Airport at 11.4 mm. In Qassim, Al-Sahiyah in Qibah recorded 33.2 mm, followed by Dakhnah in Al-Rass at 28.4 mm, Buraydah at 25.6 mm, Unaizah at 22.6 mm and Prince Naif bin Abdulaziz Airport at 14.4 mm. The Eastern Province recorded 24 mm at the air base in Hafar Al-Batin, 17.4 mm in Umm Al-Shiflah in Qaryat Al-Ulya, 17.3 mm at Al-Qaisumah Airport, 15.6 mm at another monitoring station in Hafar Al-Batin and 12 mm at the air base airport in Jubail. In Makkah region, Al-Nouriyah recorded 28.8 mm, followed by Al-Umrah at 7.6 mm and Al-Rusayfah at 7.3 mm, the lowest measurement listed in the report. Meanwhile, Al-Hisu in Al-Hanakiyah recorded 28.6 mm in Madinah region, while Al-Madain neighborhood in Hail registered 8.1 mm.

articles.title: Arab Saudi, Tajikistan menandatangani perjanjian untuk memerangi persimpangan-perbatasan korupsi
articles.description: RIYADH - Arab Saudi dan Tajikistan menandatangani memorandum pemahaman (MoU) pada hari Rabu untuk memperkuat kerjasama dalam mencegah dan memerangi korupsi. Presiden Otoritas Korupsi (Nazaha), dan Sulaymon mengatakan Sultonzoda, Direktur Badan Keuangan Tajikistan dan mengombinasikan Korupsi, di hadapan Duta Saudi ke Tajikistan Khalid bin Abdullah Al- Shamrani. Media [2793052] Perjanjian ini bertujuan untuk meningkatkan kerjasama dalam memerangi korupsi transnasional, bertukar informasi tentang korupsi - pelanggaran terkait dan memperkuat kapasitas institusi dari kedua belah pihak. Selama pertemuan, para pejabat juga meninjau hubungan bilateral dan mendiskusikan cara untuk memajukan kerjasama dalam mempromosikan integritas dan memerangi korupsi. Mereka mendiskusikan lebih lanjut upaya Nazaha untuk melindungi integritas, mempromosikan transparansi dan korupsi tempur, bersama pengalaman Tajikistan di bidang yang sama.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia, Tajikistan sign agreement to combat cross-border corruption
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia and Tajikistan signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) on Wednesday to strengthen cooperation in preventing and combating corruption. The MoU was signed by Mazen bin Ibrahim Al-Kahmous, President of the Oversight and Anti-Corruption Authority (Nazaha), and Sulaymon Said Sultonzoda, Director of Tajikistan’s State Agency for Financial Control and Combating Corruption, in the presence of Saudi Ambassador to Tajikistan Khalid bin Abdullah Al-Shamrani. **media[2793052]** The agreement aims to enhance cooperation in combating transnational corruption, exchanging information on corruption-related offenses and strengthening the institutional capacities of both sides. During the meeting, the officials also reviewed bilateral relations and discussed ways to advance cooperation in promoting integrity and combating corruption. They further discussed Nazaha’s efforts to safeguard integrity, promote transparency and combat corruption, alongside Tajikistan’s experience in the same field.

articles.originalTitle: Saudi FDI inflows grow 33.5% in 2025 as foreign investment stock reaches SR1.06 trillion
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Foreign direct investment (FDI) inflows into Saudi Arabia grew 33.5 percent year-on-year to SR159.1 billion in 2025, according to the Federation of Saudi Chambers’ “Voice of Business” report. The report also highlighted that the Kingdom’s total FDI stock reached SR1.06 trillion. Meanwhile, the number of licenses for US investors reached approximately 530 by October 2026, compared with 371 in 2025. American direct investments in Saudi Arabia totaled SR55.6 billion between 2016 and 2024. The report also showed that inward FDI flows reached SR22.3 billion in the second quarter of 2026, with net FDI flows totaling SR19.1 billion. Despite the annual growth recorded in 2025, inward FDI flows declined by 16.9 percent year-on-year in the second quarter of 2026. **media[2793034]**

articles.originalTitle: Saudi private-sector bank credit hits SR3.32 trillion as investment registrations surge in 2026
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Federation of Saudi Chambers has highlighted major shifts in the Kingdom’s economy and investment landscape, with private-sector bank credit reaching SR3.324 trillion in September 2026, up 6 percent year-on-year, and 9,018 new investment registrations recorded in Q2 2026, compared with 2,561 in the same period of 2025. The federation’s “Voice of Business” report highlighted several key economic indicators, including women’s ownership of 48 percent of active business registrations and an increase in the number of Saudi women employed in the private sector to 1.13 million. Saudi women’s labor force participation also reached 33.7 percent, compared with 18 percent in 2017. **media[2793026]** The report revealed that 9,018 new investment registrations were recorded in the second quarter of 2026, compared with 2,561 during the same period in 2025, noting a change in registration methodology. Meanwhile, bank credit extended to the private sector increased by 6 percent year-on-year to SR3.324 trillion in September 2026, marking a rise of SR27.8 billion from the previous month. Financing for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) also increased by 16.5 percent year-on-year to SR490.8 billion in the second quarter of 2026, accounting for 11.7 percent of total credit facilities. The report also highlighted regional employment growth, with six regions outside Riyadh, Makkah and the Eastern Province exceeding the national private-sector employment growth rate of 7 percent in the second quarter of 2026. Najran recorded the highest growth at 45.7 percent, followed by Hail at 13.7 percent, Qassim at 11.5 percent, the Northern Borders at 10.5 percent, Asir at 9 percent and Jazan at 7.9 percent. **media[2793027]** On the regulatory front, the federation outlined the provisions of the new Commercial Transactions Law, comprising 271 articles and replacing three existing laws: the Commercial Law, the Commercial Papers Law and the Commercial Books Law. articles.title: "Yang bisa saya lakukan adalah memeluk anak-anak saya dan menangis ': Palestina di Gaza menghadapi banjir musim dingin yang mematikan
articles.description: "Yang bisa saya lakukan adalah memeluk anak-anak saya dan menangis ': Palestina di Gaza menghadapi banjir musim dingin yang mematikan Di MEE Live, Jurnalis Palestina, Nada Nabil berbicara kepada jurnalis MeE James Schneider tentang bagaimana hujan lebat dan banjir yang semakin parah bagi keluarga pengungsi di Gaza, di mana banyak yang tinggal di tenda dan rumah yang rusak. Nabil mengatakan orang yang biasanya akan menyambut hujan sekarang takut itu. Dia menceritakan bagaimana seorang ibu mengatakan kepadanya bahwa semua dia bisa lakukan adalah memeluk anak-anaknya, menangis dan menjanjikan mereka hari yang lebih baik ketika matahari kembali. Banjir datang ketika Palestina di Gaza terus menghadapi konsekuensi pembatasan Israel pada bantuan kemanusiaan memasuki Gaza. Meskipun gencatan senjata, Israel terus menghalangi masuk persediaan penting, termasuk tenda, selimut dan bahan yang diperlukan untuk memperbaiki infrastruktur yang rusak. Di MEE Live, Jurnalis Palestina, Nada Nabil berbicara kepada jurnalis MeE James Schneider tentang bagaimana hujan lebat dan banjir yang semakin parah bagi keluarga pengungsi di Gaza, di mana banyak yang tinggal di tenda dan rumah yang rusak. https: / / t.co / 74Zd01f8u - Middle East Eye (@ MiddleEastEye) November 10, 2026
articles.originalTitle: ‘All I can do is hug my children and cry’: Palestinians in Gaza face deadly winter floods
articles.originalDescription: ‘All I can do is hug my children and cry’: Palestinians in Gaza face deadly winter floods On MEE Live, Palestinian journalist Nada Nabil spoke to MEE journalist James Schneider about how heavy rains and flooding are worsening conditions for displaced families in Gaza, where many are living in tents and damaged homes. Nabil said people who would normally welcome the rain are now afraid of it. She recounted how one mother told her that all she could do was hug her children, cry and promise them better days when the sun returned. The flooding comes as Palestinians in Gaza continue to face the consequences of Israel’s restrictions on humanitarian aid entering Gaza. Despite the ceasefire, Israel continues to obstruct the entry of essential supplies, including tents, blankets and materials needed to repair damaged infrastructure. articles.title: Jepang menjanjikan $1.97m untuk mendukung respon kesehatan Gaza
articles.description: Jepang menjanjikan $1.97m untuk mendukung respon kesehatan Gaza Jepang menandatangani perjanjian dengan Organisasi Kesehatan Dunia pada hari Selasa untuk menyediakan sekitar $1.97 juta untuk mendukung respon kesehatan di Gaza, Wafa melaporkan, mengutip kantor perwakilan Jepang ke Palestina. Perjanjian ini ditandatangani di Ramallah oleh perwakilan Jepang untuk Palestina, Katsuhiko Araike, dan WHO perwakilan di wilayah Palestina yang ditempati, Reinhilde Van De Weerdt. Komponen utama dari hibah ini adalah pembentukan sel koordinasi Tim Medis Darurat (EMT) dalam Pusat Operasi Darurat Kementerian di Gaza City, menurut laporan tersebut.
articles.originalTitle: Japan pledges $1.97m to support Gaza health response
articles.originalDescription: Japan pledges $1.97m to support Gaza health response Japan signed an agreement with the World Health Organisation on Tuesday to provide approximately $1.97 million to support the health response in Gaza, Wafa reported, citing Japan’s representative office to Palestine. The agreement was signed in Ramallah by Japan’s representative to Palestine, Katsuhiko Araike, and WHO representative in the occupied Palestinian territory, Reinhilde Van De Weerdt. A key component of the grant is the establishment of an Emergency Medical Team (EMT) coordination cell within the Ministry’s Emergency Operations Centre in Gaza City, the report said.

articles.originalDescription: US House Democrat leader Jeffries will retain position despite opposition, sources say Submitted by Yasmine El-Sabawi on Tue, 11/10/2026 - 19:15 In the Senate, unless progressive-backed Chris Van Hollen formally steps up to unite the ranks as a challenger, Chuck Schumer will likely win The leader of the House Democrats, New York Congressman Hakeem Jeffries, right, speaks to reporters alongside the leader of the Senate Democrats, New York Senator Chuck Schumer, on the steps of the US Senate on 21 May 2026 in Washington, DC (Win McNamee/Getty Images via AFP) Off The top Democrat in the House of Representatives, Hakeem Jeffries, is all but certain to become the next Speaker of the House, despite dissatisfaction among some freshman lawmakers and their progressive colleagues in the chamber, sources have told Middle East Eye. There simply is no alternative leader in the running. "It's a cost to go against someone who will eventually be the leader of the caucus. There's not enough people who are willing to do that," one source said. This comes as many voters have expressed their desire to see Jeffries vacate the position, accusing him of being out of step with the party's growing leftist progressive wing, which wants to see money out of politics, and a stop to the transfer of weapons to Israel. New lawmakers are looking to work with him instead, three sources familiar with the internal process on Capitol Hill confirmed to MEE. The 56-year-old Jeffries is backed by pro-Israel lobbying groups and has made it clear he is an avowed protector of Israel . He has also received substantial financial support from a litany of big corporations , including tech and weapons manufacturers. Perhaps most importantly, his candidacy in his New York district and his leadership bid were endorsed by progressive kingmaker and New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani - much to the chagrin of Mamdani's own supporters. articles.originalTitle: Petition opposing Hakeem Jeffries as US House Speaker passes one million signatures
articles.originalDescription: Petition opposing Hakeem Jeffries as US House Speaker passes one million signatures Submitted by Mounira Elsamra on Tue, 11/10/2026 - 19:08 Jeffries is expected to become the first Black speaker when the new Congress convenes in January US House of Representatives Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries speaks during a press conference at the US Capitol in Washington, DC, on 9 November 2026 (Jim Watson/AFP) Off More than a million people have signed a petition urging Democrats to reject Hakeem Jeffries as the next Speaker of the US House of Representatives, as growing opposition to his leadership puts his support for Israel and US foreign policy under renewed scrutiny. Jeffries, who currently leads the House Democrats, is expected to become the first Black speaker when the new Congress convenes in January, after the Democrats' sweeping midterm victories on 3 November. But Jeffries is not the speaker-elect yet. He confirmed his candidacy last week, but his colleagues must elect him later this month. Jeffries stands currently uncontested, with no other Democratic lawmaker throwing their hat in the ring for the position. While no one in the party has come forward to run against Jeffries, several newly elected lawmakers have voiced reservations about his policy positions, casting doubt on whether or not they will endorse him. Some voters and influencers have mobilised, with dozens of viral videos urging citizens to call their representatives and sign the petition against Jeffries. “We believe the Speaker should represent the Democratic voters, not just the Democratic establishment,” says the petition put forward by social media influencer Nicole Whitted . The petition calls on representatives to examine Jeffries' public record, policy positions, campaign donor record, and leadership. articles.title: Arab Saudi meminta untuk segera mengakhiri semua ancaman ke navigasi maritim
articles.description: RIYADH - Dewan Menteri Saudi telah menyerukan penghentian segera dari semua tindakan yang mengancam keselamatan navigasi maritim dan melemahkan keamanan jalur air vital, terutama Laut Merah, Bab Al- Mandab Strait, dan Selat Hormuz. Kabinet kembali posisi ini selama sesi dipimpin oleh Putra Mahkota dan Perdana Menteri Mohammed bin Salman di Riyadh pada hari Selasa. Dalam peninjauan tentang pengembangan regional dan internasional, Kabinet menegaskan kembali komitmen kerajaan yang tak tergoyahkan untuk mendukung semua upaya yang bertujuan untuk memperkuat daerah dan keamanan global dan stabilitas, ketika menghadapi terorisme dan membongkar milisi kriminalnya. Pada awal sesi ini, Putra Mahkota menjelaskan Kabinet tentang hasil pembicaraannya dengan Raja Hamad bin Isa Al Khalifa dari Bahrain dan Presiden Suriah Ahmed Al- Sharaa. Dia juga memberi penjelasan kepada Kabinet tentang pesan yang dia terima dari Presiden Dr. Julius Maada Bio dari Sierra Leone dan pada panggilan teleponnya dengan Perdana Menteri Kanada Mark Carney dan Perdana Menteri Republik Hellenic Kyriakos Mitsotakis. Konsultasi dan pembicaraan-pembicaraan mengenai hubungan bilateral Arab Saudi dengan negara-negara mereka dan cara-cara untuk memperkuat mereka, dan mendasari pentingnya koordinasi terus-menerus pada isu-isu internasional dan regional. Dalam pernyataan kepada Badan Pers Saudi setelah sesi ini, Menteri Media Salman Al- Dossary mengatakan Kabinet menyambut penandatanganan Perjanjian Umum pada Proyek GCC Railway untuk menghubungkan negara anggota Dewan Kolaborasi Teluk (GCC). Kabinet juga mengomentari upaya yang berkelanjutan untuk memajukan kerjasama strategis dan integrasi ekonomi dan pengembangan dan melanjutkan melaksanakan visi Raja Salman untuk memperkuat aksi GCC bersama, mencapai tujuan bersama, dan memenuhi aspirasi masyarakat negara-negara GCC. articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia calls for immediate end to all threats to maritime navigation
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Saudi Council of Ministers has called for an immediate cessation of all acts that threaten the safety of maritime navigation and undermine the security of vital waterways, particularly the Red Sea, the Bab Al-Mandab Strait, and the Strait of Hormuz. The Cabinet reiterated this position during its session chaired by Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman in Riyadh on Tuesday. In its review of regional and international developments, the Cabinet reaffirmed the Kingdom’s unwavering commitment to supporting all efforts aimed at strengthening regional and global security and stability, while confronting terrorism and dismantling its criminal militias. At the outset of the session, the Crown Prince briefed the Cabinet on the outcomes of his talks with King Hamad bin Isa Al Khalifa of Bahrain and Syrian President Ahmed Al-Sharaa. He also briefed the Cabinet on the message he received from President Dr. Julius Maada Bio of Sierra Leone and on his phone calls with Prime Minister of Canada Mark Carney and Prime Minister of the Hellenic Republic Kyriakos Mitsotakis. articles.title: F1 star Lewis Hamilton mengunjungi perbatasan Gaza
articles.description: F1 bintang Lewis Hamilton mengunjungi perbatasan Gaza Formula Satu bintang Lewis Hamilton mengunjungi perbatasan Rafah Mesir menyeberang pada hari Selasa dan bertemu pekerja bantuan memberikan bantuan ke Jalur Gaza yang rusak perang, menurut pernyataan pemerintah Mesir. Gubernur Sinai Utara "Khaled Megawer membawa Lewis Hamilton berkunjung ke tanah Rafah menyeberang untuk belajar tentang upaya-upaya Mesir untuk mendukung saudara-saudara Palestina di Jalur Gaza", pernyataan yang dibaca. Video yang dibagikan oleh kantor Megawer menunjukkan tujuh kali juara dunia menyambut para pekerja bantuan dan belajar tentang upaya mereka untuk mendapatkan pasokan ke Gaza, di mana minggu ini hujan lebat menyapu bersih puluhan ribu tenda. Menurut gencatan senjata Israel dan Hamas tahun lalu, setidaknya 600 truk bantuan per hari harus masuk Gaza, di mana lebih dari dua juta orang menghadapi krisis kemanusiaan yang parah. Pekerja bantuan mengatakan hanya sebagian kecil dari jumlah tersebut yang diijinkan oleh otoritas Israel, yang mengendalikan semua masuk ke wilayah tersebut. Ferrari Formula Salah satu juara dunia Lewis Hamilton berbicara dengan Gubernur Sinai Utara Khaled Megawer selama kunjungannya ke perbatasan Rafah persimpangan antara Mesir dan Jalur Gaza untuk melihat upaya langsung untuk menerima kemanusiaan dan bantuan bantuan bantuan yang terikat untuk Jalur Gaza, di Rafah, Mesir, 10 November 2026 (Reuters)
articles.originalTitle: F1 star Lewis Hamilton visits Gaza border
articles.originalDescription: F1 star Lewis Hamilton visits Gaza border Formula One star Lewis Hamilton visited Egypt's Rafah border crossing on Tuesday and met aid workers delivering assistance to the war-battered Gaza Strip, according to an Egyptian government statement. North Sinai governor "Khaled Megawer took Lewis Hamilton on a visit to the Rafah land crossing to learn about the Egyptian efforts to support the Palestinian brothers in the Gaza Strip", the statement read. Video shared by Megawer's office showed the seven-time world champion greeting aid workers and learning about their efforts to get supplies into Gaza, where this week heavy rains swept away tens of thousands of tents. According to a truce struck by Israel and Hamas last year, at least 600 trucks of aid per day should enter Gaza, where more than two million people are facing a severe humanitarian crisis. Aid workers say only a fraction of that amount is being allowed through by Israeli authorities, who control all entry into the territory. Ferrari's Formula One world champion Lewis Hamilton speaks with North Sinai Governor Khaled Megawer during his visit to the Rafah border crossing between Egypt and the Gaza Strip to see firsthand efforts to receive humanitarian and relief aid bound for the Gaza Strip, in Rafah, Egypt, 10 November 2026 (Reuters)

articles.title: Putra Mahkota Saudi, Raja Bahrain menjanjikan keamanan daerah yang lebih kuat dan stabilitas
articles.description: RIYADH - Putra Mahkota dan Perdana Menteri Mohammed bin Salman menerima Raja Hamad bin Isa Al Khalifa dari Bahrain di Riyadh pada hari Selasa. Selama pertemuan mereka, para pemimpin meninjau hubungan sejarah antara dua negara, bidang kerjasama bilateral, dan cara untuk memperkuat dan mengembangkan mereka. Mereka mendiskusikan perkembangan wilayah terbaru dan upaya untuk meningkatkan keamanan dan stabilitas di wilayah tersebut. Raja Hamad memuji upaya dari Penjaga dari Dua Masjid Suci Raja Salman dan Putra Mahkota untuk memperkuat hubungan antara dua negara, memuji Kerajaan terhormat, bersejarah, dan sikap persahabatan terhadap Bahrain dan rakyatnya dalam berbagai kesempatan dan dukungan untuk Bahrain di semua tingkatan. Dia juga menyatakan apresiasi atas upaya kepemimpinan Saudi untuk memajukan aksi Teluk bersama dan peran penting dalam meletakkan dasar keamanan, perdamaian, dan stabilitas di wilayah tersebut. Dan berharap Bahrain dan rakyatnya melanjutkan pembangunan dan kemajuan. Pada awal pertemuan itu, Putra Mahkota menyambut raja Bahrain ke Kerajaan, dan raja berterima kasih kepadanya untuk penerimaan hangat dan keramahan murah hati. Putra Mahkota menyampaikan salam kepada Raja Salman kepada Raja Bahrain, yang membalas menyampaikan salamnya kepada Raja Salman. Pertemuan ini dihadiri oleh Emir Pangeran Faisal bin Bandar, Menteri Dalam Negeri, dan Anggota Kabinet Pangeran Turki bin Mohammed bin Fahd, Menteri Sport Pangeran Abdullah bin bin Turki Alfaisal, Menteri Dalam Negeri, Pangeran Abdullah bin Saud bin Naif, Menteri Keamanan Nasional, * Media (27929904) * Dari sisi Bahraini, pertemuan itu dihadiri oleh Putra Mahkota dan Perdana Menteri Pangeran Salman bin-Hamad Al Khalifa; Menteri dari Pengadilan Kerajaan Sheikh bin Ahmed bin Salman Al Khalifa; Penasehat kepada Raja untuk Raja Nabeel bin Yaaqob Al- Hamad Al Khalifa, Penasehat Pengurus Pengurus Nasional, Theyab bin Saqr Al Nuajii, dan Duta Besar Bahraini untuk Arab Saudi Sheikh Ali bin Abdulrahman Al Khalifa.

articles.title: Pemilihan Michigan: Bagaimana kritikus Abdul El- Sayed meremukkan pertahanan orang Palestina sebagai 'benci'
articles.description: Pemilihan Michigan: Bagaimana kritikus Abdul El- Sayed dioleskan pembelaannya terhadap Palestina sebagai 'benci' Diberikan oleh Murad Idris pada Fri, 11 / 06 / 2026 - 20: 51 Dengan menyerang motivasinya, lawan-lawan Senator Amerika Serikat, berpaling perdebatan atas dukungan AS terhadap genosida Israel di Gaza menjadi persidangan karakter Abdul El- Sayed (kiri) memenangkan kursi Senat AS Michigan pada 3 November, dua hari setelah Haley Stevens (pusat), Partai Demokrat dia mengalahkan di primer, mendukung lawan Republik-nya Mike-Sayed (kanan) (Jeff Schusky, Jim Watson dan Blake Fagan / AFAP) dalam pidato kemenangannya minggu lalu, Kiriman Elhman "kata-kali" berbeda, Dia ingat para pendukungnya bertanya mengapa dia tidak pernah menyebut lawannya penuh kebencian. Mereka lawan, katanya, "benci ide" dari Amerika cukup besar bagi orang-orang yang berdoa berbeda. Dia mengatakan kepada Mike Rogers, Republik yang baru saja dia kalahkan, "Kau memilih benci, dan Michigan memilih harapan". Kemudian dia berpaling kepada mereka yang menyebut orang-orang kebencian karena percaya bahwa anak-anak Palestina tidak boleh dibunuh dengan uang pajak Amerika: "Itu bukan kebencian. Ini cinta". Dalam satu pidato, Sayed menolak kata "benci", mengubahnya, menggunakannya sebagai senjata dan menolaknya sebagai nama. Retorika kebencian adalah mata uang politik Amerika. Hal ini digemari, diperdagangkan dan dibelanjakan, dan membeli berdiri moral, yang mengubah menjadi suara dan dukungan. Semua orang perdagangan di dalamnya, termasuk orang itu ditujukan pada, tetapi nilai yang sebenarnya adalah memilah kelompok ke mereka dituduh kebencian dan mereka yang membuat tuduhan. Ikuti sirkulasi melalui Michigan. "Benci" Diikat sepanjang kampanyenya. Rogers secara teratur mencela "ideologi kebencian" nya. Satu Demokrat memberitahu CNN dia tidak bisa memilih Sayed "karena aku menentang kebencian". Anggota Kongres Demokratik Haley Stevens, yang dikalahkan Sayed di pemilihan utama, menukar dukungannya dengan Rogers, "memilih negara ketimbang kebencian". Dia mengumumkan itu setelah menghadiri

He recalled supporters asking why he never called his opponents hateful. Those opponents, he said, "hate the idea" of an America big enough for people who pray differently. He told Mike Rogers, the Republican he had just beaten, "You chose hate, and Michigan chose hope." Then he turned to those who call people hateful for believing that Palestinian children should not be killed with American tax dollars: " That's not hate . It's love." In one speech, Sayed declined the word "hate", turned it around, used it as a weapon and refused it as a name. The rhetoric of hate is the currency of American politics . It gets minted, exchanged and spent, and it buys moral standing, which converts into votes and endorsements . Everyone trades in it, including the man it was aimed at, but its real value is sorting groups into those accused of hate and those who make the accusation. Follow its circulation through Michigan. "Hate" hounded Sayed throughout his campaign. Rogers regularly denounced his "hateful ideology". One Democrat told CNN he could not vote for Sayed "because I'm against hate". articles.title: Api Israel membunuh tujuh orang, termasuk ayah dan anak, di Gaza
articles.description: Api Israel membunuh tujuh orang, termasuk seorang ayah dan anak, di Gaza pasukan Israel membunuh setidaknya tujuh orang Palestina, termasuk seorang ayah dan putranya yang berusia 13 tahun, di Jalur Gaza pada hari Selasa, pejabat kesehatan setempat mengatakan. Dokter mengatakan Fadi Rajab dan anaknya Abubakr tewas dalam serangan udara yang menghantam atap sebuah tempat penampungan perpindahan di Zeitoun lingkungan di Gaza City. Seorang Palestina ketiga tewas dalam serangan udara Israel dekat sekolah di lingkungan kota Gaza Daraj, tambahan petugas kesehatan. Di Khan Younis, di Gaza Selatan, tembakan Israel membunuh seorang pria, kata petugas medis. Kemudian pada hari Selasa, sebuah serangan udara Israel mengenai pengecoran logam di lingkungan kota Sabra di Gaza, membunuh tiga orang, petugas medis berkata, mengambil korban tewas setidaknya tujuh hari.
articles.originalTitle: Israeli fire kills seven, including a father and son, in Gaza
articles.originalDescription: Israeli fire kills seven, including a father and son, in Gaza Israeli forces killed at least seven Palestinians, including a father and his 13-year-old son, in the Gaza Strip on Tuesday, local health officials said. Medics said Fadi Rajab and his son Abubakr were killed in an air strike that hit the roof of a displacement shelter in the Zeitoun neighbourhood in Gaza City. A third Palestinian was killed in an Israeli air strike near a school in Gaza City's Daraj neighbourhood, health officials added. In Khan Younis, in southern Gaza, Israeli gunfire killed a man, medics said. Later on Tuesday, an Israeli air strike hit a metal foundry in the Sabra neighbourhood of Gaza City, killing three people, medics said, taking the day's death toll to at least seven.

articles.description: PARIS - Saudi Menteri Luar Negeri Pangeran Faisal bin Farhan bertemu dengan Ukraina Menteri Luar Negeri Andrii Sybiha di Paris pada hari Selasa. Pertemuan diadakan di pinggir Grup Tujuh (G7) pertemuan menteri. Selama pertemuan, para menteri meninjau hubungan bilateral dan cara untuk memperkuat lebih lanjut dan mengembangkan mereka di berbagai bidang. Mereka mendiskusikan upaya bersama untuk mencapai perdamaian dan pandangan pertukaran pada kunci regional dan internasional isu kepentingan bersama. articles.originalDescription: PARIS — Saudi Minister of Foreign Affairs Prince Faisal bin Farhan met with Ukrainian Minister for Foreign Affairs Andrii Sybiha in Paris on Tuesday. The meeting was held on the sidelines of the Group of Seven (G7) ministerial meeting. During the meeting, the ministers reviewed bilateral relations and ways to further strengthen and develop them across various fields. They discussed joint efforts to achieve peace and exchanged views on key regional and international issues of mutual interest. Following the meeting, the ministers signed a memorandum of understanding between the government of Saudi Arabia and the Cabinet of Ministers of Ukraine on the mutual exemption from short-stay visa requirements for holders of diplomatic, special, and service passports.

The meeting was held on the sidelines of the Group of Seven (G7) ministerial meeting in Paris. The meeting addressed recent developments in the Middle East, including the terrorist Houthi militia’s continued attacks on civilians and civilian objects in Yemen and Saudi Arabia and their implications for regional security. Participants also discussed diplomatic efforts to support mediation between the United States and Iran to de-escalate tensions and contain ongoing regional crises. The ministers underscored the importance of strengthening international coordination to secure regional waterways, keep trade flowing, and maintain global supply chains.

articles.originalDescription: ‘We woke up soaking wet’: Gaza’s displaced face another winter of floods and collapsed shelters For the past four days, Nahla al-Majdoub, 48, and her family of eight have been staying with neighbours in the west of Gaza City after their tent was destroyed by the latest heavy rainfall. Majdoub and her family had been sheltering in a makeshift tent at the port of Gaza for nearly two years after their home in the northern Gaza Strip was destroyed during Israel’s ground invasion. But when heavy rain and strong winds swept across the besieged enclave last week, their fragile shelter could no longer protect them. They were asleep when the storm began. They woke to the sound of thunder and rainwater pouring into their shelter, seeping through the roof and flooding the ground beneath their tent. “

articles.title: Departemen kota memperingatkan SR5.000 denda untuk menjual tembakau ke bawah - 18s
articles.description: RIYADH - Kementerian Kota dan Perumahan menekankan bahwa penjualan atau ketentuan produk tembakau kepada siapa pun di bawah usia 18 adalah dilarang, dan bahwa pelanggar menghadapi hukuman termasuk denda maksimum dari SR5.000, penetapan wajib penutupan, dan dua kali lipat hukuman untuk pelanggaran berulang. Menteri menginstruksikan bahwa pendirian harus mematuhi peraturan yang mengatur aktivitas. Ini menunjukkan bahwa larangan juga meluas untuk memungkinkan siapa pun di bawah 18 untuk masuk ke toko-toko yang khusus dalam menjual produk tembakau atau daerah yang ditunjuk untuk melayani mereka. Ini menambahkan bahwa peraturan mengatur toko tembakau memungkinkan penjual untuk meminta bukti bahwa pembeli telah mencapai usia hukum. Menteri memperingatkan bahwa kedua pelanggaran dianggap pelanggaran serius, masing-masing membawa denda hingga SR5,000, tergantung pada klasifikasi yang relevan kotamadya atau otoritas lokal. Menteri mencatat bahwa pendirian mungkin juga ditutup sesuai dengan peraturan yang berlaku, dan bahwa denda dua kali lipat dalam hal pelanggaran berulang. Selain itu, menteri mengatakan peraturan yang mengatur toko tembakau membutuhkan pendirian untuk menampilkan tanda-tanda peringatan tentang harms merokok dan jelas negara bahwa entri dan penjualan dilarang bagi mereka di bawah usia hukum. Mereka juga melarang menjual rokok individu dan mendistribusikan produk tembakau melalui penawaran promosi gratis, hadiah, hadiah, atau sampel. Pembangunan juga harus mematuhi standar yang disetujui oleh Otoritas Makanan dan Narkoba Saudi. Departemen mendesak pemilik untuk mematuhi peraturan, serta untuk memastikan bahwa karyawan akrab dengan aturan mengatur aktivitas dan hukuman untuk pelanggaran, dan pelanggaran batas. Menteri juga mengundang mereka untuk berkonsultasi dengan persyaratan rinci untuk menjual dan melayani produk tembakau di website.
articles.originalTitle: Municipalities ministry warns of SR5,000 fine for selling tobacco to under-18s
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The Ministry of Municipalities and Housing stressed that the sale or provision of tobacco products to anyone under the age of 18 is prohibited, and that the violators face penalties including a maximum fine of SR5,000, mandatory establishment closure, and doubled penalties for repeat offenses.The ministry instructed that establishments must comply with the regulations governing the activity.It indicated that the ban also extends to permitting anyone under 18 to enter shops that specialize in selling tobacco products or areas designated for serving them. It added that the regulations governing tobacco shops allow sellers to request proof that a buyer has reached the legal age.The ministry warned that both violations are considered serious offenses, each carrying a fine of up to SR5,000, depending on the classification of the relevant municipality or local authority. The ministry noted that the establishment may also be closed in accordance with applicable regulations, and that the fine doubles in the event of a repeat violation.Moreover, the ministry said the regulations governing tobacco shops require establishments to display warning signs about the harms of smoking and clearly state that entry and sales are prohibited for those below the legal age. They also prohibit selling individual cigarettes and distributing tobacco products through free promotional offers, gifts, prizes, or samples. Establishments must also comply with the standards approved by the Saudi Food and Drug Authority.The ministry urged establishment owners to comply with the regulations, as well as to ensure that employees are familiar with the rules governing the activity and the penalties for violations, and curb breaches. The ministry also invited them to consult the detailed requirements for selling and serving tobacco products on its website.

articles.title: Pendapatan Energi Saudi meningkat 115% menjadi SR87,2 miliar dalam sembilan bulan pertama 2026
articles.description: RIYADH - Saudi Energy (SE) melaporkan peningkatan pendapatan tahun 115 persen untuk SR87.2 miliar selama sembilan bulan pertama 2026, sementara keuntungan bersih naik 4.3 persen ke SR12.1 miliar, menurut hasil keuangan perusahaan. Perusahaan tersebut mengumumkan bahwa pendapatan sebelum depresiasi, amortisasi, bunga, dan pajak (EBITDA) meningkat sebesar 6,6 persen ke SR34.7 miliar, didukung oleh investasi strategis, perluasan kepemilikan aset yang diatur dan permintaan listrik. Di kuartal ketiga saja, pendapatan naik 12,9 persen ke SR35 miliar, sedangkan keuntungan bersih meningkat 0,4 persen ke SR5.4 miliar. SEE Chief Executive Officer Khalid Al- Ghamdi mengatakan perusahaan terus memenuhi permintaan listrik meningkat sementara meningkatkan ketersediaan pembangkit listrik, jaringan keandalan dan efisiensi operasional. Dia menyoroti bahwa kapasitas energi operasional penyimpanan energi mencapai 22 gigawatt-jam, mencapai target perusahaan 2026 dan memperkuat kemampuan jaringan listrik untuk mengintegrasikan sumber energi terbarukan. Basis aset yang diatur perusahaan diperluas 16,6 persen tahun ke tahun SR278.8 pada 30 September 2026, didukung oleh investasi terus dalam infrastruktur transmisi dan distribusi. Pengeluaran modal yang disesuaikan berdiri di SR59,6 miliar selama sembilan bulan pertama dalam setahun, sementara SE menandatangani perjanjian pembiayaan senilai sekitar SR64.4 miliar melalui sukuk dan berbagai fasilitas kredit. Secara operasional, puncak permintaan listrik di Kerajaan naik 2,5 persen ke 79.045 megawatt, sementara kapasitas total generasi mencapai 56,8 gigawatt. Kapasitas energi terbarukan yang terhubung ke jaringan nasional mencapai sekitar 19,3 gigawatt, sedangkan jaringan transmisi SE diperluas 6 persen ke 11,950 kilometer sirkuit. Markas pelanggan perusahaan mencapai sekitar 11.7 juta, dengan 237.762 pelanggan baru yang terhubung selama sembilan bulan pertama 2026, mewakili peningkatan 30 persen tahun-tahun. articles.originalTitle: Saudi Energy revenue rises 11.5% to SR87.2 billion in first nine months of 2026
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Energy (SE) reported an 11.5 percent year-on-year increase in revenue to SR87.2 billion during the first nine months of 2026, while net profit rose 4.3 percent to SR12.1 billion, according to the company's latest financial results. The company announced that earnings before depreciation, amortization, interest, zakat and taxes (EBITDA) increased by 6.6 percent to SR34.7 billion, supported by strategic investments, an expanding regulated asset base and growing electricity demand. In the third quarter alone, revenue climbed 12.9 percent to SR35 billion, while net profit increased 0.4 percent to SR5.4 billion. SE Chief Executive Officer Khalid Al-Ghamdi said the company continued to meet rising electricity demand while improving power plant availability, grid reliability and operational efficiency. He highlighted that operational battery energy storage capacity reached 22 gigawatt-hours, achieving the company's 2026 target and strengthening the electricity grid's ability to integrate renewable energy sources. The company's regulated asset base expanded by 16.6 percent year-on-year to SR278.8 billion as of September 30, 2026, supported by continued investments in transmission and distribution infrastructure. Adjusted capital expenditure stood at SR59.6 billion during the first nine months of the year, while SE signed financing agreements worth approximately SR64.4 billion through sukuk and various credit facilities. Operationally, peak electricity demand in the Kingdom rose 2.5 percent to 79,045 megawatts, while total generation capacity reached 56.8 gigawatts. Renewable energy capacity connected to the national grid reached approximately 19.3 gigawatts, while SE's transmission network expanded by 6 percent to 110,950 circuit kilometers. The company's customer base reached approximately 11.7 million, with 237,762 new customers connected during the first nine months of 2026, representing a 30 percent year-on-year increase. articles.title: Pendaftaran manufaktur Saudi naik 18% menjadi lebih dari 255.000 di Q3 2026
articles.description: RIYADH - Registrasi komersial aktif di sektor manufaktur Arab Saudi tumbuh 18 persen, sementara pertambangan dan penjajahan rezim meningkat 13 persen pada akhir kuartal ketiga 2026, menurut Departemen Perdagangan. Menteri melaporkan bahwa pendaftaran komersial aktif dalam produksi mencapai 255.188, dibandingkan dengan 215.697 selama periode yang sama pada tahun 2025. Sementara itu, sektor pertambangan dan penjajahan mencatat 12,831 pendaftaran komersial aktif, naik dari 11.263 selama periode yang sesuai tahun lalu. Registrasi komersial untuk pembuatan panel surya dan komponen mereka naik sebesar 33 persen, mencapai 1.700 pada akhir kuartal ketiga 2026, dibandingkan dengan 1.270 selama periode yang sama pada 2025. Registrasi untuk pembuatan dan perakitan mesin mobil dan komponen mereka meningkat 45 persen, mencapai 1.207, dibandingkan dengan 832 selama periode yang berhubungan tahun lalu. Menteri mengatakan pertumbuhan didorong oleh upaya untuk memperkuat sektor industri dan mengoptimalkan penggunaan sumber daya alam, sejalan dengan Saudi Vision 2030 tujuan. Hal ini menambah peningkatan perkembangan peluang bisnis dan investasi, diversifikasi ekonomi, dukungan untuk perusahaan kecil dan menengah, dan sektor swasta berkembang dalam industri nasional berkembang, berkontribusi terhadap persaingan ekonomi dan tujuan dari Saudi Vision 2030.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi manufacturing registrations rise 18% to over 255,000 in Q3 2026
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Active commercial registrations in Saudi Arabia’s manufacturing sector grew by 18 percent, while mining and quarrying registrations increased by 13 percent by the end of the third quarter of 2026, according to the Ministry of Commerce. The ministry reported that active commercial registrations in manufacturing reached 255,188, compared with 215,697 during the same period in 2025. Meanwhile, the mining and quarrying sector recorded 12,831 active commercial registrations, up from 11,263 during the corresponding period last year. Commercial registrations for the manufacture of solar panels and their components rose by 33 percent, reaching 1,700 by the end of the third quarter of 2026, compared with 1,270 during the same period in 2025. Registrations for the manufacture and assembly of automobile engines and their components increased by 45 percent, reaching 1,207, compared with 832 during the corresponding period last year. The ministry said the growth was driven by efforts to strengthen the industrial sector and optimize the use of natural resources, in line with Saudi Vision 2030 objectives. It added that the increase reflects expanding business and investment opportunities, economic diversification, support for small and medium-sized enterprises, and the private sector’s growing role in developing national industries, contributing to economic competitiveness and the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030.

articles.title: Pertahanan Sipil Saudi mengeluarkan peringatan merah di seluruh 7 daerah sebagai hujan lebat Kerajaan menyapu
articles.description: RIYADH - Pertahanan Sipil Saudi telah mengeluarkan peringatan merah untuk hujan lebat di bagian dari tujuh wilayah kerajaan, termasuk Riyadh, Mekah, Madinah, Asir, Jazan, Hail dan Qassim, hujan lebat November terus menyapu seluruh Arab Saudi. Peringatan, berdasarkan peringatan dari National Center for Meteorology (NCM), cuaca tertutup kondisi mempengaruhi bagian dari tujuh daerah. Pertahanan sipil mendesak warga untuk mengambil tindakan pencegahan selama hujan, mengikuti instruksi resmi dan tinggal jauh dari daerah di mana air menumpuk, lembah dan saluran banjir. Sementara itu, perkiraan NCM moderat badai petir berat mampu menyebabkan banjir kilat pada hari Selasa, November 10, di bagian-bagian Provinsi Timur, Riyadh, Qassim, Hail, daerah Madinah dan Mekah, serta dataran tinggi Jazan dan Asir. Badai petir diharapkan disertai hujan es dan angin aktif mengaduk debu dan pasir. Cahaya ke curah hujan sedang juga diramalkan di bagian Tabuk, Al- Jouf dan daerah Batas Utara, dengan kemungkinan kabut di beberapa daerah ini. Menurut ramalan harian NCM, tingkat kelembaban diperkirakan mencapai 95 persen di Riyadh, Dammam, Abha dan Buraidah, diikuti 90 persen dalam Hail dan Al- Baha. Kelembaban juga diperkirakan 85 persen di Jazan dan Jeddah, 80 persen di Mekah dan Najran, 75 persen di Madinah, 70 persen di Tabuk, 65 persen di Arar dan 60 persen di Sakika.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Civil Defense issues red alerts across 7 regions as heavy rains sweep Kingdom
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Civil Defense has issued red alerts for heavy rainfall across parts of seven regions of the Kingdom, including Riyadh, Makkah, Madinah, Asir, Jazan, Hail and Qassim, as heavy November rains continue to sweep across Saudi Arabia. The warnings, based on alerts from the National Center for Meteorology (NCM), cover weather conditions affecting parts of the seven regions. Civil Defense urged residents to take precautions during rainfall, follow official instructions and stay away from areas where water accumulates, valleys and flood channels. Meanwhile, the NCM forecast moderate to heavy thunderstorms capable of causing flash floods on Tuesday, November 10, across parts of the Eastern Province, Riyadh, Qassim, Hail, Madinah and Makkah regions, as well as the highlands of Jazan and Asir. The thunderstorms are expected to be accompanied by hail and active winds stirring up dust and sand. Light to moderate rainfall is also forecast across parts of Tabuk, Al-Jouf and the Northern Borders regions, with fog possible in some of these areas. According to the NCM’s daily forecast, humidity levels are expected to reach 95 percent in Riyadh, Dammam, Abha and Buraidah, followed by 90 percent in Hail and Al-Baha. Humidity is also forecast at 85 percent in Jazan and Jeddah, 80 percent in Makkah and Najran, 75 percent in Madinah, 70 percent in Tabuk, 65 percent in Arar and 60 percent in Sakaka.

articles.description: RIYADH - Pertahanan udara dicegat dan menghancurkan rudal pesiar diluncurkan oleh milisi Houthi menuju Riyadh, Koalisi untuk mendukung Legitimasi di Yaman mengumumkan Selasa. Koalisi juga melaporkan bahwa pertahanan udara Saudi telah dicegat rudal balistik diluncurkan oleh Houthis menuju ibukota. Pertahanan Sipil Saudi mengaktifkan peringatan dini di Riyadh, memperingatkan penduduk dari ancaman potensial dan mendesak mereka untuk mengikuti instruksi keselamatan resmi. Dalam insiden terpisah, pertahanan udara Saudi menggagalkan rudal balistik lain diluncurkan oleh milisi Houthi menuju wilayah selatan Kerajaan, menurut koalisi. Penyadapan datang tak lama setelah koalisi mengumumkan penghancuran fasilitas Houthi yang digunakan untuk merakit dan menghasilkan komponen rudal balistik.
articles.originalTitle: Air defenses intercept Houthi cruise and ballistic missiles targeting Riyadh
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Air defenses intercepted and destroyed a cruise missile launched by the Houthi militia toward Riyadh, the Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen announced Tuesday.The coalition also reported that Saudi air defenses had intercepted a ballistic missile launched by the Houthis toward the capital.Saudi Civil Defense activated an early warning alert in Riyadh, warning residents of a potential threat and urging them to follow official safety instructions.In a separate incident, Saudi air defenses thwarted another ballistic missile launched by the Houthi militia toward the Kingdom's southern region, according to the coalition.The interceptions came shortly after the coalition announced the destruction of a Houthi facility used to assemble and produce ballistic missile components.

articles.title: Deputi Riyadh Emir memeriksa bangunan Saudi Aramco rusak dalam serangan Houthi
articles.description: RIYADH - Deputi Emir dari Riyadh Pangeran Mohammed bin Abdulrahman memeriksa sebuah bangunan administratif Saudi Aramco di Riyadh pada hari Senin untuk menilai kerusakan terbatas disebabkan oleh serangan Houthi menargetkan fasilitas sipil. Kunjungan ini mengikuti serangan pesawat tak berawak di gedung Minggu pagi, yang menyebabkan puing-puing jatuh ke tempatnya, mengakibatkan kerusakan yang terbatas tapi tidak ada cedera atau korban jiwa, menurut Kementerian Energi Saudi. Selama inspeksi, Pangeran Mohammed mengatakan serangan Houthi memperkuat posisi lama Arab Saudi tentang milisi teroris dan menargetkan fasilitas sipil. Dia memuji upaya personil di seluruh sipil, sektor militer dan keamanan dalam menanggapi insiden dan menjaga Kerajaan. Wakil emir diberi penjelasan tentang prosedur yang diterapkan oleh Saudi Aramco dan otoritas regional yang relevan setelah serangan tersebut. Dia mengarahkan bahwa semua sumber daya yang diperlukan dan dukungan disediakan untuk memfasilitasi pekerjaan personil Aramco. Pangeran Mohammed juga menghargai upaya kepemimpinan Saudi untuk menjaga keamanan dan stabilitas Kerajaan. Dia menyoroti semangat solidaritas nasional dan kesiapan pasukan Saudi untuk menghadapi ancaman apapun terhadap keamanan negara. Beberapa petugas keamanan senior dari daerah Riyadh menemani wakil emir selama pemeriksaan.
articles.originalTitle: Riyadh deputy emir inspects Saudi Aramco building damaged in Houthi attack
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Deputy Emir of Riyadh Region Prince Mohammed bin Abdulrahman inspected a Saudi Aramco administrative building in Riyadh on Monday to assess the limited damage caused by a Houthi attack targeting civilian facilities.The visit followed an attempted drone attack on the building Sunday morning, which caused debris to fall onto the premises, resulting in limited damage but no injuries or fatalities, according to the Saudi Ministry of Energy.**media[2792416]**The ministry said the relevant authorities immediately responded to the incident and took the necessary measures.During his inspection, Prince Mohammed said the Houthi attacks reinforced Saudi Arabia's longstanding position regarding the terrorist militia and its targeting of civilian facilities.He praised the efforts of personnel across civilian, military and security sectors in responding to the incident and safeguarding the Kingdom.The deputy emir was briefed on the procedures implemented by Saudi Aramco and the relevant regional authorities following the attack.**media[2792415]**He directed that all necessary resources and support be provided to facilitate the work of Aramco personnel.Prince Mohammed also expressed appreciation for the Saudi leadership's efforts to maintain the Kingdom's security and stability.He highlighted the spirit of national solidarity and the readiness of Saudi forces to confront any threats to the country's security.Several senior security officials from Riyadh Region accompanied the deputy emir during the inspection.

articles.title: Hampir 80 persen dari Inggris melihat Israel sebagai ancaman bagi perdamaian dunia
articles.description: Hampir 80 persen orang Inggris melihat Israel sebagai ancaman bagi perdamaian dunia hampir empat orang Inggris melihat Israel sebagai ancaman serius bagi perdamaian dunia, menurut survei yang diterbitkan minggu lalu oleh National Centre for Social Research (NatCen). Angka naik dari 48 persen pada tahun 2005 sampai 78 persen musim semi ini, dua setengah tahun menuju genosida di Gaza dan setelah Israel dan AS telah menyerang Iran. Pada bulan Juli, polling pendapat YouGov ditugaskan oleh Dewan Inggris-Arab Understanding menemukan bahwa hanya 17 persen dari populasi Inggris yang percaya bahwa Israel tidak melakukan genosida di Gaza. Perang terhadap Iran telah memukul ekonomi Inggris, meninggalkan rumah membayar lebih banyak untuk energi, makanan dan hipotek.
