articles.title: Perdana Menteri Kanada Carney mengutuk serangan Houthi di Arab Saudi selama panggilan dengan Putra Mahkota
articles.description: RIYADH - Saudi Crown Prince dan Perdana Menteri Mohammed bin Salman diadakan pada hari Senin panggilan telepon dengan Perdana Menteri Kanada Mark Carney. Selama panggilan, Carney mengutuk serangan teroris milisi Houthi di Arab Saudi dan menegaskan solidaritas Kanada dengan Arab Saudi terhadap ancaman apapun terhadap keamanannya dan keamanan warga negara dan warganya. Para pemimpin juga membahas hubungan bilateral antara dua negara dan cara untuk memperkuat dan mengembangkan kerjasama di berbagai bidang.
articles.originalTitle: Canadian PM Carney condemns Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia during call with Crown Prince
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman held on Monday a phone call with Prime Minister of Canada Mark Carney.During the call, Carney condemned the terrorist Houthi militia's attacks on Saudi Arabia and affirmed Canada's solidarity with Saudi Arabia against any threats to its security and the safety of its citizens and residents.The leaders also discussed bilateral relations between the two countries and ways to strengthen and develop cooperation across various fields.

articles.title: Saudi FM membahas situasi regional dengan rekan-rekan Inggris, Perancis, Jerman dan Korea di Paris
articles.description: PARIS - Saudi Menteri Luar Negeri Pangeran Faisal bin Farhan mengadakan pembicaraan dengan menteri asing Inggris, Perancis, Jerman dan Korea di Paris pada hari Senin. Pertemuan diadakan di pinggir Grup Tujuh (G7) Menteri Asing 'Rapat. Selama pertemuan mereka, Pangeran Faisal dan Sekretaris Negara Luar Negeri, Commonwealth dan Development Affairs of the United Kingdom Ed Miliband meninjau hubungan bilateral antara negara mereka. Mereka mendiskusikan masalah kunci regional dan perkembangan saat ini, serta upaya gabungan untuk memastikan keamanan maritim, rute pengiriman yang aman, dan memulihkan keamanan dan stabilitas di wilayah tersebut. Selama pertemuannya dengan Menteri Perancis untuk urusan luar negeri di Eropa, Jean- Noelle Barrot, Pangeran Faisal menyatakan penghargaan atas upaya Perancis selama kepresidenan G7 tahun ini dan untuk mengundang Arab Saudi untuk berpartisipasi dalam pertemuan menteri. Para menteri mendiskusikan perkembangan regional baru-baru ini, teroris milisi Houthi terus menyerang Arab Saudi, dan kerjasama upaya untuk mengandung krisis regional dan mengurangi dampak mereka. Mereka juga mendiskusikan upaya-upaya untuk melindungi saluran air, memastikan kebebasan navigasi, dan mempertahankan keamanan daerah dan stabilitas. Duta Besar Saudi ke Perancis Dr Faisal Almyfel menghadiri pertemuan. Pangeran Faisal bin Farhan juga bertemu dengan Menteri Luar Negeri Korea Cho Hyun. Selama pertemuan, mereka meninjau hubungan bilateral dan mendiskusikan jalan kerja sama dan kemitraan antara dua negara. Mereka juga bertukar pandangan pada isu-isu regional saat ini dan upaya-upaya yang berkelanjutan untuk mengatasi mereka. Menteri Luar Negeri Saudi dan Menteri Luar Negeri Jerman Johann Wadephul meninjau hubungan bilateral antara negara mereka. Mereka membahas perkembangan regional dan upaya diplomatik bertujuan untuk menjaga keamanan dan stabilitas di wilayah tersebut, memastikan kebebasan navigasi, dan keamanan rute maritim.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi FM discusses regional situation with his British, French, German and Korean counterparts in Paris
articles.originalDescription: PARIS — Saudi Minister of Foreign Affairs Prince Faisal bin Farhan held talks with foreign ministers of the United Kingdom, France, Germany and Korea in Paris on Monday. The meetings were held on the sidelines of the Group of Seven (G7) Foreign Ministers' Meeting.During their meeting, Prince Faisal and Secretary of State for Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Affairs of the United Kingdom Ed Miliband reviewed bilateral relations between their countries. They discussed key regional issues and current developments, as well as joint efforts to ensure maritime security, safeguard shipping routes, and restore security and stability in the region.During his meeting with French Minister for Europe and Foreign Affairs Jean-Noël Barrot, Prince Faisal expressed appreciation for France's efforts during its G7 presidency this year and for inviting Saudi Arabia to participate in the ministerial meeting. The ministers discussed recent regional developments, the terrorist Houthi militia's continued attacks on Saudi Arabia, and joint efforts to contain regional crises and mitigate their repercussions. They also discussed efforts to safeguard waterways, ensure freedom of navigation, and maintain regional security and stability. Saudi Ambassador to France Dr. Faisal Al-Mujfel attended the meeting. Prince Faisal bin Farhan also met with Korean Minister of Foreign Affairs Cho Hyun. During the meeting, they reviewed bilateral relations and discussed avenues of cooperation and partnership between the two countries. They also exchanged views on current regional issues and ongoing efforts to address them. The Saudi foreign minister and the German Federal Minister for Foreign Affairs Johann Wadephul reviewed bilateral relations between their countries. They discussed regional developments and diplomatic efforts aimed at maintaining security and stability in the region, ensuring freedom of navigation, and safeguarding maritime routes.

articles.title: Arab Saudi bergabung dengan G7 Paris berbicara tentang memanfaatkan AI untuk keamanan global
articles.description: PARIS - Saudi Menteri Luar Negeri Pangeran Faisal bin Farhan menghadiri sesi G7 diperluas dengan Partner (G7 +) pada kecerdasan buatan (AI) di Paris pada hari Senin. Sesi ini membahas implikasi kemajuan cepat dalam teknologi AI dan model untuk lingkungan strategis global dan keamanan internasional. Pertemuan ini juga ditujukan untuk memperkuat koordinasi internasional dalam mengelola resiko terkait AI- sambil mempromosikan inovasi dan memastikan pengembangan yang aman dan bertanggung jawab dan penggunaan teknologi ini untuk melindungi keamanan global dan stabilitas.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia joins G7 Paris talks on harnessing AI for global security
articles.originalDescription: PARIS — Saudi Minister of Foreign Affairs Prince Faisal bin Farhan attended an expanded G7 Session with Invited Partners (G7+) on artificial intelligence (AI) in Paris on Monday.The session discussed the implications of rapid advances in AI technologies and models for the global strategic environment and international security. The meeting also addressed ways to strengthen international coordination in managing AI-related risks while promoting innovation and ensuring the safe and responsible development and use of these technologies to safeguard global security and stability.

articles.description: RIYADH - Penanganan kontainer secara keseluruhan di seluruh pelabuhan Saudi mencatat peningkatan 14 persen dalam satu tahun selama bulan terakhir Oktober, menurut Abdullah Al- Munif, juru bicara dari Otoritas Pelabuhan Saudi (Mawani). Dia mengatakan bahwa Jeddah Islamic Port merekam volume penanganan bulanan tertinggi dalam sejarahnya pada Oktober 2026, mencapai 582.900 TEUs (unit ekuivalen dua belas kaki). Hal ini menandai peningkatan 27,45 persen atas catatan sebelumnya, ditetapkan pada bulan Juni. Al-Munif mencatat bahwa jeddah Islam Port 's catatan kinerja mencerminkan efisiensi operasional dan kemampuan logistik canggih. "The prestasi underscore kemampuan pelabuhan untuk menjaga kecepatan dengan transformasi cepat dalam perdagangan global dan mengakomodasi tumbuh volume perdagangan. Milestone ini akan membantu memastikan aliran halus barang dan memperkuat kelanjutan rantai pasokan," katanya. Menurut Otoritas Umum Ports dan Bea Cukai (GAPC), total volume kontainer yang ditangani di pelabuhan Saudi mencapai sekitar 86.200 TEU pada bulan Oktober, dibandingkan dengan sekitar 759.800 TEU pada bulan yang sama pada 2025. Pertumbuhannya didorong oleh 8,53 persen peningkatan dalam wadah inbound, yang naik sekitar 305.600 TEU dari 281.600 TEUS, dan peningkatan 4.83 persen dalam kontainer luar, yang naik ke sekitar 282.900 TEU dari 269.900 TEUs. Sementara itu, kontainer pengiriman menurun sebesar 10.54 persen ke sekitar 186,400 TEU, dibandingkan dengan 208.400 TEU, sementara kontainer transit berjumlah sekitar 91.300 TEU. Termasuk 1,83 juta ton kargo umum, 9.48 juta ton muatan massal cair, dan 4.44 juta ton kargo padat, sementara kargo transit mencapai 34.780 ton. articles.originalTitle: Container handling at Saudi ports rises 14% in October; Jeddah Islamic Port sets a record
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The overall container handling across Saudi ports recorded a 14 percent year-on-year increase during the last month of October, according to Abdullah Al-Munif, spokesperson of the Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani). He said that Jeddah Islamic Port recorded the highest monthly container-handling volume in its history in October 2026, reaching 582,900 TEUs (twenty-foot equivalent units). This marked a 27.45 percent increase over its previous record, set in June.Al-Munif noted that Jeddah Islamic Port's record performance reflects its operational efficiency and advanced logistical capabilities. “The achievement underscores the port's ability to keep pace with the rapid transformations in global trade and accommodate growing trade volumes. This milestone would help ensure the smooth flow of goods and strengthen the continuity of supply chains,” he said. According to the General Authority of Ports and Customs (GAPC), the total volume of containers handled at Saudi ports reached approximately 866,200 TEUs in October, compared to around 759,800 TEUs in the same month of 2025. The growth was driven by an 8.53 percent increase in inbound containers, which rose to approximately 305,600 TEUs from 281,600 TEUs, and a 4.83 percent increase in outbound containers, which climbed to approximately 282,900 TEUs from 269,900 TEUs. Meanwhile, transshipment containers declined by 10.54 percent to approximately 186,400 TEUs, compared to 208,400 TEUs, while transit containers totaled approximately 91,300 TEUs. In contrast, the total volume of cargo handled at Saudi ports fell by 11.7 percent to 22.36 million tons in October, compared to 25.32 million tons in the same month last year. This included 1.83 million tons of general cargo, 9.48 million tons of liquid bulk cargo, and 4.44 million tons of solid bulk cargo, while transit cargo amounted to 34,780 tons. articles.title: Departemen Energi: Eastern-West Pipeline ditargetkan di Madinah; operasi tetap tidak terpengaruh
articles.description: RIYADH - Sebuah sumber resmi di Kementerian Energi menyatakan bahwa East-West Pipeline di wilayah Madinah ditargetkan pada hari Senin, 9 November, mengakibatkan kebakaran kecil. Tim respon darurat berhasil membawa api di bawah kontrol tanpa cedera atau korban jiwa, sementara operasi pipa tetap tidak terpengaruh. Sumber ini menjelaskan bahwa tim tanggap darurat, bersama dengan tim teknis khusus, segera meluncurkan operasi setelah serangan dan mengambil semua tindakan yang diperlukan untuk mengamankan situs dan memastikan keselamatannya sesuai dengan prosedur keamanan yang disetujui dan rencana respon darurat.
articles.originalTitle: Energy ministry: East-West Pipeline targeted in Madinah; operations remain unaffected
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — An official source at the Ministry of Energy stated that the East-West Pipeline in the Madinah region was targeted on Monday, November 9, resulting in a minor fire. Emergency response teams successfully brought the fire under control without any injuries or fatalities, while the pipeline's operations remained unaffected.The source explained that emergency response teams, along with specialized technical teams, immediately launched operations following the attack and took all necessary measures to secure the site and ensure its safety in accordance with approved safety procedures and emergency response plans.

articles.title: Etimad meluncurkan layanan pembayaran yang baik untuk perusahaan swasta dan nirlaba
articles.description: RIYADH - The National Center for Government Resource Systems (NCGR) mengumumkan peluncuran "Instal Requests for Violations" layanan untuk privasi - dan non-profit-sektor-sektor melalui platform Etimad. Layanan baru memungkinkan pendirian untuk menerapkan pemasangan berdasarkan penyelesaian denda keuangan yang luar biasa sesuai dengan prosedur yang disetujui. NCGR mengatakan bahwa layanan dirancang untuk memungkinkan pendirian untuk mengajukan permintaan untuk membayar denda keuangan yang luar biasa dalam instalasi, memfasilitasi akses ke layanan sesuai dengan prosedur yang disetujui. Layanan ini memungkinkan pelanggar di sektor swasta dan nirlaba untuk menyelesaikan denda yang diberlakukan oleh lembaga pemerintah dan direkam pada platform "Efaa" melalui pembayaran angsuran. Hal ini bertujuan untuk meringankan beban keuangan membayar denda ini sementara berkontribusi untuk meningkatkan pendapatan pemerintah.
articles.originalTitle: Etimad launches fine installment payment service for private and non-profit establishments
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — The National Center for Government Resource Systems (NCGR) announced the launch of the “Installment Requests for Violations” service for private- and non-profit-sector establishments through the Etimad platform. The new service enables establishments to apply for installment-based settlement of outstanding financial fines in accordance with approved procedures.The NCGR said that the service is designed to enable establishments to submit requests to pay outstanding financial fines in installments, facilitating access to the service in accordance with approved procedures. The service allows violators in the private and non-profit sectors to settle fines imposed by government agencies and recorded on the “Efaa” platform through installment payments. It aims to ease the financial burden of paying these fines while contributing to increased government revenue.

"Selama periode yang sama, jumlah pengunjung ke Al- Rawdah Al- Sharifah di Nabi Masjid di Madinah naik dari sekitar 6 juta sampai hampir 16 juta. Prestasi ini dimungkinkan oleh pengembangan layanan terus menerus dan upaya konser dari pihak berwenang yang relevan," katanya. Menteri membuat pernyataan saat menghadiri sesi menteri berjudul "Melayani Peziarah: Sebuah Ekosistem Nasional Terpadu", pada hari kedua dari edisi keenam dari Konferensi Haji dan Pameran di Jeddah pada hari Senin. Sesi ini membahas integrasi upaya oleh badan-badan pemerintah dan eksekutif dalam melayani peziarah, mengembangkan mekanisme untuk kerjasama bersama, dan meningkatkan tingkat kesiapan untuk 1448 musim haji. Al- Rabiah menunjukkan bahwa lebih dari 60 lembaga pemerintah terlibat dalam sistem haji, beroperasi di bawah sekitar 600 tahunan rencana operasional. Addressing sesi, Menteri Turisme Al- Khateeb menyoroti peran kementerian sebagai mitra kunci dalam sistem melayani tamu Allah. Dia mencatat bahwa pelayanan telah bertanggung jawab untuk mengawasi akomodasi peziarah dalam koordinasi dengan Kementerian Haji dan Umrah, sementara bekerja untuk meningkatkan kualitas fasilitas akomodasi. Dia mengungkapkan bahwa sekitar 400 bangunan telah diambil dari layanan karena gagal untuk memenuhi standa

articles.title: perluasan bandara Madinah untuk meningkatkan kapasitas 18 juta penumpang pada Oktober 2027
articles.description: JEDDAH - Otoritas Umum Penerbangan Sipil (GACA) Presiden Abdulaziz Al- Duailej mengatakan bahwa proyek ekspansi di Bandara Internasional Pangeran Mohammed bin Abdulaziz di Madinah akan meningkatkan kapasitas 18 juta dari 8 juta penumpang, dengan penyelesaian proyek dijadwalkan untuk Oktober 2027. Berbicara di Konferensi Haji 6 dan Pameran di Superdome Jeddah, ia menegaskan bahwa sektor penerbangan memainkan peran penting dalam memajukan tujuan dari Program Layanan Pilgrim. Dia mencatat bahwa, dengan dukungan kepemimpinan, tahun-round upaya sedang berlangsung untuk memastikan kenyamanan dan kenyamanan peziarah selama musim haji di enam bandara utama. Al- Duailej mengatakan bahwa Raja Abdulaziz International Airport di Jeddah Menangani rekor 52 juta penumpang tahun lalu. Dia menyoroti proyek pembangunan yang sedang berlangsung ditujukan untuk memperluas kapasitas operasional dan meningkatkan kualitas layanan yang disediakan untuk penumpang dan peziarah di bandara. Kepala GaCA menjelaskan bahwa proyek-proyek ini termasuk peningkatan dan rehabilitasi Terminal 4 untuk mengakomodasi lebih dari 15 juta penumpang, pembangunan terminal haji bandara untuk menangani 16 juta penumpang, dan perluasan Terminal 1. articles.title: Otoritas Haram membuka prekualifikasi untuk pasokan makanan Iftar tender untuk Ramadan berikutnya
articles.description: MAKKAH - Otoritas Umum untuk Layanan Urusan Masjid Grand dan Masjid Nabi, dalam kemitraan dengan Yayasan Kemanusiaan Nusak, telah membuka aplikasi untuk produksi makanan dan perusahaan pasokan untuk pasokan makanan untuk para pemuja puasa di Masjid Grand Mekah dan Masjid Nabi di Madinah selama Ramadan 1448. tender tujuan untuk menarik perusahaan berkualitas yang memenuhi persyaratan teknis dan operasional dan dapat memasok makanan secara efisien, dalam kepatuhan ketat dengan standar keamanan makanan. Untuk prekualifikasi, perusahaan harus memiliki pendapatan rata-rata tahunan setidaknya SR50 juta selama tiga tahun terakhir, pengalaman yang terbukti memasok 150.000 kali makan dalam satu hari, fasilitas produksi makanan berlisensi, setidaknya 15 kendaraan pendingin didedikasikan untuk transportasi makanan, dan setidaknya lima tahun pengalaman dalam produksi makanan atau pasokan. Para pelamar juga harus memegang sertifikasi keamanan makanan terakreditasi, seperti ISO 22000, FSSC 22000, atau ekuivalen, dan memenuhi semua ketentuan lisensi dan persyaratan hukum. Aplikasi dibuka dari hari Minggu, Nov 8, sampai Selasa, Nov 10, 2026, pada platform kualifikasi Sufar pemasok. Rincian tender, persyaratan, dan prosedur pengajuan tersedia di https: / / sufar.org, dan pertanyaan dapat dikirim ke Sufar.org.org.
articles.originalTitle: Haram authority opens prequalification for iftar meal supply tender for next Ramadan
articles.originalDescription: MAKKAH — The General Authority for the Care of the Affairs of the Grand Mosque and the Prophet's Mosque, in partnership with the Nusuk Humanitarian Foundation, has opened applications for food production and supply companies for a tender for the supply of iftar meals for fasting worshippers at the Grand Mosque in Makkah and the Prophet's Mosque in Madinah during Ramadan 1448 AH.The tender aims to attract qualified companies that meet technical and operational requirements and can supply meals efficiently, in strict compliance with food safety standards. To prequalify, companies must have average annual revenue of at least SR50 million over the past three years, proven experience supplying 150,000 meals in a single day, a licensed food production facility, at least 15 refrigerated vehicles dedicated to meal transport, and at least five years of experience in food manufacturing or supply. Applicants must also hold accredited food safety certification, such as ISO 22000, FSSC 22000, or equivalent, and meet all regulatory licensing and legal requirements. Applications are open from Sunday, Nov. 8, to Tuesday, Nov. 10, 2026, on the Sufar supplier qualification platform. Tender details, requirements, and submission procedures are available at https://sufar.org, and inquiries can be sent to Suppliers@sufar.org.

articles.title: Arab Saudi meluncurkan buku ujian medis online untuk pekerja domestik yang baru tiba
articles.description: RIYADH - Arab Saudi Departemen Sumber Daya Manusia dan Pengembangan Sosial (MHRSD) telah memperkenalkan layanan online untuk jadwal pemeriksaan medis pemesanan bagi pekerja lokal yang baru tiba. Melalui integrasi dari platform perekrutan Mushant dan aplikasi Sehhatty, dan kerjasama dengan Departemen Kesehatan, layanan bertujuan untuk menyederhanakan prosedur sederhana bagi para majikan, meningkatkan pengalaman mereka dalam layanan akses dan memfasilitasi penyelesaian persyaratan untuk menerbitkan izin tinggal (iqamas). Layanan baru memungkinkan pengusaha untuk secara otomatis melihat rincian pekerja domestik mereka melalui aplikasi Sehhaty setelah kedatangan mereka di Kingdom, pilih pusat kesehatan terakreditasi terdekat, dan buku dan mengelola pemeriksaan medis janji elektronik. Karyawan dapat menyelesaikan proses pemesanan tanpa mengunjungi pusat kesehatan secara pribadi, menghemat waktu dan usaha sambil membantu mengurangi periode menunggu. Bentuk integrasi bagian dari upaya yang sedang berlangsung untuk mengembangkan proses perekrutan digital melalui platform Musanted, meliputi seluruh perjalanan dari negara pekerja asal sampai penerbitan izin tinggal sesuai dengan peraturan Saudi. Dengan menghubungkan layanan dan menyederhanakan prosedur terkait, inisiatif bertujuan untuk meningkatkan kualitas layanan dan aksesibilitas, mendukung upaya transformasi digital pelayanan dan meningkatkan kepercayaan penerima 'dalam layanan yang disediakan.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia launches online medical exam booking for newly arrived domestic workers
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (MHRSD) has introduced an online service for booking medical examination appointments for newly arrived domestic workers. Through the integration of the Musaned recruitment platform and the Sehhaty application, and in cooperation with the Ministry of Health, the service aims to simplify procedures for employers, improve their experience in accessing services and facilitate the completion of requirements for issuing residency permits (iqamas). The new service allows employers to automatically view the details of their domestic workers through the Sehhaty application upon their arrival in the Kingdom, select the nearest accredited health center, and book and manage medical examination appointments electronically. Employers can complete the booking process without visiting a health center in person, saving time and effort while helping reduce waiting periods. The integration forms part of ongoing efforts to develop the digital recruitment process through the Musaned platform, covering the entire journey from the worker’s country of origin to the issuance of a residency permit in accordance with Saudi regulations. By connecting services and simplifying related procedures, the initiative aims to improve service quality and accessibility, support the ministry’s digital transformation efforts and enhance beneficiaries’ trust in the services provided.

articles.title: NCM mengeluarkan peringatan merah untuk kabut padat di Asir, peringatan oranye untuk hujan dan kabut di 3 daerah
articles.description: JEDDAH - Pusat Nasional Meteorologi (NCM) mengeluarkan peringatan merah untuk kabut padat di Asir bersama peringatan oranye untuk curah hujan moderat di Vassim dan kabut di Jazan dan Riyadh pada hari Senin. Peringatan merah di Asir meliputi Abha, Ahad Rufaydah, Al Namas, Balqarn, Tanorah dan Khamis Mushait, peringatan kabut tebal dan visibilitas turun ke satu kilometer atau kurang. Peringatan itu berlaku dari 1 pagi sampai 8 pagi Di Qassim, sebuah peringatan oranye dikeluarkan untuk curah hujan moderat 10: 00 sampai 10: 00, meliputi Abanat, Al Khabra, Al Rass, Al Fawwarah, Al Nabhaniyah, Riyadh Al Khabra, Dariyah dan Uqlat Al Suqur. NCM memperingatkan bahwa curah hujan dapat disertai oleh angin kuat, dekat - nol visibilitas, hujan es, banjir kilat dan badai petir. Sementara itu, peringatan oranye untuk kabut dikeluarkan di Jazan, meliputi Al Harth, Al Dair, Al Reeth, Al Aridah, Al Eidabi, Fayfa dan Harub, dari 1: 00 sampai 8: 00, dengan visibilitas diharapkan drop ke antara satu dan tiga kilometer. Di wilayah Riyadh, sebuah peringatan oranye untuk melanjutkan kabut Al Zulu, Al Ghat, Al Majmaah dan Shaqra dari 1: 10 pagi, dengan visibilitas juga diharapkan jatuh ke antara satu dan tiga kilometer. Dalam ramalan cuaca sehari-hari, NCM diperkirakan moderat untuk badai petir berat disertai hujan es dan angin aktif di bagian-bagian Jazan, Asir dan Al Baha, berpotensi menyebabkan banjir kilat. Cahaya untuk curah hujan sedang juga diperkirakan untuk bagian-bagian daerah Mekah dan Riyadh, sementara angin aktif bisa menaikkan debu dan pasir, mengurangi visibilitas di beberapa daerah. Pusat juga memperingatkan kemungkinan formasi kabut di bagian daerah yang terkena dampak.
articles.originalTitle: NCM issues red alert for dense fog in Asir, orange alerts for rain and fog in 3 regions
articles.originalDescription: JEDDAH —The National Center for Meteorology (NCM) issued a red alert for dense fog in Asir alongside orange alerts for moderate rainfall in Qassim and fog in Jazan and Riyadh on Monday. The red alert in Asir covers Abha, Ahad Rufaydah, Al Namas, Balqarn, Tanomah and Khamis Mushait, warning of dense fog and visibility dropping to one kilometer or less. The alert was in effect from 1 a.m. to 8 a.m. In Qassim, an orange alert was issued for moderate rainfall from 10 a.m. to 10 p.m., covering Abanat, Al Khabra, Al Rass, Al Fawwarah, Al Nabhaniyah, Riyadh Al Khabra, Dariyah and Uqlat Al Suqur. The NCM warned that the rainfall could be accompanied by strong winds, near-zero visibility, hail, flash floods and thunderstorms. Meanwhile, an orange alert for fog was issued in Jazan, covering Al Harth, Al Dair, Al Reeth, Al Aridah, Al Eidabi, Fayfa and Harub, from 1 a.m. to 8 a.m., with visibility expected to drop to between one and three kilometers. In Riyadh region, an orange alert for continued fog covered Al Zulfi, Al Ghat, Al Majmaah and Shaqra from 1 a.m. to 10 a.m., with visibility also expected to fall to between one and three kilometers. In its daily weather forecast, the NCM predicted moderate to heavy thunderstorms accompanied by hail and active winds across parts of Jazan, Asir and Al Baha, potentially causing flash floods. Light to moderate rainfall was also forecast for parts of Makkah and Riyadh regions, while active winds could raise dust and sand, reducing visibility in several areas. The center also warned of possible fog formation in parts of the affected regions.

Menteri mengatakan bahwa sekitar 4.000 bangunan akomodasi di Mekah dan Madinah telah dibuat tersedia, menyediakan kapasitas gabungan dari 400.000 kamar. Dia juga mengungkapkan bahwa sementara fasilitas akomodasi untuk haji telah disediakan sekitar 560.000 tempat tidur. articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia secures over 1.3 million beds for Hajj, licenses all pilgrim accommodation buildings
articles.originalDescription: JEDDAH — Saudi Arabia has secured more than 1.3 million beds for the 1448 AH Hajj season, Minister of Tourism Ahmed Al-Khateeb announced. Speaking at the Hajj Conference and Exhibition, Al-Khateeb revealed that all buildings designated to accommodate pilgrims for the upcoming Hajj season had been licensed asof the previous day, highlighting the Kingdom's early preparations. The minister said that approximately 4,000 accommodation buildings across Makkah and Madinah have been made available, providing a combined capacity of 400,000 rooms. He also revealed that temporary accommodation facilities for Hajj pilgrims have provided approximately 560,000 beds. Al-Khateeb highlighted the scale of accommodation capacity in the two holy cities, comparing their combined 400,000 rooms to the accommodation capacity available in countries worldwide. He said that only 10 percent of countries globally offer a comparable number of rooms. The minister explained that the Ministry of Tourism was entrusted with overseeing Hajj pilgrim accommodation last year, focusing on two key priorities: ensuring sufficient accommodation capacity and maintaining high service standards. In coordination with the Ministry of Hajj and Umrah and under the supervision of the Supreme Hajj Committee, chaired by the Minister of Interior, approximately 400 buildings were removed from service for failing to meet certain essential requirements. Al-Khateeb explained that building assessments focus on two main areas: structural safety and the quality of services provided within accommodation facilities. Working alongside Civil Defense, authorities assess buildings for structural integrity, emergency exits, overall safety and readiness, and suitability for licensed pilgrim accommodation. The minister also highlighted that Hajj pilgrim satisfaction had reached 93 percent, emphasizing that accommodation quality plays a crucial role in maintaining the overall pilgrim experience. articles.title: Arab Saudi mencapai tingkat kepuasan haji 93%
articles.description: JEDDAH - Arab Saudi mencapai tingkat kepuasan 93 persen dengan layanan yang disediakan untuk peziarah haji, Menteri haji dan Umrah Tawfiq Al- Rabia mengumumkan. Berbicara di Konferensi Haji dan Pameran, Al- Rabiah dikaitkan prestasi untuk upaya terkoordinasi Melibatkan lebih dari 60 lembaga pemerintah dan review sekitar 600 rencana depan musim haji. Menteri juga menyoroti kemajuan di bawah Program Peziarah, diluncurkan pada tahun 2019 di bawah Penjaga Dua Masjid Suci Raja Salman, mengumumkan bahwa program telah melampaui target 90 persen untuk pengalaman peziarah Umrah. Dia menguraikan tiga tujuan utama program ini: memfasilitasi akses ke Dua Masjid Suci, memberikan layanan berkualitas tinggi, dan memperkaya pengalaman agama dan budaya para peziarah. Al- Rabiah menjelaskan bahwa program ini melacak beberapa indikator kinerja kunci, termasuk jumlah peziarah Umrah, aksesibilitas bagi peziarah internasional, dan seluruh pengalaman Umrah. Dia juga menyoroti upaya untuk meningkatkan haji pengalaman dan mengembangkan sejarah, Islam, dan situs budaya. Menteri lebih lanjut menguraikan perencanaan ekstensif balik prestasi ini, termasuk menetapkan tujuan, koordinasi pertemuan, dan membangun sistem terintegrasi untuk mengelola haji dan proyek Umrah. Al- Rabiah menekankan bahwa hasil upaya ini sekarang terlihat di tanah.
articles.originalTitle: Saudi Arabia achieves 93% Hajj pilgrim satisfaction rate
articles.originalDescription: JEDDAH —Saudi Arabia achieved a 93 percent satisfaction rate with services provided to Hajj pilgrims, Minister of Hajj and Umrah Tawfiq Al-Rabiah announced. Speaking at the Hajj Conference and Exhibition, Al-Rabiah attributed the achievement to coordinated efforts involving more than 60 government agencies and the review of approximately 600 plans ahead of the Hajj season. The minister also highlighted progress under the Pilgrim Experience Program, launched in 2019 under the Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman, announcing that the program had surpassed its 90 percent target for the Umrah pilgrim experience. He outlined the program's three main objectives: facilitating access to the Two Holy Mosques, delivering high-quality services, and enriching pilgrims' religious and cultural experiences. Al-Rabiah explained that the program tracks several key performance indicators, including the number of Umrah pilgrims, accessibility for international pilgrims, and the overall Umrah experience. He also highlighted efforts to enhance the Hajj pilgrim experience and develop historical, Islamic, and cultural sites. The minister further outlined the extensive planning behind these achievements, including setting objectives, coordinating meetings, and establishing an integrated system to manage Hajj and Umrah projects. Al-Rabiah emphasized that the results of these efforts are now visible on the ground.

articles.originalTitle: Six more nations, GCC and Muslim World League condemn Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia
articles.originalDescription: RIYADH — Six more countries along with the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) and Muslim World League (MWL), have strongly condemned the terrorist Houthi militia’s continued attacks on Saudi Arabia, joining Syria, Kuwait and Bahrain in reaffirming solidarity with the Kingdom and support for its security and sovereignty. In a statement issued on Monday, the UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs condemned the Houthi group’s attempts to target several areas of Saudi Arabia, describing them as a flagrant violation of the Kingdom’s sovereignty and a threat to its security and stability. The ministry reaffirmed the UAE’s full solidarity with Saudi Arabia and support for all measures aimed at preserving its security and stability. Egypt’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs also condemned the continued attacks on Saudi territory, including the launch of two ballistic missiles toward Riyadh, describing them as a violation of international law and Saudi sovereignty, an escalation and a direct threat to civilians. The ministry expressed Egypt’s full solidarity with Saudi Arabia and support for measures taken to defend its security, sovereignty, citizens and interests. Qatar’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs condemned the Houthi attacks on several areas of the Kingdom, most recently the targeting of Riyadh with two ballistic missiles, describing them as aggressive conduct that disregards civilian lives and violates Saudi sovereignty and international law. Konferensi ini, dengan tema "Dari Mekah ke Dunia", diselenggarakan oleh Kementerian Haji dan Umrah bekerjasama dengan Program Peziarah Pengalaman. Upacara pelantikan dihadiri oleh beberapa pejabat senior Saudi, kepala misi haji, dan perwakilan kantor urusan haji dari berbagai negara di dunia Islam. Deputi Emir dari Mekah tur pameran pendamping, di mana ia melihat teknologi terbaru, memperkaya inisiatif, dan pintar dirancang untuk meningkatkan layanan bagi peziarah. Dia juga mengunjungi paviliun-pavilion dari entitas yang turut serta mewakili sektor pemerintah, swasta, dan sektor nirlaba. articles.originalTitle: Makkah Deputy Emir inaugurates Hajj Conference and Exhibition
articles.originalDescription: JEDDAH — Deputy Emir of Makkah Prince Saud bin Mishaal inaugurated on Sunday the sixth edition of the Hajj Conference and Exhibition at Jeddah Superdome. The four-day event is being held under the patronage of Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman. The conference, with the theme "From Makkah to the World," is organized by the Ministry of Hajj and Umrah in cooperation with the Pilgrim Experience Program. The inaugural ceremony was attended by several senior Saudi officials, heads of Hajj missions, and representatives of Hajj affairs offices from various countries of the Islamic world. The Deputy Emir of Makkah toured the accompanying exhibition, where he viewed the latest technologies, enriching initiatives, and smart solutions designed to enhance services for pilgrims. He also visited the pavilions of participating entities representing the governmental, private, and non-profit sectors. In his address on behalf of King Salman, Prince Saud welcomed the attendees to their second home, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and conveyed the King's greetings.“With God's help and guidance, Saudi Arabia continues its blessed efforts to serve the Two Holy Mosques and pilgrims, placing this noble mission at the forefront of its priorities. The Kingdom reaffirms its commitment to the continuous development of the Hajj system, enhancing service quality, harnessing the latest technologies, and strengthening integration among government agencies to facilitate the pilgrim's journey from departure until a safe return. The continued success of Hajj seasons stands as a testament to the readiness and high efficiency of the Hajj system,” the deputy emir said, adding, the Hajj and Umrah Conference and Exhibition is one of the key enablers of this success, contributing to enhanced cooperation and joint coordination, the conclusion of agreements, and improved preparedness for the Hajj season. articles.originalTitle: US-Saudi Business Council charts new path to boost trade, investment and economic ties
articles.originalDescription: WASHINGTON — The meeting of the Board of Directors of the U.S.- Saudi Business Council reaffirmed its commitment to supporting the strategic and economic partnership between the two countries. articles.description: Keruntuhan bank pasir Gaza membunuh lima di antara hujan lebat Setidaknya lima orang telah terbunuh, termasuk tiga anak, setelah hujan lebat menyebabkan sebuah bank pasir runtuh di pusat Gaza Deir al- Balah, Berita Wafa dilaporkan pada hari Minggu. articles.originalTitle: Gaza sandbank collapse kills five amid heavy rains
articles.originalDescription: Gaza sandbank collapse kills five amid heavy rains At least five people have been killed, including three children, after heavy rains caused a sandbank to collapse in central Gaza's Deir al-Balah, Wafa news reported on Sunday. A civil defence spokesman added that five wounded people had been pulled out of the rubble after their tents were hit, and teams are continuing to search for survivors. The incident comes amid worsening conditions faced by displaced Palestinians in Gaza, as national and internation institutions warned heavy rainfall and bad weather require urgent intervention and the provision of safe shelter and winter supplies.
